02004242.name: Wealth Acquisition Potion
02004242.desc: A pungent alchemical concoction that increases item and Meso drop rates by 20% for 2 hours. The Wealth Acquisition Potion is not limited by item drop rate increases or max Meso acquisition increases. Alchemists are able to stomach two potions with Meso, EXP, Drop Rate Boost effects at a time, but they are too strong for anyone else to drink more than one.

02350901.desc: A ticket used to request a custom illustration from the Wandering Portraitist. Upon accepting the request, the Wandering Portraitist will harvest the energy of your character's appearance to ply his trade. You can receive this ticket from the Wandering Portraitist under special circumstances. It produces the same result as the Portrait Commission Ticket.\r\nIf you're lucky, you will get 4 illustrations.

02350902.name: Silver Portrait Commission Ticket
02350902.desc: A silver ticket used to request a custom illustration from the Wandering Portraitist. Upon accepting the request, the Wandering Portraitist will harvest the energy of your character's appearance to ply his trade.\r\nIf you're lucky, you will get 4 illustrations at once. You can recommission up to 2 times if you are not satisfied with the results.

02635541.name: Thunbergia Pot
02635541.desc: This elegant flower pot holds thunbergia erecta, a type of morning glory flower also known as the king's mantle. The elegant, old-world style of St. Tia is on full display. These flowers should help the Guild Castle welcome each glorious morning.

02635542.name: Bridal Wreath Pot
02635542.desc: An elegant flower pot with flowers pruned from the Greenhouse. The antique and elegant style of St. Tia is on full display.\nIt carries a soft, flowery scent.

02635543.name: Oberon's Vase
02635543.desc: This flower vase contains rare pansies from what was once called the Fairy Forest.\nRumor has it that rubbing the sap from the crushed petals around someone's eyes will make them fall in love with the first person they see.

02635544.name: Pot of Purity
02635544.desc: This pot of flowers represents our love for our shared home.\nAs long as that love holds strong, the flowers will not wilt.

02635545.name: Form of Power Statue
02635545.desc: An artistic, geometric statue representing the power of the Energy Stone.\nIt radiates awe and reverence.

02635546.name: Form of a Droplet Statue
02635546.desc: This sculpture's curved surface is meant to represent a falling droplet of water, which in turn represents the tears of one who dedicated themselves to the protection of the castle.

02635547.name: Ornate Decorative Sword
02635547.desc: This sword was clearly well cared for. It was forged a long time ago, but it still feels like it's fresh off the anvil.

02635548.name: Plaster Bust
02635548.desc: A plaster bust of a man who was well-known in St. Tia for his good looks. Makes any room feel more attractive. Nothing beats the classics!

02635549.name: Crystal Lighting Ornament
02635549.desc: This crystal decoration emits a soft glow.\nThe ore is unrefined, and has a mysterious quality to it.

02635550.name: Crystal Candelabrum
02635550.desc: A candelabrum with multiple candles dipped in gold placed on it.\nThe sparkling crystal decorations make it look like a glistening chandelier.

02635551.name: Pig Statue
02635551.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World pig.\nRumors say that placing one in the Guild Castle increases luck when it comes to money.

02635552.name: Mushroom Statue
02635552.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World Orange Mushroom.\nRumors say that placing one in the Guild Castle brings happiness.

02635553.name: Slime Statue
02635553.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World slime.\nRumors say that the statue grants wishes.

02635554.name: Snail Statue
02635554.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World snail.\nRumors say that placing one in the Guild Castle grants long life and long-term success.

02635555.name: Noble's Altar
02635555.desc: This altar stands in honor of the castle's past defenders and the sacrifices they made.\nA large censer sits in the center.

02635556.name: Oil Painting Easel
02635556.desc: An easel with an oil painting of a landscape, placed in a golden frame. If your mind is crowded with noisy thoughts, gaze at this painting. Peace will surely come to you.

02635557.name: Guild Castle Flag
02635557.desc: This flag goes with any room in the Guild Castle. The blue fabric and luxurious decorations show off the guild's high status.

02635558.name: White Grand Piano
02635558.desc: One of the castle's past residents favored this grand piano.\nIf you listen, you can almost hear the echoes of its old melodies.

02635559.name: Angel's Harp
02635559.desc: A statue of an angel playing the harp. Originally, this piece only included the harp, but an artist added the angel to represent comfort when laying down to sleep amidst crowded thoughts.

02635560.name: Goddess Minerva Statue
02635560.desc: While studying abroad in Orbis, a sculptor came across a statue of Minerva, and created this statue in tribute. According to the story, the sculptor also wanted to comfort someone who suffered from insomnia. Rumors say that those who pet the statue of Eliza, who's asleep at the goddess's feet, will fall into sleep free of nightmares.

02635561.name: Spirit of the Snow Statue
02635561.desc: A statue sculpted in the form of a Spirit of Snow. Created with pristine ice, it holds together without melting, thanks to the Energy Stone's protection.

02635562.name: Dragon Fossil
02635562.desc: The old kingdom's archaeologist worked long and hard to complete this skeletal structure. It was a great asset for biological research, and played a crucial role during the war against the dragons in the past.

02635563.name: Phonograph Cabinet and Sofa
02635563.desc: A comfortable fabric sofa, placed next to the Phonograph Cabinet.\nSit down, listen to music, and feel all your worries drift away.

02635564.name: Grandfather Clock
02635564.desc: This grandfather clock befits the elegant look of the castle.\nAs one of the castle's oldest decorations, it continued to tell the time even after the residents had left the castle behind.

02635565.name: St. Tia Fountain
02635565.desc: A large fountain with numerous decorations.\nBuilt in the style of St. Tia, it portrays the land's distinctive style.

02635566.name: Craftsman Statue
02635566.desc: When a certain kingdom defeated a plague of dragons, an artist spent the rest of his life sculpting a monument to the victory. This sculpture radiates pride in that victory, as well as a sense of solidarity with the hero facing the dragon.

02635567.name: Pipe Organ
02635567.desc: A massive instrument befitting an impressive castle like yours. If you sit down and start to play it, then deep, calm melodies will permeate throughout the castle.

02635568.name: Hero Statue
02635568.desc: When a certain kingdom defeated a plague of dragons, an artist spent the rest of his life sculpting a monument to the victory. This is a recreation of, and homage to, that original monument.

02671140.desc: Spooky?! Cute?! Don't anger the spider! One wrong move, and the precious spiderweb might break.

02671141.name: Maplemas Light Bulb Tree
02671141.desc: There's no rule that the Maplemas tree has to be on the ground. It's easy to create a festive mood using light bulbs!

02671170.name: 살랑살랑 레이스 커튼 창문
02671170.desc: 분홍색 레이스 커튼이 달린 창문. 바람이 들어와 살랑살랑 거리는 모습이 보기 좋다.

02671171.name: 점핑 주황버섯 나무액자
02671171.desc: 통통 튀어다니는 주황버섯의 모습이 그려진 액자. 독보적인 점프 능력은 주황버섯을 따라올 자가 없다.

02671172.name: 점핑 리본돼지 나무액자
02671172.desc: 뛰어다니고 튀어다니기도 하는 리본돼지의 모습이 그려진 액자. 리본돼지의 질주 본능은 그칠 줄 모른다.

02671173.name: 점핑 슬라임 나무액자
02671173.desc: 통통 튀어다니는 슬라임의 모습이 그려진 액자. 점프 능력으로는 주황버섯과 슬라임을 따라올 자가 없다.

02671174.name: 원목 주방 선반
02671174.desc: 나무로 만든 주방 선반. 여러 주방 도구를 간편히 보관할 수 있다.

02671175.name: 오래된 목재 창문
02671175.desc: 세월의 흐름이 느껴지는 목재 창문. 바람이 불 때마다 삐그덕 거리는 소리가 난다. 그래도 귀신은 아니니 걱정하지 말자.

02671176.name: 페리온 태양 패브릭 포스터
02671176.desc: 페리온의 태양 장식이 그려진 패브릭 포스터. 어디까지나 기념품이니 이걸 두르고 페리온의 모래 황야를 걸어다닐 생각은 말자. 입에 모래 들어온다.

02671177.name: 메이플 월드맵
02671177.desc: 메이플 월드 전역이 상세히 그려진 지도. 분명 이 지도를 만들기 위해 누군가는 직접 모든 곳을 발로 뛰어다녔을 것이다.

02671178.name: 앤티크 석고액자 - 메르세데스
02671178.desc: 엘프 여왕 메르세데스의 초상화가 그려진 액자. 여왕님답게 우아하고 기품이 넘친다.

02671180.name: 자연주의 나무 시계
02671180.desc: 100% 나무로 만든 시계. 배터리는 나무가 아니냐는 딴지는 걸지 말자.

02671181.name: 마크라메 행잉 플렌츠
02671181.desc: 벽에 거는 식물 장식. 약초로 꼭 약만 만드는 것이 아니다. 미적 감각만 있다면, 그 무엇이든 예술 작품이 될 수 있다.

02671182.name: 아치형 창문
02671182.desc: 위가 둥근 아치형 창문. 실내에서 아이템을 분해하면 먼지가 많이 날리니 창문을 항상 열도록 하자. 언제나 환기는 중요하다.

02671183.name: 앤티크 석고액자 - 시그너스
02671183.desc: 여제 시그너스의 초상화가 그려진 액자. 친절하고 온화해 보이는 그녀이지만, 속으론 많은 걱정거리를 안고 있을 것이다. 잘못된 길을 걸으면 안 될 텐데.

02671184.name: 마크라메 커튼 창문
02671184.desc: 분위기 있는 마크라메 커튼이 달린 창문. 은은하게 새어 들어오는 태양 빛이 제법 아름답다.

02671185.name: 행잉 플랜츠
02671185.desc: 벽에 거는 식물 장식. 누군가에겐 이 식물들도 소중한 전리품이나 다름 없겠지.

02671186.name: 파풀라투스 벽시계
02671186.desc: 파풀라투스가 타고 있는 시계를 꼭 빼닮은 벽시계. 그러나 혹시 모른다. 꽤나 정교한 것이, 파풀라투스의 시계가 맞는 걸지도?

02671187.name: 포스터 - 드래곤 마스터
02671187.desc: 드래곤 마스터 에반의 모습이 그려진 포스터. 농부의 아들이 영웅의 후계자가 될 줄 누가 알았을까? 운명이란 건 정말 대단하다.

02671188.name: 크리스탈 샹들리에
02671188.desc: 빛을 받아 반짝거리는 모습이 아름다운 크리스탈 샹들리에다.

02671189.name: 포스터 - 태초의 버섯
02671189.desc: 버섯이 그려진 포스터. 머쉬킹의 말에 따르면 태초의 버섯이라고 하는데, 진위 여부는 알 수 없다. 그림이지만 점프에 대한 열망이 느껴진다.

02671190.name: 포스터 - 꿈을 조종하는 자
02671190.desc: 군단장 루시드의 모습이 그려진 포스터. 머리맡에 붙이고 자면 왠지 모르게 악몽을 꿀 것 같다.

02671191.name: 포스터 - 오, 나의 여제님!
02671191.desc: 각성한 시그너스 여제의 모습이 그려진 포스터. 세계의 운명을 짊어진 그 고난과 걱정은 상상할 수 없을 만큼 괴로울 것이다. 그러다 잘못된 길로 나가면 안 될 텐데.

02671192.name: 포스터 - 아르카나의 정령들
02671192.desc: 아르카나의 귀여운 정령들이 그려진 포스터. 아르카나의 아름다운 풍경도 엿볼 수 있다.

02671194.name: 포스터 - 엘프의 여왕
02671194.desc: 엘프의 여왕 메르세데스가 그려진 포스터. 군단장 루시드가 사모한 존재답게, 멋있고 우아한 자태를 뽐내고 있다.

02671195.name: 포스터 - 우리는 시그너스 기사단
02671195.desc: 시그너스 기사단이 그려진 포스터. 여제를 수호하는 기사들답게 당당하고 강인한 모습을 엿볼 수 있다.

02671197.name: 천연 라탄 접시 장식
02671197.desc: 페리온의 이얀이 한땀한땀 만든 라탄 접시. 다행히도 돼지와 함께 춤을이 장난을 쳐 두진 않았다.

02671198.name: 반반의 태엽시계
02671198.desc: 시간술사 반반의 태엽시계. 시간술사도 시계는 필요하다. 다행히 시간이 갑자기 빨라지거나 거꾸로 흘러가지는 않는다.

02671199.name: 시그너스 인형선반
02671199.desc: 타락한 시그너스와 신수 인형이 올라간 선반. 조작된 미래의 모습이었지만, 항상 조심하는 게 좋을 것 같다.

02671200.name: 칼로스 실링 팬
02671200.desc: 칼로스 드론을 닮은 실링 팬. 다행히 빔은 쏘지 않는다. 만약 빨간색으로 변하면 에너지파를 쏴보자.

02671201.name: 듄켈의 투구 장식
02671201.desc: 친위대장 듄켈의 투구 장식. 투구를 쓰려는 자는 그 무게를 견뎌야 하지만, 장식이기에 그렇게 무겁지 않다.

02671202.name: 신성검 벽걸이 장식
02671202.desc: 신성검 아소르의 외형을 본뜬 벽걸이 장식. 제법 섬세한 디테일 덕에, 선택받지 않은 자도 검에게 선택받은 기분이 들게 한다.

02671203.name: 황금 벽걸이 선반
02671203.desc: 스타들도 빛나기 위한 노력을 한다. 노력의 결과물을 벽걸이 선반에 전시해 보자.

02671204.name: 나무 벽걸이 선반
02671204.desc: 나무로 된 벽걸이 선반. 보여주고 싶은 아이템들을 진열해 둘 수 있다.

02671213.name: Witch's Transformation Mirror
02671213.desc: A mirror containing the spirit of a Halloween-loving ghost child. Apparently they're fond of pulling the occasional prank.

02671218.name: 류드의 검

02672188.desc: This spider looks so surprised! But he's soft and cuddly too.

02672189.name: Soft Snowman Bed
02672189.desc: Don't worry. It's not cold! A soft snowman hugs you in a surprisingly warm embrace.

02672190.name: Eastern Tea Table
02672190.desc: A tea table to share with someone dear. Savor the tea and enjoy a friendly chat.

02672191.name: CAPOO's Cat Tower
02672191.desc: CAPOO likes dungeons, but he likes his cat tower even more.

02672192.name: Peekaboo Ghost Kid Cupboard
02672192.desc: No need to be scared! This ghost just enjoys some practical jokes.

02672193.name: Maplemas Toy Train Table
02672193.desc: It's early morning as the snow softly falls over a sleepy town. The silence is only broken by the chugging of a steam engine driving cars full of hopes and dreams. Where will it deliver to next?

02672195.name: Cathode Ray Tube TV
02672195.desc: Oh to capture a moment in time. How sweet is it to return there at the press of a button.

02672196.name: Maple Computer Desk
02672196.desc: So much magic packed into a box that tiny! There's a whole world in there of adventure and whimsy just waiting to be explored!

02672197.name: Shroom Buddies Comic Cabinet
02672197.desc: A place to safely store erstwhile treasures.

02672200.name: Memory Cabinet
02672200.desc: Is there something that fills you with nostalgia simply at the sight of it?

02672201.name: Respect Personal Preferences Bunk Bed
02672201.desc: Regardless of your preferences, the bed is a most personal space.

02672220.name: 원카드 미니게임 부스
02672220.desc: 메이플 월드의 용사들 사이에서 인기 있는 게임 중 하나인\n#c메이플 원카드#를 드디어 집에서 만나볼 수 있게 되었다!

02672222.name: 달콤한 휴식 데이베드
02672222.desc: 일과 중 달콤한 휴식을 맞이할 수 있게 해 주는 데이베드. 하지만 너무 깊은 잠을 청하지는 말자. 밤에 못 잔다.

02672223.name: 원목 행거
02672223.desc: 나무로 만든 평범한 행거. 의자에 대충 널어놓지 말고, 행거에 걸어 옷이 구겨지지 않도록 하자.

02672224.name: 원목 아일랜드 식탁
02672224.desc: 나무로 만든 평범한 아일랜드 식탁. 음식을 먹고 흘리면 재빠르게 닦도록 하자.

02672225.name: 가스오븐레인지
02672225.desc: 가스레인지와 오븐이 합쳐진 일체형 조리 기구. 자취인들의 필수 아이템이다.

02672226.name: 헤네시스 들꽃 화분
02672226.desc: 헤네시스의 이름 없는 들꽃이 심어진 화분이다. 들꽃이 화분이 되어 만난 것도 인연이니, 정성스럽게 돌보아 주도록 하자.

02672227.name: 패브릭 크림 코너소파
02672227.desc: 산뜻한 크림색의 코너소파. 때가 타면 보기 싫어지니 청소를 깔끔히 하도록 하자.

02672228.name: 패브릭 크림 소파
02672228.desc: 산뜻한 크림색의 소파. 때가 타면 보기 싫어지니 청소를 깔끔히 하도록 하자.

02672229.name: 빨간 버섯 스툴
02672229.desc: 버섯 모양 스툴. 점프대가 아니니, 있는 힘껏 몸으로 푹 눌러앉았다가 실망하지 말자.

02672230.name: 주황버섯 인형
02672230.desc: 평범한 주황버섯 인형. 말랑말랑한 재질로, 와락 끌어안고 있으면 마음이 편안해진다.

02672231.name: 소형 해바라기 화분
02672231.desc: 소형 해바라기 화분. 화분도 소형이고 해바라기도 소형이다. 해바라기의 샛노란 색이 집을 화사하게 만들어주는 것 같다.

02672232.name: 1인용 패브릭 소파
02672232.desc: 평범한 1인용 소파. 때로는 거만한 사장님 자세로 앉아 휴식을 취해보자. 이유 없이 자신감이 차오른다.

02672233.name: 기울어진 원형 테이블
02672233.desc: 살짝 삐그덕거리는 원형 테이블. 수평이 맞지는 않지만, 그 덕에 액체를 올려 두면 소소한 스릴을 느낄 수 있다.

02672234.name: 월넛 데이베드
02672234.desc: 메이플 월드의 험난한 지형을 모두 등반한 당신이여! 이제는 쉬어라. 끝없는 탐구심과 인내심, 끈기를 모두 갖춘 당신은 충분한 자격을 갖추었다!

02672235.name: 미니 철제 금고
02672235.desc:
소중하거나 값비싼 물건을 보관할 수 있는 금고. 튼튼해서 잘 망가지지도 않는다. 그러니 웬만하면 비밀번호를 잊어버리지 말자.

#c배치된 가구를 클릭하여
창고를 이용할 수 있습니다.

02672236.name: Sleepywood Sauna Bathtub
02672236.desc: A replica of the bathtub at the Sleepywood Hotel Sauna. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna.

02672237.name: 오래된 원목 싱글침대
02672237.desc: 세월의 흐름이 느껴지는 원목 침대. 몸을 뒤척일 때마다 삐그덕 소리가 난다. 그래도 무너지진 않으니 걱정하지 말자.

02672238.name: 소형 화분
02672238.desc: 아담한 소형 화분. 크기는 작지만 집 전체를 향긋한 향기로 채울 수 있다.

02672239.name: 산호 어항
02672239.desc: 아쿠아로드 곳곳에 있는 산호를 모아 어항으로 만들었다. 물갈이를 하기 위해 아쿠아리움까지 가야 하는 작은 단점이 있다.

02672240.name: 킹사이즈 고급가죽 침대
02672240.desc: 상점에서 100억 메소 정도를 거뜬히 Flex 하는 사람이라면, 분명 이런 고급 가죽 침대에서 잠이 들 거다. 묘하게 메소의 향이 나는 듯 하다.

02672241.name: Sleepywood Sink
02672241.desc: A replica of the sink at the Sleepywood Hotel. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna.

02672242.name: 단풍나무 분재
02672242.desc: 수많은 인고의 시간 끝에 자라난 한 단풍나무의 분재. 인내의 숲 속 두 뿌리 홍삼을 손에 넣은 자만이 이 분재를 가꿀 자격을 가진다.

02672243.name: 혼테일 분수
02672243.desc: 사악한 삼두룡 혼테일의 외형을 딴 분수. 압도적으로 강한 용사와 마주쳐 순식간에 굳어버린 것 같기도 하다.

02672245.name: 힐라 오벨리스크 스탠드
02672245.desc: 힐라의 오벨리스크를 본뜬 스탠드. 어디서 언데드 몬스터가 나타날 것만 같다.

02672246.name: 로코코 천연 가죽침대
02672246.desc: 섬세한 감성을 가진 사람들을 위한 가죽침대. 편안하고 안락하다. 누워있기만 해도 감성이 충만해진다.

02672247.name: 로코코 1인용 소가죽 소파
02672247.desc: 반짝반짝 빛나는 스타를 위한 소가죽 소파. 단 한 명의 스타를 위한 고급 의자라 특별함이 느껴진다.

02672248.name: 로코코 소가죽 코너소파
02672248.desc: 수많은 스타들을 탄생시킨 전설적인 엔터테이너가 즐겨 썼다던 코너소파. 역시 소가죽이라 그런지 느낌이 다르다.

02672249.name: 오크나무 테이블
02672249.desc: 사서 위즈가 좋아하는 오크나무로 제작한 테이블. 은은한 피톤치드가 편안함을 가져다준다.

02672250.name: 앤티크 대리석 벽난로
02672250.desc: 불꽃늑대처럼 뜨겁게 타오르는 불꽃을 품은 벽난로. 영원히 꺼지지 않을 것만 같다.

02672251.name: 오크나무 책상
02672251.desc: 사서 위즈가 좋아하는 오크나무로 제작한 책상. 은은한 피톤치드가 집중력을 향상시켜 준다. 하지만 그래도 일은 하기 싫은걸.

02672252.name: 오크나무 3단 책장
02672252.desc: 탄소 연대 측정 결과 엄청난 세월을 살아온 것 같다는 책장. 책장에게 나이를 물어봐도 대답을 해 주진 않으니 믿거나 말거나다.

02672254.name: 에스닉 해먹 침대
02672254.desc: 전설적인 요리사가 엄청난 수의 대량 주문을 성공적으로 마치고 편히 잠들었다는 침대.

02672255.name: 에스닉 패턴 패브릭 소파
02672255.desc: 전설적인 요리사가 엄청난 수의 대량 주문을 성공적으로 마치고 편히 쉬었다는 소파.

02672256.name: 천연 라탄 체어
02672256.desc: 전 세계에 명성을 드높인 자만이 앉을 수 있다는 의자. 고급스런 라탄의 질감이 편안하고 안락한 느낌을 준다.

02672257.name: 테이블 가든
02672257.desc: 약초들을 수없이 캐어 이제 테이블 데코까지 하게 되었다. 몸이 건강해지는 향기가 난다.

02672258.name: 페리온 토템 장식
02672258.desc: 페리온의 명물인 토템 장식. 왜인지는 모르지만, 눈빛이 우리를 지켜주겠다는 게 아니라, 살려달라고 말하는 듯하다.

02672259.name: 발록의 뿔 의자
02672259.desc: 마왕 발록의 뿔이 장식된 의자. 삐딱한 자세로 앉아 있으면 정말 메이플 월드의 마왕이 된 느낌이 든다.

02672260.name: 자쿰의 손 테이블
02672260.desc: 당장이라도 무언가를 움켜쥘 것만 같은 자쿰의 손 테이블. 하지만 걱정하지 말자. 움직이지는 않는다. 아마도.

02672261.name: 매그너스의 뿔 의자
02672261.desc: 한 배신자가 떠오르는 디자인의 의자. 여기 앉는다고 운석을 막 뿌리거나 하지는 못한다. 하지만 배신자의 왕 기분은 낼 수 있다.

02672262.name: 카웅 청소기
02672262.desc: 외계의 기술력으로 만들었다는 카웅 청소기. 그런 것 치곤 사람의 말을 잘 알아듣는다. 가끔 안에 누군가가 타고 있는 듯한 착각을 일으키기도 한다.

02672263.name: 피에르 우산꽂이
02672263.desc: 피에르의 파티장에 놓여있던 우산꽂이. 우산이라는 것이 늘 그렇듯 주인이 있다가도 없다. 피에르는 세 모습이 한 몸이니 있다가도 없는 게 맞긴 하다.

02672264.name: 블러디퀸 화장대
02672264.desc: 루타비스의 블러디퀸이 사용했다는 화장대. 거울 속을 들여다보면 거울 속의 누군가가 나를 들여다보는 꺼림직한 기분이 든다.

02672265.name: 벨룸 용암욕조
02672265.desc: 루타비스의 벨룸이 연상되는 디자인의 욕조. 용암처럼 보이는 불에 겁먹지 말자. 겉모습만 그렇다.

02672266.name: 버섯 플로어 스탠드
02672266.desc: 집보다는 스탠드가 되고자 한 굳센 의지가 이 주황버섯을 스탠드로 만들었다. 영롱하게 빛나는 이 버섯을 축하해 주자.

02672267.name: 아쿠아리움 산호 스탠드
02672267.desc: 아쿠아리움 동물원의 산호 조명과 같은 산호 스탠드. 뮤즈가 직접 만든 축소판 스탠드다.

02672268.name: 마네킹
02672268.desc: 마음대로 꾸밀 수 있는 마네킹이다. 개성을 살려 멋있게 꾸밀 수 있다.

02672269.name: 얼어붙은 사자상
02672269.desc: 사자 왕의 조각상. 마음뿐만 아니라 겉모습까지 얼어붙어 버렸다. 발치의 장미는 왜인지 모르게 슬퍼하는 것 같다.

02672270.name: 오르카 토끼 인형 쿠션
02672270.desc: 거대한 토끼 인형 쿠션. 양옆에는 스우와 오르카 쿠션도 함께 있다. 이 쌍둥이는 어딜 가든 항상 함께라더니, 여기서까지 같이 있다.

02672271.name: 아카이럼 석상
02672271.desc: 아카이럼의 상징인 뱀 석상. 날카로운 뱀 눈초리로 날 노려보고 있다. 다행히 이계의 사제는 소환되지 않는다. 하지만 혹시 모르니 잘 관리하도록 하자.

02672272.name: 핑크빈 소파
02672272.desc: 핑크빈을 잘 아는 자만이 앉을 수 있다는 전설의 분홍 콩 의자. 핑크빈의 배만큼이나 푹신푹신하다.

02672273.name: 루시드 침대
02672273.desc: 군단장 루시드가 잠을 청한다는 침대. 이게 여기 있으면 루시드는 대체 어디서 자는 거지?

02672274.name: 윌의 거미줄 해먹의자
02672274.desc: 윌의 거미줄로 만든 해먹 의자. 닿아도 스킬봉인이 걸리진 않으니 마음껏 쉬도록 하자.

02672275.name: 데미안의 검
02672275.desc: 군단장 데미안의 파멸의 검. 가까이 다가가면 알 수 없는 속삭임이 들린다. 홀리지 않도록 조심하자.

02672276.name: 가디언 엔젤 슬라임 분수
02672276.desc: 가디언 엔젤 슬라임의 모습을 딴 분수. 어떤 원리인지는 모르지만, 라무라무의 온천수가 흘러나온다. 역시 귀엽다.

02672277.name: 더스크 암흑 빈백
02672277.desc: 거대 괴수 더스크의 환각을 빼닮은 빈백. 닿아도 상태 이상에 걸리지 않으니 마음껏 기대도록 하자.

02672278.name: 영혼이 타오르는 양초
02672278.desc: 욕망의 제단에 놓인 영혼이 타오르는 양초. 꺼지지 않도록 조심스럽게 대하자.

02672279.name: 검은 마법사의 거울
02672279.desc: 검붉은 오라를 품기는 검은 마법사의 거울. 그는 여기서 무엇을 보았던 것일까?

02672280.name: 나무 진열장
02672280.desc: 나무로 된 진열장. 보여주고 싶은 아이템들을 진열해 둘 수 있다.

02672281.name: Ribbon Piggy Bank
02672281.desc: Contains pocket change gathered over untold hours of hunting. You've collected a whole 10 billion!\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

02672282.name: Golden Display Case
02672282.desc: A display case for a star who shines brighter than all others. Display your items with pride.

02672283.name: Ritzy Mannequin
02672283.desc: A ritzy mannequin with an even fancier platform. Style it to your liking.

02672284.name: Pitched Display Case
02672284.desc: Perfect for displaying the Pitched Boss set.

02672285.name: Henesys Stall
02672285.desc: A kiosk you can buy from. Don't forget to get your seller's permit from Chief Stan.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the General Store.

02672286.name: Potion Station
02672286.desc: Truly, you can never have too many potions.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the General Store.

02672287.name: Mushroom Refrigerator
02672287.desc: A refrigerator modeled after an Orange Mushroom. Not a refrigerator meant for cooling mushrooms or a refrigerator made out of mushroom, in case you were confused.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the General Store.

02672288.name: Slime Storage
02672288.desc: Contains pocket change gathered over untold hours of hunting. You've collected a whole 100 million!\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

02672289.name: Purple Safe
02672289.desc: Contains pocket change gathered over untold hours of hunting. You've collected a whole 100 billion!\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

02672300.name: Comfy Teddy Bear
02672300.desc: A huge teddy bear that's always ready to welcome you home with a big hug after a hard day.

02672301.name: Sweet Three-Tier Cake
02672301.desc: A beautiful cake made with great care. Its three layers represent joy, love, and hope.

02672302.name: Jumbo Junior Yeti Doll
02672302.desc: It's a little big for a for something called a 'Jr.' Yeti, but who cares, it's cute.

02672313.name: Warrior Armor Decoration
02672313.desc: Armor worn by a warrior of the Anegasaki clan. It's ornamented with the image of a crescent moon.

02672314.name: Sword Training Dummy
02672314.desc: A training dummy made to practice your swordsmanship. Just be careful that you don't get too into your training and attack the rest of the furniture.

02672315.name: Spirit Walker Rack
02672315.desc: Kanna's favorite Spirit Walker outfit is hanging on this rack.

02672316.name: Sengoku Warriors Arch Shelf
02672316.desc: An arch shelf displaying the Sengoku Warriors' prized possessions.

02672317.name: Traditional Kotatsu
02672317.desc: With a kotatsu, mandarin, and hot tea, the winter's chill can't touch you.

02672318.name: Twentoona's Aquarium
02672318.desc: Despite what this aquarium would have you believe, Twentoona can actually survive outside of water!

02672319.name: Twenteena's Treasure
02672319.desc: What do you suppose Twenteena was looking at through that telescope?

02672320.name: Planet Twent Chair
02672320.desc: Brings a bit of out-of-this-world flavor to your home.

02672321.name: Planet Twent Exercise Ball
02672321.desc: Got to stay fit for intergalactic travel! Say, is it just me or does this ball resemble a certain bean?

02672322.name: Mesotron-S Liquid Nitrogen Fridge
02672322.desc: #c[Night Troupe Limited Edition]#\nA #cMesotron-S Liquid Nitrogen Fridge# modeled after the mech's top of the line cooling system. There's nothing it can't freeze!

02672323.name: Night Troupe Bed
02672323.desc: #c[Night Troupe Limited Edition]#\nA bed built to Spiegelmann's special design and full of magic to bring you happy dreams!

02672324.name: [One-Punch Man] TV
02672324.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02672325.name: [One-Punch Man] Table
02672325.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02672326.name: One Card Deck
02672326.desc: A giant One Card deck. Be careful sitting on it; the cards can still move independently!

02672327.name: Sleepywood Sauna Bathtub
02672327.desc: A replica of the bathtub at the Sleepywood Hotel Sauna. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna.

02672328.name: Sleepywood Foot Bath
02672328.desc: A replica of the foot bath at the Sleepywood Hotel Sauna. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna. And, even better, it can be enjoyed with a friend.

02672329.name: Luxe Sauna Cafe
02672329.desc: A home cafe set for the Sleepywood Sauna's Luxe Sauna. Enjoy the cold, sweet satisfaction of a sauna drink from the comfort of your home. You can even share them with guests.

02672335.name: Pink Bean Stan Gull
02672335.desc: A seagull that likes Pink Bean too much. What does that bird even want with it?

02672337.name: Dorm Bed
02672337.desc: A bed with the miraculous ability to lull you to sleep no matter how much homework you still haven't gotten done.

02672338.name: Lecture Hall Seat
02672338.desc: It's a chair and a desk. Yet, it fails at being particularly good at either function.

02672339.name: Monster Translator
02672339.desc: Supposedly monsters gather around to swap info on their favorite foods.

02672340.name: Lecture Hall Podium
02672340.desc: One can hope it was shoddily made so it can collapse and end the lecture early.

02672341.name: Mini Slime Recycling Bin
02672341.desc: If you stare long enough, it seems to move around somehow. Don't worry, it's not real though. But it will eat you if you don't separate your recyclables. Don't test it.

02672345.name: Dark Sea Model Temple
02672345.desc: A glass display that recreates the Temple of the Radiant Star. Legends tell of a shining goddess who dwells there, luring the sailors of the Dark Sea with her siren song...yet, the music always ends in screams. Click on the furniture to change the appearance of the temple.

02672348.name: Kazax Statue
02672348.desc: A marble statue that... Wait, did it just move?

02672349.name: Large Libae Doll
02672349.desc: A doll of Libae that could lull anyone holding it to a peaceful sleep.

02672350.name: Inkwell Cushion
02672350.desc: A cushion with super squishy cheeks.

02672352.name: Life Core
02672352.desc: An anomaly capable of making the partial whole--of creating life.

02672353.name: Unsanctioned Creation
02672353.desc: There are things prohibited by natural law for very good reason.

02672357.name: Magical Safe
02672357.desc: A safe befitting of Lethe's manor. Rest easy knowing your precious items are locked up safe as can be. However, it doesn't seem like it can be used.

02676000.name: Dorm Window
02676000.desc: An ordinary window adorned with a cute Rock Spirit decoration. Be careful not to knock it off when opening the window.

02676001.name: Dorm Calendar
02676001.desc: A study plan is written on it. Will this plan be followed? Absolutely not. But hey, it's the thought that counts.

02676002.name: Jacket Hook
02676002.desc: A whole hook just for your jacket? That's some dedication.

02676003.name: Dorm Wall Display Case
02676003.desc: A storage unit akin to a pea pod with a Pink Bean squeezed into the bottom cubby.

02676004.name: Lecture Hall Window
02676004.desc: An ordinary window. Reminder: Do not use this as an escape hatch from a boring class--unless you're on the first floor.

02676005.name: Lecture Hall Chalkboard
02676005.desc: An ordinary chalkboard. The second your attention strays from it, it will be filled with formulas beyond your comprehension.

02676006.name: Lecture Hall Full Bulletin Board
02676006.desc: A bulletin board filled with helpful information about Maple University.

02676007.name: Lecture Hall Sparse Bulletin Board
02676007.desc: A bulletin board slightly less filled with helpful information about Maple University.

02676008.name: Silver Dimensional Power Plaque
02676008.desc: An award given to those who displayed great feats in climbing the Dimensional Tower. Even if you've fallen behind, your endurance will shine through.

02676009.name: Gold Dimensional Power Plaque
02676009.desc: An award given to those who displayed great feats in climbing the Dimensional Tower. Hard work is good as gold.

02676010.name: Diamond Dimensional Power Plaque
02676010.desc: An award given to those who displayed great feats in climbing the Dimensional Tower. It sparkles almost as much as you.

02676011.name: Maple U Pink Bean Tapestry
02676011.desc: A reproduction of the tapestries hung around campus. Unfortunately, you can't hang it from a balloon.

02676013.name: Maple U Stringed Pennants
02676013.desc: Several pendants strung together, featuring iconic monsters.

02676014.name: Teddy Window
02676014.desc: A window decorated with Pink Teddy's giant yellow bow.

02676015.name: Sovereign's Arms
02676015.desc: An award given to the ultimate sovereign. The hammers come off in case you want to have an impromptu match.

02676016.name: Lucid's Dreamcatcher
02676016.desc: A charm that Lucid made to ward off nightmares. Supposedly, if you hang it over your bed, no bad dreams can trouble your sleep.

02676018.name: Wanderer's Hanging Scroll
02676018.desc: An eye-catching scroll featuring...is that the person from the wanted poster? No... Not blobby enough.

02676019.name: Sword Mount
02676019.desc: A place to keep your sword. Pose with it and say something cool for a quick confidence boost.

02676020.name: Anima Window
02676020.desc: A charming Anima-style window. It's all in the ears.

02676021.name: Anima Lantern
02676021.desc: A tranquil lantern that makes you think of spring. Don't worry, the petals dissolve so you don't need to sweep up after it.

02676022.name: CW Season 2 Challenger
02676022.desc: An award presented to those who reached #cChallenger tier in Challenger World Season 2#. It is a symbol of true courage and willpower.

02676023.name: Nightmarish Curtained Window
02676023.desc: Limbo is peeking into the house through your window. When the abyss looks back at you... It's time to play peek-a-boo!

02676024.name: Autographed Angelic Buster Poster
02676024.desc: A poster autographed by everyone's favorite idol, Angelic Buster. Even in poster form, her charisma draws all eyes to her.

02676025.name: New Leaf Mall Neon Sign
02676025.desc: A neon sign that once hung in New Leaf Mall's coolest record store. Now it can bring those same vibes straight to your home.

02676026.name: Maple World Map
02676026.desc:
A wall map showing the regions of Maple World drawn in miniature.
 It's the product of the efforts of countless explorers, and gazing at it is enough to reignite your sense of adventure. Where to next?

02676027.name: NLM Yeti Wall Art
02676027.desc: A neon Yeti sign that took up a whole wall of the New Leaf Mall. If you stare at it for long enough, you start to get the feeling that you can one-shot that boss you were struggling with. You can change the color of the neon sign by touching it.

02676028.name: [One-Punch Man] Wall AC Unit
02676028.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02676029.name: [One-Punch Man] Fluorescent Light
02676029.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02676030.name: [One-Punch Man] Saitama Poster
02676030.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02676031.name: [One-Punch Man] Saitama and Genos Poster
02676031.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02676032.name: [One-Punch Man] Terrible Tornado Poster
02676032.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02676033.name: Collectible Card Frame (Mini)
02676033.desc: Furniture that can display your MapleStory Collectible Cards.

02676034.name: Collectible Card Frame (Large)
02676034.desc: Furniture that can display your MapleStory Collectible Cards.

02676035.name: Crown Poster
02676035.desc: A glimmering poster celebrating the Crown update.

02676036.name: CW Season 3 - Challenger
02676036.desc: An award presented to those who reached #cChallenger tier in Challenger World Season 3#. It is a symbol of true courage and willpower.

02676037.name: Malefic Star Scroll
02676037.desc: A scroll bearing the likeness of the Malefic Star. The longer you gaze into her fathomless eyes, the greater your desire to sink into the depthless sea.

02676038.name: World's Best Hero of Season 4
02676038.desc: An award given to the #cnumber one# Hero who proved themselves the strongest in #cWorld's Best Punch King Season 4#. Hang this award on your wall to let it be known that your were on top.

02676039.desc: An award given to the #cnumber one# Paladin who proved themselves the strongest in #cWorld's Best Punch King Season 4#. Hang this award on your wall to let it be known that your were on top.

02676084.desc: An award given to the #cnumber one# Ren who proved themselves the strongest in #cWorld's Best Punch King Season 4#. Hang this award on your wall to let it be known that your were on top.

02676085.name: Priest's Medallion
02676085.desc: A symbol of the Mitra Order usually worn by prients of Cernium. These medallions, made with care, have been used in ceremonies for many years, so they're now common in the holy land of Cernium.

02676086.name: CW Season 4 - Challenger
02676086.desc: An award presented to those who reached #cChallenger tier in Challenger World Season 4#. It is a symbol of true courage and willpower.

02676087.name: CW Season 4 - Super Challenger
02676087.desc: An award presented to those who reached #cSuper Challenger tier in Challenger World Season 4#. It is a symbol of unending courage and the willpower to overcome any challenge.

02676088.name: Overdrive Poster
02676088.desc: A glimmering poster celebrating the Overdrive update.

02677000.name: Dorm Desk
02677000.desc: A small desk that magically sidetracks you from homework to anything else.

02677001.name: Dorm Bed
02677001.desc: A bed with the miraculous ability to lull you to sleep no matter how much homework you still haven't gotten done.

02677002.name: Potted Bloom
02677002.desc: It's a flower in a pot. A potted flower. A potted bloom, even.

02677003.name: Potted Sprout
02677003.desc: Somehow it's always looked like a sprout. Will it ever grow up?

02677004.name: Dorm Bedside Table
02677004.desc: The perfect place to put an alarm clock that you'll snooze every five minutes for hours on end.

02677005.name: Dorm Bookcase
02677005.desc: Full of books you'll definitely get around to reading, for sure.

02677006.name: Dorm Coat Tree
02677006.desc: Despite being purpose-made to hold coats, it often loses out to whatever chair is nearest the door.

02677007.name: Lecture Hall Seat
02677007.desc: It's a chair and a desk. Yet, it fails at being particularly good at either function.

02677008.name: Lecture Hall Podium
02677008.desc: One can hope it was shoddily made so it can collapse and end the lecture early.

02677010.name: Well-Loved Cat Tower
02677010.desc: Where cats hang out when they're tired of the cardboard box.

02677012.name: Textbook Stack
02677012.desc: A bunch of books about the science of jumping. How are there so many words to explain jumping?

02677013.name: University Lockers
02677013.desc: Lockers that open via a student ID card. Back in the day, they had passcodes like 0000 or 1234. Don't follow their example; those are horrible passwords.

02677014.name: Mini Slime Recycling Bin
02677014.desc: If you stare long enough, it seems to move around somehow. Don't worry, it's not real though. But it will eat you if you don't separate your recyclables. Don't test it.

02677015.name: Maple Leaf Mood Lamp
02677015.desc: The maple leaf (definitely not a star) emits a comforting golden glow.

02677016.name: Monster Translator
02677016.desc: Supposedly monsters gather around to swap info on their favorite foods.

02677017.name: The Thinking Yeti
02677017.desc: It's thinking pretty hard there, but is it actually making any progress?

02677018.name: Comfy Yut Sofa
02677018.desc: A supremely plush sofa awarded to masters of the Game of Yut. Don't be afraid to take your bad-roll induced anger on it. It can take it.

02677019.name: Pink Bean Racekart Bed
02677019.desc: When you've got to feel the thrill of the road, but also need your eight hours.

02677020.name: Legendary Holographic Throne
02677020.desc: The real legend has returned! The legendary throne that only the legend of legends can sit in, legendarily.

02677021.name: Plum Blossom Bonsai
02677021.desc: The red plum blossoms bring a welcome pop of color to your home. If you're lucky, it might sprout some plums in the summer.

02677022.name: Anima Folding Screen
02677022.desc: A folding screen with red plum blossoms trees on it. Seeing it out of the corner of your eye, it nearly looks like a real landscape.

02677023.name: Anima Cushion
02677023.desc: A cushion with a common Anima symbol on it. Oddly, it smells of fresh-cut grass.

02677024.name: Stray Puppy
02677024.desc: That's a big puppy! It's a hungry one and needs to be kept warm, so you better take good care of it.

02677025.name: Mother-of-Pearl Wardrobe
02677025.desc: A stunning wardrobe that exudes modern elegance. Shame it just holds shirts and stuff.

02677026.name: Traditional Tea Set
02677026.desc: A naturalistic place to enjoy tea alone or with company.

02677027.name: Let's Get Stacking! Mini-Game Cabinet
02677027.desc: Used to play the #cLet's Get Stacking!# Mini-Game. They say you could stack higher if it weren't for building codes.

02677028.name: Game of Yut Board
02677028.desc: Game of Yut, a folk game with a long tradition. Pssst. Hey. There is a secret strategy you can try. If you're about to lose, flip the board. You opponent will be mad, but your scorecard will be no worse for wear.

02677029.name: Wolf Dog Statue
02677029.desc: Just like the one they have in Evernia. Careful though, this one bites!

02677030.name: Evernia Display Case
02677030.desc: A display case resembling the merchant stalls they have in Evernia. Better keep an eye on it, or someone may try to buy your stuff!

02677031.name: Limited Display Case
02677031.desc: A furnishing commemorating the 1st Limited Label item.

02677032.name: Kaling Canopy Bed
02677032.desc: A canopy bed modeled after Kaling's style. You can't quite say why, but you feel as if sleeping here will transform you into an exhausted grad student. Could a grad student afford a canopy bed? Let's not ask hurtful questions.

02677033.name: Specter's Clutch Chair
02677033.desc: A chair in the shape of a giant Specter hand. It looks real enough to reach out and grab you, but that hasn't happened...yet.

02677034.name: Mini Sleipnir
02677034.desc: A wooden rocking horse modeled after Baldrix's Sleipnir. Don't repeat this, but someone said that Baldrix used to ride it as a child. Apparently, old habits die hard...

02677035.name: Weapon Mount
02677035.desc: A rack that holds legendary weapons used by some ancient warrior. When you touch it, a brilliant light shines forth. Ages may pass, but a truly noble spirit can endure.

02677036.name: Netherworld Display Case
02677036.desc: A display case modeled after some ancient warrior's forgotten battleground. You can use it to display items that remind you of your adventures.

02677037.name: Maple Desk Calendar
02677037.desc: A desk calendar with a drawing of a cute slime. Its cheerful, slimy face seems to urge you to treat every single day as a gift. Or at least to remember your appointments.

02677038.name: Nodestone Popcorn Maker
02677038.desc: Once you've used so many Nodestones that you've reached the very top, what should you do with them? Make them into popcorn, of course! Chowing down on a handful of these rock-hard kernels is the ultimate flex.

02677039.name: Nodestone Bean Bag
02677039.desc: The craftsman that used to make Nodestones has gotten a bit bored and started a side project. The result: this Nodestone-shaped bean bag! Before you rip the seams open, though, it's not full of Nodestones, just ordinary beans.

02677040.name: Experience Nodestone Bean Bag
02677040.desc: The craftsman that used to make Nodestones has gotten a bit bored and started a side project. The result: this Experience Nodestone-shaped bean bag! Before you rip the seams open, though, it's not full of Experience Nodestones, just ordinary beans.

02677041.name: Mirror World Nodestone Bean Bag
02677041.desc: After collecting all of Mirror World's Nodestones, you've finally gotten the ultimate collector's item: a bean bag shaped to look like them. Now everyone will know that you're the biggest Mirror World Nodestone fan there is.

02677042.name: Mitra's Nodestone Bean Bag
02677042.desc: After collecting all of Mitra's Nodestones, you've finally gotten the ultimate collector's item: a bean bag shaped to look like them. Now everyone will know that you're the biggest Mitra Nodestone fan there is.

02677043.name: Bright Treasure Chest
02677043.desc: An incredibly rare Legendary Diamond Treasure Box which shines with five colors and sparkles brilliantly. Sure to make all the other treasure hunters incredibly jealous.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

02677044.name: Mini Circulator
02677044.desc: A small, white circulator. It was supposedly a made to be a souvenir for people who used circulators for Ability Reset...but isn't that pun a bit of a stretch? Don't count on it to cool down your room--it's not a fan.

02677045.name: Display Case
02677045.desc: A fancy display case to display your most precious items. You are putting your treasures in a literal spotlight, so be sure you get a good lock, too.

02677046.name: King Size Luxury Golden Bed
02677046.desc: A luxury golden bed for people who shine with the light of countless stars. It gives off a golden luster as majestic as its owner. You'll shine even brighter if you're with someone special.

02677047.name: Sleepywood Foot Bath
02677047.desc: A replica of the foot bath at the Sleepywood Hotel Sauna. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna. And, even better, it can be enjoyed with a friend.

02677048.name: Roboserver Pink Bean
02677048.desc: This roboserver from the New Leaf Mall seems to have followed you home. Something about it makes you a bit nervous...

02677049.name: New Leaf Mall Bean Bag
02677049.desc: A bean bag from New Leaf Mall. It looks like Rock Spirit, but don't worry, it's not full of rocks. It's actually quite comfy.

02677050.name: New Leaf Mall Sofa
02677050.desc: A sofa from New Leaf Mall. When you sit on it, it's as warm as soft as a hug from a Yeti.

02677051.name: New Leaf Mall PC
02677051.desc: The best gaming setup you can find in New Leaf Mall--a monitor with Pink Bean's horns, a top-of-the-line desktop, and an ergonomic gaming chair. You could probably sit here all day.\r\n

02677052.name: Autumn Lights Display Case
02677052.desc: A kiosk that can display your favorite things with the scent of crisp autumn leaves. You can display items that aren't clothes or accessories, whether or not Camila approves.

02677053.name: Jaguar on Break
02677053.desc: Do jaguars like sitting in boxes as much as cats do? Who knows, but wouldn't it be cute if they did?\r\n

02677054.name: [One-Punch Man] Book and Comic Pile
02677054.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677055.name: [One-Punch Man] TV
02677055.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677056.name: [One-Punch Man] Table
02677056.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677057.name: [One-Punch Man] Alarm Clock
02677057.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677058.name: [One-Punch Man] Mattress
02677058.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677059.name: [One-Punch Man] Small Bookcase
02677059.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677060.name: [One-Punch Man] Open Window
02677060.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677061.name: [One-Punch Man] Closed Window
02677061.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677062.name: [One-Punch Man] Desk and Chair
02677062.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677063.name: [One-Punch Man] Microwave
02677063.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677064.name: [One-Punch Man] Watering Can
02677064.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677065.name: [One-Punch Man] Rice Cooker
02677065.desc: MapleStory x One-Punch Man collaboration furnishing.

02677066.name: Fishbowl
02677066.desc: A fishbowl containing a gold fish.\r\nBut does that mean it's a goldfish...?

02677067.name: Collectible Card Binder
02677067.desc: Furniture you can use to view your MapleStory Collectible Cards.

02677068.name: Luxe Sauna Cafe
02677068.desc: A home cafe set for the Sleepywood Sauna's Luxe Sauna. Enjoy the cold, sweet satisfaction of a sauna drink from the comfort of your home. You can even share them with guests.

02677069.name: Knight Statue
02677069.desc: A statue carved in the likeness of a knight chess piece, highly-sought after by first-time homeowners as a symbol of protection. It keeps a watchful eye on any visitors...though experienced burglars know that they can distract it with a nice marble carving of a carrot.

02677070.name: Tallahart-Style Brazier
02677070.desc: A Tallahart-style brazier that shines with the ancient city's unique charm.\nDon't get lost in its glow, or you'll be the one who gets burned.

02677071.name: Phantasmal Tree
02677071.desc: A Phantasmal Tree, sprouted from the glory and the ruin of Tallahart.\nYou need only place a hand upon its bark to see echoes of the ancient past.

02677072.name: Dark Sea Model Temple
02677072.desc: A glass display that recreates the Temple of the Radiant Star. Legends tell of a shining goddess who dwells there, luring the sailors of the Dark Sea with her siren song...yet, the music always ends in screams. Click on the furniture to change the appearance of the temple.

02677073.name: Ellanos
02677073.desc: Ellanos, the mystical creature born of the phantasms of Tallahart, seems to have...grown used to indoor heating and regular meals? Ellanos seems perfectly content to lounge around now. Just make sure to sweep up its less-than-phantasmic fur.

02677074.name: 진과 함께한 추억
02677074.desc: 진이 주사위를 던지는 순간을 그대로 본뜬 가구. 왠지 자꾸만 눈길이 간다. 가구를 클릭 시 진이 주사위를 던지는 모습을 볼 수 있다.

02677075.name: Well-Loved Athena Pierce Doll
02677075.desc: An Athena Pierce doll that has been held so much the stuffing is bursting from the seams in several places. As worn as it is, the fabric is soft and comforting.

02677076.name: Mercedes Pillow
02677076.desc: A limited-edition pillow decorated with art of Mercedes, Ruler of the Elves. Only a few were ever made, so it's highly-prized among fans.

02677077.name: Giant Mushroom Garden Pool
02677077.desc: A glass bowl decorated to look like Seokchon Lake, including, for some reason, a reproduction of the monster summoning magic. The Giant Mushroom always shows up first and gets stuck, so even if it might flood the house a bit, there's no chance of a flood of monsters.

02677078.name: Teddy Bear
02677078.desc: The kindly old Magne of Cernium asked you to find this cute plush. Apparently, Magne's granddaughter loves it.

02677079.name: Scorched Scripture
02677079.desc: A common book of scripture from Cernium. While the library burned around it, reduced mostly to ash, this book itself is only lightly singed. Is that a real miracle?

02677080.name: Operation Ultima Hologram
02677080.desc: Crafted in the image of the forward operating base's command center, now you can relive the excitement of Operation Ultima from your very own base.

02677081.name: Magic Fireplace
02677081.desc: A fireplace befitting of Lethe's mansion. The magical flame burning in the heart warms the soul itself.

02677082.name: Antique Bed
02677082.desc: A bed befitting of Lethe's mansion. Enjoy resting in the lap of luxury.

02677083.name: Magical Safe
02677083.desc: A safe befitting of Lethe's mansion. Rest easy knowing your precious items are locked up safe as can be.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

02680000.name: Slash Blast
02680000.desc: Attack nearby enemies all at once.

02680001.name: Energy Bolt
02680001.desc: Fires a condensed energy bolt that explodes on contact with an enemy.

02680003.name: Lucky Sevens
02680003.desc: Throws 2 lucky Throwing Stars in a row at the target.

02680004.name: Somersault Kick
02680004.desc: A devastating kick that accompanies a backward somersault. Attacks all enemies in the vicinity.

02680005.name: Combat Orders
02680005.desc: Temporarily increases the skill level of all Expedition allies except for the Expedition Captain. \nSome special skills are an exception and the skill level will not be increased.

02680006.name: Advanced Blessing
02680006.desc: Greatly enhances Attack Power of the Expedition allies for a short time.

02680007.name: Holy Symbol
02680007.desc: Temporarily allows all Expedition allies to gain additional EXP while hunting.

02680008.name: Sharp Eyes
02680008.desc: Temporarily grants Expedition allies the ability to locate an enemy's weakness to deal critical damage to that enemy.

02680009.name: Haste
02680009.desc: Greatly enhances Speed of the Expedition allies for a short time.

02680010.name: Speed Infusion
02680010.desc: Increases Attack Speed of Expedition Allies by 2 for a short time.

02680011.name: Time Leap
02680011.desc: Resets the skill cooldown for you and your expedition allies.\nDoes not reset the cooldown of Time Leap and some other skills.

02680012.name: Warrior Mastery
02680012.desc: Trains up your warrior basics to increase Speed.

02680014.name: Cry Valhalla
02680014.desc: Calls upon the power of the ancients to defend you.

02680015.name: Dark Thirst
02680015.desc: Channels your inner vampire to increase Attack Power.

02680017.name: Raging Blow - Spread
02680017.desc: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Raging Blow.

02680020.name: Heaven's Hammer - Extra Strike
02680020.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Heaven's Hammer.

02680021.name: Heaven's Hammer - Cooldown Cutter
02680021.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Heaven's Hammer.

02680022.name: Raging Blow
02680022.desc: Deals consecutive blows to multiple enemies in front of you.

02680023.name: Heaven's Hammer
02680023.desc: Slams a large hammer into the ground, dealing damage to multiple enemies.

02680024.name: Brandish
02680024.desc: Performs a double attack on enemies in front of you.

02680025.name: Spear Sweep
02680025.desc: Swings your spear to pull in enemies and stun them.

02680026.name: Intrepid Slash
02680026.desc: Deals 3 consecutive attacks on multiple enemies in front of you.

02680027.name: Dark Impale
02680027.desc: Launches consecutive rapid attacks on multiple enemies.

02680028.name: Rising Rage
02680028.desc: Suppresses your inner rage into a powerful energy sphere.

02680029.name: Smite Shield
02680029.desc: Summons a shield imbued with immortal strength to strike down nearby enemies.

02680030.name: Nightshade Explosion
02680030.desc: Releases your inner power to lay waste to nearby enemies.

02680031.name: Flame Orb
02680031.desc: Creates and throws a burning orb at multiple enemies.

02680032.name: Cold Beam
02680032.desc: Drops sharp ice shards on enemies to deal damage.

02680033.name: Thunder Bolt
02680033.desc: Creates a powerful magnetic field that fires down lightning bolts on up to 6 enemies.

02680034.name: Holy Arrow
02680034.desc: Fires a Holy Arrow at multiple enemies.

02680035.name: Explosion
02680035.desc: Creates a fire explosion near you that hits nearby enemies.

02680036.name: Ice Strike
02680036.desc: Creates an ice explosion around you that damages nearby enemies.

02680037.name: Shining Ray
02680037.desc: Damages enemies using a ray of holy light.

02680038.name: Flame Sweep
02680038.desc: Sweeps the area in front of you with a powerful flame.

02680039.name: Meteor Shower
02680039.desc: Summons meteorites from the sky to inflict intense fire damage against multiple enemies

02680040.name: Blizzard
02680040.desc: Summons spears of ice from the sky, showering multiple enemies in a nasty blizzard to freeze them.

02680041.name: Genesis
02680041.desc: A holy ray of light shines down from the sky, burning up to 15 monsters at once.

02680042.name: Angel Ray
02680042.desc: Attacks with a holy arrow, dealing tremendous holy damage

02680043.name: Spell Mastery
02680043.desc: Increases Magic Mastery and Attack Power.

02680044.name: Infinity
02680044.desc: Increases the damage of all Magic Attacks for a short time.

02680047.name: Wind Arrow
02680047.desc: Fires multiple arrows that fly like the wind.

02680048.name: Piercing Arrow
02680048.desc: Fires an arrow. Its effect increases with each enemy it hits.

02680049.name: Speed Mirage
02680049.desc: Fires arrows fast enough to leave an afterimage.

02680050.name: Bolt Burst
02680050.desc: Fires arrows in all directions, striking multiple enemies nearby.

02680051.name: Arrow Stream
02680051.desc: Shoots a wild flurry of arrows straight ahead.

02680052.name: Empowered Piercing Arrow
02680052.desc: Rips through enemies with an empowered piercing arrow.

02680053.name: Gritty Gust
02680053.desc: Blasts nearby enemies with a gust of wind to tear them apart.

02680054.name: High Speed Shot
02680054.desc: Fires off a focused shot that pierces all enemies within range.

02680055.name: Archery Mastery
02680055.desc: Grants proficiency in the fundamentals of Archery.

02680057.name: Arrow Stream - Spread
02680057.desc: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Arrow Stream.

02680058.name: Arrow Stream - Extra Strike
02680058.desc: Increases Arrow Stream's number of attacks.

02680060.name: Piercing Arrow - Spread
02680060.desc: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Piercing Arrow.

02680061.name: Piercing Arrow - Extra Strike
02680061.desc: Increase the number of attacks for Piercing Arrow.

02680063.name: Bullseye Shot
02680063.desc: Hones in on the enemy's weak spot for a devastating shot.

02680065.name: Shuriken Burst
02680065.desc: Throws three exploding shurikens that ricochet to nearby enemies when hit.

02680066.name: Gust Charm
02680066.desc: Focuses the power of the wind to do devastating damage.

02680067.name: Savage Blow
02680067.desc: Deals very quick consecutive attacks to a monster.

02680068.name: Shuriken Challenge
02680068.desc: Summons a large shadow-powered shuriken to annihilate enemies.

02680070.name: Cruel Stab
02680070.desc: Inflicts a brutal stab with the dagger.

02680071.name: Sudden Raid
02680071.desc: Calls in a horde of friends to set the stage on fire.

02680072.name: Death Star
02680072.desc: Summons 4 shurikens that combine into one giant shuriken.

02680073.name: Shadow Veil
02680073.desc: Summons a dark ally to deal damage.

02680076.name: Quad Star - Extra Strike
02680076.desc: Increases Number of Attacks for Quad Star.

02680078.name: Cruel Stab - Spread
02680078.desc: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Cruel Stab.

02680079.name: Cruel Stab - Extra Strike
02680079.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Cruel Stab.

02680080.name: Critical Throw
02680080.desc: Increases Critical Rate to reduce damage deviation.

02680081.name: Bleed Dart
02680081.desc: Coats your stars with a deadly poison that causes bleeding, increasing Attack Power.

02680082.name: Flip of the Coin
02680082.desc: Flips a lucky coin to conjure up a random blessing.

02680083.name: Double Shot
02680083.desc: Fires two consecutive shots at the enemy.

02680084.name: Static Thumper
02680084.desc: Attacks multiple enemies with a shockwave from a high jump.

02680085.name: Sea Serpent Burst
02680085.desc: Attacks the enemies in front of you with a Sea Serpent shockwave.

02680087.name: Turning Kick
02680087.desc: Spins after jumping to kick multiple enemies in front.

02680088.name: Blunderbuster
02680088.desc: Fires a scatter shot that damages multiple enemies.

02680089.name: Blackboot Bill
02680089.desc: Summons the mighty Blackboot Bill to blast through enemies.

02680090.name: Sea Serpent's Rage
02680090.desc: Calls upon the power of the Sea Serpent to bite and tear your enemies.

02680091.name: Octopunch
02680091.desc: Throws a barrage of punches with super human power.

02680092.name: Nautilus Strike
02680092.desc: Order the Nautilus to attack multiple enemies at once.

02680093.name: Hook Bomber
02680093.desc: Throws a punch that attacks the enemy in front with a powerful explosive energy.

02680094.name: Brain Scrambler
02680094.desc: Shoots the target in its squishy bits to deal heavy damage to it.

02680095.name: Sea Serpent Burst II
02680095.desc: Enhances your connection with the Sea Serpent's power, allowing you to strike enemies with an even more powerful shockwave.

02680096.name: Ugly Bomb
02680096.desc: Fires a really weird-looking bomb that you... where did you buy this thing?

02680098.name: Hook Bomber - Spread
02680098.desc: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Hook Bomber.

02680099.name: Hook Bomber - Extra Strike
02680099.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Hook Bomber.

02680101.name: Brain Scrambler - Extra Strike
02680101.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Brain Scrambler.

02680102.name: Crossbones
02680102.desc: Summons the souls of departed pirates to temporarily increase Attack Power.

02680103.name: Jolly Roger
02680103.desc: Your pirate pride kicks in, boosting Attack Power.

02680105.name: Frozen Orb
02680105.desc: Creates and throws a Frozen Orb.

02680106.name: Frozen Orb - Reinforce
02680106.desc: Increases the damage of Frozen Orb.

02680107.name: Frozen Orb - Spread
02680107.desc: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Frozen Orb.

02680108.name: Flame Sweep - Reinforce
02680108.desc: Increases the damage of Flame Sweep.

02680109.name: Flame Sweep - Extra Strike
02680109.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Flame Sweep.

02680110.name: Snipe
02680110.desc: Fires a carefully-aimed shot to deal severe damage.

02680112.name: Snipe - Extra Strike
02680112.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Snipe.

02680113.name: Concentration
02680113.desc: Increases damage as you steel yourself for battle.

02680114.name: Agile Guns
02680114.desc: Increases Gun Attack Speed and Dexterity.

02680115.name: Dark Clarity
02680115.desc: Calms your heart to provide an increase to Attack Power.

02680119.name: Magnum Punch
02680119.desc: Unleashes a powerful and explosive straight punch in front of you.

02680120.name: Bunker Buster Explosion
02680120.desc: Depletes the accumulated energy to fire your Bunker Buster.

02680121.name: Bobbing
02680121.desc: Moves forward while avoiding enemy attacks, hitting enemies along the way.

02680122.name: Arm Cannon Boost
02680122.desc: Increases Attack Speed by 2 for a short time.

02680123.name: Hammer Smash
02680123.desc: Strikes the ground to knock nearby enemies into the air. Creates an extra shockwave that deals additional damage after the skill ends.

02680125.name: Shotgun Punch
02680125.desc: Fires a Screw Blow accompanied by a shockwave.

02680126.name: Aftershock Punch
02680126.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Hammer Smash and Shotgun Punch.

02680127.name: Improved Bunker Explosion
02680127.desc: Increases the damage of Bunker Buster Explosion.

02680128.name: For Liberty
02680128.desc: Materializes the will of the Resistance to increase attack power.

02680129.name: Gatling Punch
02680129.desc: Throws a rapid barrage of punches out in front of you.

02680130.name: Quad Blow
02680130.desc: Quickly attacks multiple enemies 4 times in a row.

02680131.name: Staff Boost
02680131.desc: Increases Attack Speed by 2 for a short time.

02680132.name: Condemnation
02680132.desc: Makes a pact with a dark spirit using a black magic book. It manifests to deal a wide-range attack.

02680133.name: Battle Burst
02680133.desc: Charges through enemies with Dark Chain.

02680134.name: Dark Shock
02680134.desc: Uses Teleport to create a streak of black lightning between your starting and ending positions.

02680135.name: Finishing Blow
02680135.desc: Quickly attacks multiple enemies 6 times in a row.

02680136.name: Dark Genesis
02680136.desc: Uses deadly lightning to hit up to 15 enemies.

02680137.name: Dark Aura
02680137.desc: Produces a mysterious aura that increases the damage done by the Expedition allies.

02680138.name: Condemnation
02680138.desc: Makes a pact with a more powerful dark spirit using a black magic book. It manifests to deal a wide-range attack.

02680140.name: Master of Death
02680140.desc: Your mastery over death allows you to take full advantage of its abilities.

02680141.name: Sweeping Staff
02680141.desc: Summons a magic staff to sweep out the bad guys.

02680142.name: Grim Harvest
02680142.desc: Masters the art of black magic and summons death itself to dispatch your enemies.

02680143.name: Summon Jaguar
02680143.desc: Summons a Jaguar to fight by your side.

02680144.name: Resistance Auto Crank
02680144.desc: Upgrades your weapon with Resistance technology, making it easier to fire.

02680145.name: Dash 'n Slash
02680145.desc: The Jaguar dashes forward, pushing away and dealing damage on multiple enemies.

02680147.name: White Heat Rush
02680147.desc: Your Jaguar coils and pounces to push away enemies and deal damage.

02680148.name: Hunting Assistant Unit
02680148.desc: Utilize Resistance technology to call in a support unit.

02680149.name: Drill Salvo
02680149.desc: Borrow the Resistance's technology to set up a unit that fires giant drills.

02680150.name: Silent Rampage
02680150.desc: Envelops you in the savage power of the hunter.

02680151.name: Jaguar Rampage
02680151.desc: The Jaguar sweeps and slashes with maximum rage.

02680152.name: Exploding Arrows
02680152.desc: Calls on the Resistance to attack enemies.

02680153.name: Primal Grenade
02680153.desc: Fires a grenade made with the latest Resistance technology to attack enemies.

02680154.name: Beam Spline
02680154.desc: Lashes out with the Whip Blade twice to deals damage to multiple enemies.

02680155.name: Circuit Surge
02680155.desc: Increases power output to increase damage.

02680156.name: Quicksilver
02680156.desc: Attacks multiple enemies in front with the Whip Blade.

02680157.name: Ion Thrust
02680157.desc: Uses your energy to deploy the Ion Thruster, which damages and pushes back enemies.

02680158.name: Combat Switch
02680158.desc: Freely changes the Whip Blade to attack multiple enemies.

02680159.name: Diagonal Chase
02680159.desc: Activates full air boosters to shoot up with explosive power while pushing back enemies.

02680160.name: Gravity Pillar
02680160.desc: Deploys an energy field to attack enemies.

02680161.name: Beam Dance
02680161.desc: Unleashes a flurry with your Whip Blade to damage nearby enemies.

02680162.name: Mecha Purge: Snipe
02680162.desc: Roo-D's powerful weapon attacks the enemies.

02680163.name: Hypogram Field: Force Field
02680163.desc: Deploys the Hypogram Field to attack enemies within the field.

02680164.name: Mecha Purge - Reinforce
02680164.desc: Increases the damage of Mecha Purge.

02680165.name: Orbital Cataclysm
02680165.desc: A powerful laser blasts down from space to scorch the earth.

02680166.name: Photon Ray
02680166.desc: Locks onto enemies and destroys them with photonic cannon blasts.

02680167.name: Homing Beacon
02680167.desc: Launches a Homing Beacon to attack multiple enemies. The beacon is programmed to chase the targeted enemy.

02680169.name: Support Unit: H-EX
02680169.desc: Summons H-EX, a stationary support robot. H-EX uses a special shockwave to attack nearby enemies.

02680170.name: Punch Launcher
02680170.desc: Launches fists to knock back multiple enemies.

02680171.name: Giant Robot SG-88
02680171.desc: Summons the giant robot SG-88 to bombard a group of enemies with missiles.

02680172.name: Bots 'n Tots
02680172.desc: Places a robot factory that deploys toy robots. Deployed robots detect nearby enemies and self-destruct when near them. The factory itself also self-destructs after a short time.

02680173.name: Distortion Bomb
02680173.desc: Detonates a special Resistance bomb to create a distortion field.

02680174.name: Support Unit: H-EX - Reinforce
02680174.desc: Increases the damage for Support Unit: H-EX.

02680175.name: Doomsday Device
02680175.desc: Summons an diabolical death machine to annihilate your opponents.

02680176.name: Worldreaver
02680176.desc: Unleashes a brutal slash that decimates all in sight.

02680179.name: Elemental Fury
02680179.desc: Unleashes the fury of flame in the form of an enraged spirit.

02680182.name: Storm of Arrows
02680182.desc: Fires arrows into the sky to fall like rain.

02680186.name: Blades of Destiny
02680186.desc: Seals the fate of your opponents with a blinding flurry of blades.

02680189.name: Cannon of Mass Destruction
02680189.desc: Fires a gigantic rocket from your cannon.

02680190.name: Robo Launcher RM7
02680190.desc: Places a fixed artillery piece, the RM7. RM7 hits the enemy by firing multiple blasts straight forward. RM7 self-destructs when it runs out of power.

02680193.name: Omega Blaster
02680193.desc: Fires a powerful beam of energy.

02681000.name: Silver Ladle
02681000.desc: Weapon that can be used by an Abyssal Expedition Ally. \r\nIncreases Attack Power of the applicable Expedition Ally when equipped.

02681001.name: Chicken Smackaroo
02681001.desc: Weapon that can be used by an Abyssal Expedition Ally. \r\nIncreases Attack Power of the applicable Expedition Ally when equipped.

02681002.name: Royal Marine Flag
02681002.desc: Weapon that can be used by an Abyssal Expedition Ally. \r\nIncreases Attack Power of the applicable Expedition Ally when equipped.

02690019.name: Leaf Dress
02690019.desc: Clothes made by loosely weaving together large leaves. The durability is weak and the defense is low, but it's better than wearing nothing.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690020.name: Sloppy Exploration Clothes
02690020.desc: Clothes made by processing leather and feathers. It's a little sloppy, but still suitable for exploration.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690021.name: Gladiator Armor
02690021.desc: Armor made by processing an iron plate and leather. Thanks to its greater durability and stronger defense, it increases your survivability in battle.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690022.name: Golden Armor
02690022.desc: Armor made by processing iron plate and gold. Its durability is not the best, but it has excellent defense.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690023.name: Leopard Coat
02690023.desc:
Clothes made by processing leather obtained from Smilodon. It has excellent durability and high defense.

02690025.desc: A hat made out of leaves collected from the jungle. It has a refreshing scent. \n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690026.desc: A hat made by processing leather. No exploration outfit is complete without it.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690027.desc: A hat made by processing iron plate and animal molars. It has good Defense.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690028.desc: A hat molded in the shape of a lightning rod by processing Golem Fragments and iron. While wearing it, you can feel a special power that nullifies lightning.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690029.desc: A hat made by placing a bird egg in the middle of a bird's nest. It somehow blocks the heat.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690030.desc: A hat made to automatically light up by using the power of Lava Stone. It allows you to see things at night.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690031.desc: A hat modeled after the one worn by the Chief of the Lizardmen. It borrows the energy of the chief to help in finding relics.\n\n#cDefense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690045.desc: It's a mining tool made by processing iron. It is harder than stone, so you can mine more quickly.

02690057.name: Leather Outfit
02690057.desc: An armor made of leather. It's not as durable as some other armor, but it's suitable for exploration.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690058.name: Plate Armor
02690058.desc: A plate armor made of iron.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690059.name: Relic Exploration Suit
02690059.desc: An exploration suit that's in pretty decent shape. It will help you on your journey.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690060.name: Functional Active Wear
02690060.desc:
Active wear made by using various materials obtained through island exploration. It's light and highly practical.

#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690061.name: Heavy Armor Battle Suit
02690061.desc:
A heavy suit of armor for longer battles.

#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%
- Special Function: increases max Attack Power by +{attackPower:g} when equipped

02690062.name: Magic Robe
02690062.desc: A robe made from the skins of Smilodon and Neophron. Just like an ancient magician would wear.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690063.name: Leather Hat
02690063.desc: A hat made of leather. It has a rustic look.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690064.name: Iron Helmet
02690064.desc: A helmet made of iron plating.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690065.name: Golden Helmet
02690065.desc: A golden helmet made from refined iron plating and gold.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690066.name: Steel Helmet
02690066.desc: A helmet made of steel plating.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690067.name: Sun Cap
02690067.desc: A sun cap that will protect your face from the scorching sun.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690068.name: Sturdy Combat Helmet
02690068.desc: A helmet that exudes sophistication. It's optimized for combat.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690071.name: Iron Plated Shoes

02690074.name: Armor of Protection
02690074.desc: An armor that radiates the power of Refined Lava Stone. It instills a will to protect what is important.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02690075.name: Helmet of Protection
02690075.desc: A helmet that radiates the power of Refined Lava Stone. It instills a will to protect what is important.\n\n#c- Defense: +{defensePower:g}%

02691045.name: Life Force Recovery Potion (S)
02691045.desc: A Life Force Recovery Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Recovers Life Force by {recoveryHP:g}

02691046.name: Life Force Recovery Potion (L)
02691046.desc: A Large Life Force Recovery Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Recovers Life Force by {recoveryHP:g}
