02691047.desc: An Acting Power Recovery Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Recovers Acting Power by {recoveryStamina:g}

02691048.name: Acting Power Recovery Potion (L)
02691048.desc: A Large Acting Power Recovery Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Recovers Acting Power by {recoveryStamina:g}

02691049.name: Glowing Potion
02691049.desc: A special potion that illuminates the surroundings even without a torch. Drinking it temporarily brightens your surroundings.\n\n#c- Special Function: can see surroundings for {time:g} seconds

02691050.name: Attack Power Increase Potion
02691050.desc: An Attack Power Increase Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Attack Power by {attackPower:g} for {time:g} seconds

02691051.name: Defense Increase Potion
02691051.desc: A Defense Increase Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Defense by {defensePower:g}% for {time:g} seconds

02691052.name: Speed Increase Potion
02691052.desc: A Speed Increase Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Speed by {speed:g} for {time:g} seconds

02691053.name: Jump Increase Potion
02691053.desc: A Jump Increase Potion made through alchemy.\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Jump by {jump:g} for {time:g} seconds

02691054.name: Poison Potion
02691054.desc: A Poison Potion made through alchemy. It's harmful to the body, but it increases Attack Power.\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Attack Power by +{attackPowerRate:g} for {time:g} seconds and decreases Life Force by -{maxHPRate:g}%

02691055.name: Fast Jungle Pig One-time Coupon
02691055.desc: You can quickly roam the island by riding the fast jungle pig. \r\n#c - Increases Speed greatly \r\n - Max Mount Duration: {time:g} seconds

02691056.name: Light Jungle Pig One-time Coupon
02691056.desc: You can explore every corner of the island by riding the light jungle pig. #c - Increases Speed/Increases Jump greatly \r\n - Max Mount Duration: {time:g} seconds

02691057.name: Heavy Jungle Pig One-time Coupon
02691057.desc: Ride the heavy jungle pig and you'll never be lonely. \r\n#c - Reduces Speed \r\n - Max Mount Duration: {time:g} seconds

02691058.name: Magic Wings One-time Coupon
02691058.desc: You can fly through the sky with magic wings. \r\n#c - Enables the Flying Skill \r\n - Max Mount Duration: {time:g} seconds

02691059.name: Airplane One-time Coupon
02691059.desc: You can fly through the sky quickly aboard this airplane. \r\n#c - Enables the Flying Skill\r\n - Max Mount Duration: {time:g} seconds

02691060.name: Submarine One-time Coupon
02691060.desc: You can ride in the submarine and navigate underwater through the jungle. \r\n#c - Ignores diving penalty \r\n - Max Mount Duration: {time:g} seconds

02691061.name: Leaves Bag
02691061.desc: A bag made of leaves.\n- When used, adds an additional 4 slots to your inventory.

02691062.name: Leather Bag
02691062.desc: A bag made of leather.\n- When used, adds an additional 8 slots to your inventory.

02691063.name: Magic Bag
02691063.desc: A special bag made of Lizardman Skin.\n- When used, adds an additional 12 slots to your inventory.

02691064.name: Special Emergency Medicine
02691064.desc:
A special emergency medicine that numerous researchers at expedition headquarters created by working tirelessly day and night. Recovers a significant amount of Life Force and Acting Power.

#c- Recovers Life Force by +100
- Recovers Acting Power by +30

02691065.name: Special Nutritional Supplement
02691065.desc: A special nutritional supplement that numerous researchers at expedition headquarters created by working tirelessly day and night. Temporarily increases Life Force and Max Acting Power and increases Attack Power.\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Max Life Force by {maxHP:g} for {time:g} seconds, increases Max Acting Power by {maxStamina:g}, increases Attack Power by {attackPower:g}

02691066.name: Whetstone
02691066.desc: You can partially repair the durability of equipped weapon or harvesting tool. \n\n- Recovers durability by +{RecoveryDurability:g} when used

02691067.name: Attack Power Explosion Potion
02691067.desc: Adrenaline is temporarily secreted, physical abilities are amplified, and attack power and attack speed are greatly increased! It's an explosion of attack power!\n\n#c- Special Function: increases Attack Power by +{attackPower:g} for {time:g} seconds

02691068.name: Acting Power Recovery Potion (XL)
02691068.desc: A potion that recovers all Acting Power.\n\n#c- Recovers Acting Power by +{recoveryStamina:g}

02691069.name: HP Recovery Potion (XL)
02691069.desc: A potion that recovers all HP.\n\n#c- Recovers HP by +200

02691070.name: Water
02691070.desc: Water that can be used for cooking.

02691073.name: Clue of Ancient Threat
02691073.desc: A note that the ancient races used to carry around. Clues regarding strong enemies are written on it. You can find a strong enemy if you gather enough clues and investigate.

02691074.name: Energy Bar

02691075.name: Hardtack

02691076.name: Canned Food

02691077.name: Chocolate

02691078.name: Leather Saddle
02691078.desc: A saddle that can be placed on the back of a stunned jungle boar. You can use it by double-clicking.

02691079.name: Smilodon Capture Cage
02691079.desc: A sturdy cage that can trap a stunned Smilodon. Smilodon is feared by all monsters in the jungle, so this should be quite useful.

02691080.name: Fireworks
02691080.desc:
Fireworks that produce a small display. Use to increase Attack Power and Defense while feeling festive. The resulting explosive sound when used can temporarily stun nearby monsters.

#c- Attack Power: +{attackPower:g}
- Defense: {defensePower:g}%
- Duration: {time:g}sec

02691081.name: Dish with Subtle Taste

02691082.name: Dish with Disappointing Taste

02691083.name: Frag Grenade
02691083.desc: A grenade made by processing gunpowder through alchemy. It can be used on enemies to inflict damage.

02691084.name: Firebomb
02691084.desc: A firebomb made by processing Lava Stone through alchemy. It can be used on enemies to inflict damage.

02691085.name: Smoke Bomb
02691085.desc: A smoke bomb made by processing charcoal through alchemy. It temporarily blurs the enemy's peripheral vision.

02691086.name: Flash-Bang
02691086.desc: A flash-bang made by refining Red Flower Powder through alchemy. It temporarily disables the enemy's vision.

02691087.name: Smoked Meat

02691088.name: Smoked Fish

02691089.name: Boiled Pork

02691090.name: Seafood Soup

02691091.name: Chun Gwon

02691092.name: Pad Thai

02691093.name: Expedition Diary
02691093.desc: A diary to document your travels on the Misty Island.\n#cDouble-click# the item to record the places you visit.

02691094.name: Masterpiece! Steak

02691095.name: Mysterious Cook Book
02691095.desc: A book that contains mysterious recipes.\n#cDouble-click# the item to see what dishes are recorded in the book.

02691096.name: Unreliable Clue
02691096.desc: A document that is presumed to contain a clue about the relic hidden on the Misty Island.\n#cDouble-click# the item to check the clue.

02691097.name: Matches
02691097.desc: It is a portable light source tool. You can be active at night, but your range of vision is short.

02691098.name: Torch
02691098.desc: It is a portable light source tool. With a moderate range of vision, you can be active even at night.

02691099.name: Return Scroll - Misty Island Ancient Ruins
02691099.desc: A scroll that allows you to return to the center of the ancient ruins by using the magical power of Lava Stone. Can be used any number of times.

02692000.name: Survival Worktable
02692000.desc: You can't survive in this dangerous wilderness with just your bare hands. Build a worktable to craft various tools and structures necessary for survival, and inform the headquarters that you have settled safely.

02692001.name: Industrial Worktable
02692001.desc: A worktable that can produce more practical and improved tools and structures, and can send and receive voice signals to and from the headquarters. #cWhen crafted, the Survival Worktable placed on the map is upgraded.

02692002.name: Engineering Worktable
02692002.desc: Lava Stone can be processed and used as an energy source, and allows for advanced mechanical devices to be crafted. A walkie-talkie with high reception sensitivity is attached. #cWhen crafted, the Industrial Worktable placed on the map is upgraded.

02692003.name: Alchemy Pot
02692003.desc: You can craft various recovery and enhancement medicines and poisons. Be careful not to confuse potions with poisons.

02692004.name: Enchantment Table
02692004.desc: You can craft equipment and defense facilities that contain powerful magic.

02692005.name: Bonfire
02692005.desc: You can light a fire to drive away the cold and darkness of the night and warm up a meal.

02692006.name: Improved Bonfire
02692006.desc: A brighter and longer-lasting bonfire using charcoal. You can drive away the cold and darkness of the night and grill up a hot meal.

02692007.name: Countertop
02692007.desc: You can prepare various ingredients to cook a wholesome meal. The results will be tastier than raw or grilled food, and have a good recovery effect, but...

02692008.name: Streetlight
02692008.desc: A streetlight that shines as brightly as the sun even at night.

02692009.name: Wooden Box
02692009.desc: A wooden box that can hold up to 8 items.

02692010.name: Improved Wooden Box
02692010.desc: A practical wooden box that can hold up to 12 items.

02692011.name: Palm Tent
02692011.desc: A tent made by weaving together large leaves. Blocks rain and wind and slightly recovers Acting Power.

02692012.name: Feather Tent
02692012.desc: A tent made of feathers and leather. Neophron feathers that adjust the temperature based on the external environment are placed on the roof to maintain the proper temperature at all times. It protects against wind and rain and heat, and recovers Acting Power.

02692013.name: Barricade
02692013.desc: A wooden barricade that protects against invading monsters. Sharpened points inflict low damage to monsters that touch the barricade.

02692014.name: Advanced Stone Wall
02692014.desc: A stone wall that firmly defends against invading monsters. It does not break easily.

02692015.name: Sturdy Advanced Stone Wall
02692015.desc: A stone wall made stronger by pouring concrete between the stones. It can firmly defend against invading monsters invasion and does not break easily.

02692016.name: Sticky Platform
02692016.desc: The stickiness of the platform significantly slows down monsters' Speed.

02692017.name: Monster Sound Speaker
02692017.desc: A speaker that produces a terrifying sound, even to monsters. Monsters take a small amount of damage and their Attack Power is decreased in fear upon hearing the sound.\n #cOnly 2 can be installed at a time.#

02692018.name: Molar Trap
02692018.desc: Inflicts low damage to passing monsters. Linking several molar traps together might be enough to kill the monsters.

02692019.name: Cannon Tower
02692019.desc: When a monster comes within range, it fires a cannon and inflicts a powerful attack.

02692020.name: Fireball Tower
02692020.desc: A fireball tower made from the hot flames found all around the island. Inflicts powerful damage on monsters.

02692021.name: Lightning Tower
02692021.desc: A lightning tower containing the mysterious power of the Thunder Stone. Inflicts damage on monsters with the power of lightning that rips through the sky, making them unable to move intermittently.

02692022.name: Water Bomb Tower
02692022.desc: Throws a water bomb containing the energy of the cold deep sea that freezes anything to its core. Inflicts damage on monsters and slows their Speed.

02692023.name: Automatic Fishing Rod
02692023.desc: An automatic fishing rod specially designed to catch fish anywhere. Once installed, it automatically catches fresh fish at regular intervals.

02692024.name: Holy Grail
02692024.desc: A holy grail made of pure gold imbued with magic containing the power of earth, water, and lightning. You will experience a miracle every time you drink from it.

02692025.name: Weather Controller
02692025.desc: With the power of magic, you can temporarily control the weather. The odds of success are not high.

02692026.name: Excavator
02692026.desc: A machine with a large claw that can excavate relics buried deep in the ground.

02692027.name: Relic Detector
02692027.desc: A device that can detect the power of Lava Stone contained inside relics. It takes a lot of time to find the exact location.

02692028.name: Wooden Fence
02692028.desc: A wooden fence made by tying together logs with rope. You can protect yourself from enemies until it is destroyed.

02692029.name: Wooden Barricade
02692029.desc: A wooden barricade made of wide-cut trees. By sharpening the tip, it inflicts damage to approaching enemies.

02692030.name: Stone Wall
02692030.desc: A stone wall made by mixing stone and steel materials. It looks very sturdy.

02692031.name: Advanced Stone Wall
02692031.desc: A wall made by applying fine-grained cement between stones. The dense structure makes it easy to block enemy attacks.

02692032.name: Enhanced Wall
02692032.desc: A wall made by combining stone, steel, and gold. Due to its high durability, it is suitable for defending against enemies.

02692033.name: Steel Thorn Wall
02692033.desc: A wall made of steel thorns that will sting from even the lightest touch. It inflicts strong damage to enemies that touch the wall before it is destroyed.

02692034.name: Lava Wall
02692034.desc: A wall that contains the energy of lava from a volcano located in the center of Misty Island. It inflicts powerful damage while blocking the enemy's approach.

02692035.name: Lava Stone Wall
02692035.desc: A wall that contains the magic of Lava Stone. It emits a red light, creating a powerful defense. It is stronger than any other wall and has the best durability.

02692036.name: Crossbow Tower
02692036.desc: A tower that fires crossbow arrows. You can fire at a rapid rate.

02692037.name: Cannon Tower
02692037.desc: A cannon tower made by mixing stone and steel. It fires shells at approaching enemies.

02692038.name: Mortar Tower
02692038.desc: A tower where huge mortars are fired. Due to its large size, its speed is slow, but it can inflict strong damage to a wide area.

02692039.name: Improved Cannon Tower
02692039.desc: A cannon tower with improved performance. It fires shells at approaching enemies, and stop their actions for a while.

02692040.name: Enhanced Crossbow Tower
02692040.desc: A crossbow tower with improved performance, enabling stronger attacks.

02692041.name: Fireball Tower
02692041.desc: A tower made with the energy of flame extracted from Lava Stone. It punishes approaching enemies with the power of a strong fire attribute.

02692042.name: Lightning Tower
02692042.desc: A tower that is modeled after the thunderstorms around the Misty Island. It inflicts lightning attribute attacks on approaching enemies, and at the same time stuns them with thunder for a while.

02692043.name: Frozen Tower
02692043.desc: A tower made with the biting cold energy from the depths of the sea where no one can touch. It inflicts ice attribute attacks on approaching enemies and slows their actions at the same time.

02692044.name: Magma Tower
02692044.desc: A tower with the magical power of Refined Lava Stone. Although it is slow, it emits a powerful force that scorches the earth. The speed of enemies who step on the ground engulfed in magma will be reduced and they will take continuous damage.

02692045.name: Magic Bullet Tower
02692045.desc: A tower with the magical power of Refined Lava Stone. It inflicts damage to multiple approaching enemies.

02692046.name: Campfire for cooking
02692046.desc: A bonfire for cooking that is made by building a brazier over a flame. With this, you can drive away the cold and darkness of the night, and cook a warm meal.

02692047.name: Animal Skin Tent
02692047.desc: A tent made of durable leather. It is optimized to withstand the external environment with the addition of a solid iron plate and processed wood. It blocks rain, wind, heat, and restores Acting Power more quickly.

02692048.name: Rainwater Filter
02692048.desc: A device that filters rainwater to be collected.

02692049.name: Well
02692049.desc: A well built to pump underground water. Water can be obtained from the well at regular intervals.

02692050.name: Sturdy Box
02692050.desc: A sturdy wooden box that can hold up to 16 items.

02692051.name: Magic Analysis Device
02692051.desc: Processes Lava Stone more precisely to be used as an energy source and a high quality crafting material. #cAfter installation, you can craft rare materials at the enchantment table.

02693000.name: Leaf
02693000.desc: A large and jagged leaf that is easily found in the jungle.

02693001.name: Log
02693001.desc: A log cut in half. It is easy to process, so it's suitable for making simple tools.

02693002.name: Stone
02693002.desc: A stone mined from rock. It is harder than wood and does not burn, so it can be used for everything from simple tools to construction equipment.

02693003.name: Iron
02693003.desc: A strong and durable material. It can be used to create various enhanced tools and complex items.

02693004.name: Gold
02693004.desc: A rare ore. It contains magical power.

02693005.name: Lava Stone
02693005.desc: A flaming red ore. It radiates powerful energy.

02693006.name: Feather
02693006.desc: A small and light feather that can be obtained from Toco Toucan.

02693008.name: Piranha Deadly Poison
02693008.desc: A terrifyingly deadly poison that paralyzes anything that comes into contact with it.

02693009.name: Jungle Pig Molar
02693009.desc: A hard and sharp molar from a jungle pig.

02693010.name: Lizardman Skin
02693010.desc: A tough hide from a Lizardman. It does not tear easily.

02693011.name: Golem Rubble
02693011.desc: The rubble from the Guardian Golems. Flames spark from it when provided with heat.

02693012.name: Neophron Feather
02693012.desc: A holy feather of Neophron. It adjusts the temperature according to its surroundings, and is water-resistant.

02693013.name: Smilodon Leather
02693013.desc: A blue leather of Smilodon. It is soft, but very tough and sturdy.

02693014.name: Smilodon Canine
02693014.desc: A canine from a Smilodon. It is extremely sharp, and hard as steel.

02693015.name: Lava Stone Powder
02693015.desc: Powdered Lava Stone that emits energy.

02693016.name: Fainted Jungle Pig
02693016.desc: A Jungle Pig that passed out from a critical wound. You can put on a Leather Saddle to ride on it.

02693017.name: Rope
02693017.desc: A multi-purpose rope made by twisting and weaving leaves. It is much more durable than it looks, which makes it good for tying things together.

02693018.name: Board
02693018.desc: A wooden board that is flat and sturdy. It can be used to make boxes or various structures.

02693019.name: Charcoal
02693019.desc: Charcoal made from burning wood. It can be used to make gunpowder or improved bonfire.

02693020.name: Brick
02693020.desc: Bricks made by processing stones. It is commonly used in building structures such as stone walls.

02693021.name: Iron Plate
02693021.desc: A thick, sturdy plate made of iron. It is used in various structures that require sturdiness.

02693022.name: Iron Rod
02693022.desc: A long rod made from iron. It is useful for creating sturdy tools.

02693023.name: Gold Bar
02693023.desc: A bar of refined gold with enhanced purity. It contains powerful magic.

02693024.name: Cement Powder
02693024.desc: Powder made from stones. It hardens when mixed with water.

02693025.name: Screw
02693025.desc: A screw for binding iron plates.

02693026.name: Cog
02693026.desc: A cog made from iron. It allows an efficient transmission of power.

02693027.name: Lever
02693027.desc: A lever to control the energy supply of the Lava Stone.

02693028.name: Propeller
02693028.desc: A propeller with four blades. It converts power from the engine to create a propulsive force.

02693029.name: Engine
02693029.desc: You can power it using the energy from the Lava Stone.

02693030.name: Gunpowder
02693030.desc: Gunpowder made from mixing charcoal and golem rubble. It explodes when exposed to heat.

02693031.name: Red Flower Powder
02693031.desc: Powder made from red flowers grown with the energy of Lava Stone. It can revitalize a fatigued body.

02693032.name: Banana Powder
02693032.desc: Powder made from condensed banana. It is nutritious and filling.

02693033.name: Herbal Powder
02693033.desc: Powder made from herbs. It is good for vitality, and helps the blood flow.

02693034.name: Empty Bucket
02693034.desc: A bucket made of iron. Press #cHarvest Key# near a waterfall to fill it with water. #cConsumes {consumeStamina:g} Acting Power#

02693036.name: Deep Sea Stone
02693036.desc: A stone that glows dark blue. It contains the energy of the deep, blue sea.

02693037.name: Thunder Stone
02693037.desc: A stone that gleams blue. It contains the pure energy of countless lightning strikes.

02693038.name: Jewel of Water
02693038.desc: A jewel that contains the energy of calm water. It is useful for making magical items.

02693039.name: Jewel of Lightning
02693039.desc: A jewel that contains the energy of powerful lightning. It is useful for making magical items.

02693040.name: Lava Solution
02693040.desc: A solution made by refining Lava Stone Powder. It can be used for making various potions.

02693041.name: Regeneration Solution
02693041.desc: A solution made by refining Red Flower Powder. It can be used for making special potions.

02693042.name: Fainted Smilodon
02693042.desc: A Smilodon that passed out from a critical wound.

02693043.name: Safety Charm
02693043.desc: A safety charm that may save you in a crucial moment.

02693044.name: Excavated Relic
02693044.desc: A relic you finally discovered after a tough expedition. You should keep it safe and return to headquarters.

02693045.name: 發掘的遺物
02693045.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

02693046.name: 發掘的遺物
02693046.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

02693047.name: 發掘的遺物

03801961.name: Explorer's Pack
03801961.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by 4% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 30. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nIf you're crazy enough to descend into Azmoth Chasm, you'll need the right gear! This pack may not help you in combat, but mark my words, you'll be glad to have it in the end.

03801962.name: Advanced Explorer's Pack
03801962.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by 6% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 50. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThis pack may weigh you down a bit, but it's full of gear to help you through the perils of Azmoth Chasm. You'll face more than monsters, after all.

03801963.name: Veteran Explorer's Pack
03801963.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by 8% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 100. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThe only way we'll ever truly understand the fate of Azmoth is to examine every inch of the chasm with specialized gear... Just make sure you're ready for some rough fights, all right?

03801964.name: Vile Lash
03801964.desc: #cIncreases points earned after stopping the Azmothian Guardians within 60 seconds by 50.#\nOn the day of Azmoth's ruin, more than one of its nobles learned that pain and fear can only stay a vengeful hand for so long...

03801965.name: Vicious Lash
03801965.desc: #cIncreases points earned upon stopping the Azmothian Guardians within 60 seconds by 100.#\nThe ruin of Azmoth was not justice. How could it be, when weighed against the torment Azmoth wrought, the blood the city spilled? Stand in this grave of uncounted dreams and realize that what some would call justice was merely a relief.

03801966.name: Drak's Research Notes
03801966.desc: A #cresearch record# written in some lost language. Based on the images and the maddened scrawl, whoever wrote this did something unspeakable.

03801967.name: Alchemist Stone
03801967.desc: #cChanges into an Awakened Stone after advancing 4 times in a row.#\nCreated by an alchemist of Azmoth, it could easily pass for a normal stone.

03801968.name: Black Alchemist Stone
03801968.desc: #cChanges into an Awakened Black Stone after advancing 4 times in a row#\nCreated by an alchemist of Azmoth, it could easily pass for a normal stone.

03801969.name: Awakened Stone
03801969.desc: #cIncreases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 90.#\nUnable to trust each other with their most prized secrets, the alchemists of Azmoth created advisors of a more unnatural source. As you stare into the weeping eyes of this stone, it whispers its dark counsel in the back of your mind.

03801970.name: Awakened Black Stone
03801970.desc: #cIncreases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 220.#\nThe alchemists of Azmoth hoarded knowledge from each other, only trusting their secrets to living stones, servants supposedly bound to the will of their creator. But as you see this stone open its eyes and hear its whispered words of temptation, you wonder at the wisdom of their choice.

03801971.name: Grave Robber's Backpack
03801971.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 3% for each held item owned. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nMore than one grave robber has braved the depths of Azmoth Chasm looking for treasure... Seeing as the former owner of this pack is nowhere to be seen, you have a good idea of what happened to them.

03801972.name: Grave Robber's Bulging Backpack
03801972.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 4% for each held item owned. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nMore than one grave robber has braved the depths of Azmoth Chasm looking for treasure... Seeing as the former owner of this large pack is nowhere to be seen, you have a good idea of what happened to them.

03801973.name: Whispering Tome
03801973.desc: #cIncreases stamina reduction by 5 and Final Damage by 4% upon entering Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nAs you pick up the Whispering Tome, your mind runs cold and your breath dies in your throat. You can almost hear its sibilant song of the sorcerers of Azmoth... and the great terror they worked in their dark towers.

03801974.name: Tome of the High Sybarite
03801974.desc: #cIncreases stamina reduction by 5 and Final Damage by 9% upon entering Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nA tome warm with a sickening heat, as if it were a living thing. As you take it in your hands, you can see the glories of lost Azmoth, its rioting gardens and unfathomable sorceries... and the blood soaked into its stones. Look at the ruin around you, hero. And remember that all greed has its price.

03801975.name: Gladiator's Amulet
03801975.desc: #cIncreases damage taken by 10% and Final Damage by 3% after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe nobles of Azmoth once thought to mock their gladiators with amulets of purest silver, little realizing that by forcing their captives to fight and die in the coliseum, they were forging a blade that would turn against them on the day ruin came.

03801976.name: Battle-Hammered Gladiator's Amulet
03801976.desc: #cIncreases damage taken by 15% and Final Damage by 7% after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe berserkers were the most unfortunate captives in Azmoth's coliseum, gladiators driven mad by foul poisons and fouler sorceries. But they never fought with more ferocity than on the day Azmoth crumbled, when their battle fury was fueled not by hate and torment, but hope.

03801977.name: Emergency Protection Spell
03801977.desc: #cSeals chasm item effects, defends against stamina decreases based on time remaining, and recovers an additional 35 stamina when a stage ends 2 times.#\nA scroll of protective magic, fashioned by an ancient wizard to protect his pupils. It will preserve you from the horrors of Azmoth for a time, but it will also seal away any beneficial effects from cursed objects.\n...For some reason, the scroll is covered in cat hair.

03801978.name: Demon Rag Doll
03801978.desc: A rag doll of a #cdemon child#, complete with wings and horns. It was sewn with deepest love, and once comforted a young girl through many nights of bitter tears.

03801979.name: Barbed Arrowheads
03801979.desc: A handful of ancient arrowheads, still gleaming with a lethal #clight# though the rest of the arrow has long since rotted way. A cruel hand fashioned them to inflict the maximum amount of pain.

03801980.name: Dusty Blood Vial
03801980.desc: The glass of this vial is fogged with dirt, but the dark red color of the liquid sloshing around inside is unmistakable. It is full of #cblood#, which looks as fresh as the day it was drawn.

03801981.name: Wanted Poster Stack
03801981.desc: A sheaf of crumbling wanted posters, yellow with age. In place of criminals, each dusty page depicts a different fugitive demon who made a #cpowerful enemy#.

03801982.name: Arcane Defense Manual
03801982.desc: A ponderous tome detailing the schematics for the #carcane turrets# of Azmoth. Buried deep in its labyrinthine pages is the knowledge of the turrets' power source, an arcane fuel derived from a resource the rulers of Azmoth had in plentiful supply: demon blood.

03801983.name: Bloody Alchemy Tools
03801983.desc: You don't know what kind of #calchemy experiment# requires a sawtooth blade, bandages, and a bottle of preservative solution... but you hope you never find out.

03801984.name: Heretical Icon
03801984.desc: A diamond icon of heretical faith, with a #clidless eye# at its heart. In the flickering light, the pupil almost seems to be following your movements...

03801985.name: Gnawed Femur
03801985.desc: A #cmassive femur# from a creature unknown, now covered in tooth marks. A doctor might say it that looks more like a finger bone than a femur, but what monster could have a hand that big?

03801986.name: Emergency Rations
03801986.desc: Emergency rations cached by the advance exploration team. It doesn't look like anything has broken the seal, so they #cshould# be safe to eat.

03801987.name: Drak's Torn Notes
03801987.desc: A #ctorn page#, covered in an indescribable script. No one in their right mind would want to decipher what it says.

03801988.name: Homemade Hairpin
03801988.desc: A #chomemade hairpin#, created in hopes of bringing some small comfort to a distraught child. Examining the pin closely, you realize that it would be the perfect tool for picking the lock on a pair of manacles.

03801989.name: Strange Dagger
03801989.desc: A #cperfectly ordinary dagger#, well-used but well-maintained. Its handle is bare of device and it is identical to a thousand other blades you've seen in your adventures... so why does holding it make your heart run cold?

03801990.name: Vial of Viscous Blood
03801990.desc: At first, the dark red liquid inside this vial appears solid, with immobile bubbles pressed up against the glass. But as hours pass, the bubbles slowly rise and you realize the liquid is boiling in slow motion. Just what kind of #cblood# is inside?

03801991.name: Portrait of a Would-be God
03801991.desc: A dirty, once luxurious portrait of a #chorned demon#, gazing out towards the viewer with a haughty expression. His eyes shine with ambition and there's a self-indulgent twist to his smile. The golden label on the frame bears the name #cDrak#.

03801992.name: Drak's Ritual Scroll
03801992.desc: #cPlans written in an indescribable script#. The few illustrations you can decipher seem to detail gold, artifacts, and an ocean of blood...

03801993.name: Demonic Idol
03801993.desc: A small idol of a horned and winged demon carved out of dark stone. For some reason, you feel your arm curling into a #cthrowing motion# as you hold it.

03801994.name: Golem Self-Destruct Scroll
03801994.desc: Every alchemist in Azmoth carried a copy of this scroll at their hip, no matter where they were. They knew it was their last defense against a #cgolem# gone rogue.

03801995.name: The Encyclopedia of Infernus Husbandry
03801995.desc: A thick compendium perfect for any delusional soul hoping to rear an #cInfernus# of their very own. The illustrations of the proper feeding methods would give you nightmares if they weren't so cute.

03801996.name: Demon Mercenary Badge
03801996.desc: Handheld proof of the owner's membership in a #cmercenary company#. You have no idea why the sellsword band came to the cursed land of Azmoth, but it's clear that despite their preparations none returned alive.

03801997.name: Ruinous Ritual Blade
03801997.desc: The curse seeping from this #cmysterious ritualistic blade# is so incredibly vile, it might just be the source of the ruin that befell Azmoth Chasm.

03801998.name: Azmothian Ore
03801998.desc: #cSummons 1 Goldeater after successfully completing a Vanguard Defense or Azmothian Guardians and increases points earned by slaying Goldeaters by 300.#\nAs Azmoth's doom approached, the paranoid rulers of the city descended into fratricidal strife. To protect themselves from their so-called allies, they created a mysterious ore that marked their fiercest enemies with a golden glow.

03801999.name: Burning Azmothian Ore
03801999.desc: #cSummons 2 Goldeaters after successfully completing a Vanguard Defense or Azmothian Guardians and increases points earned by slaying Goldeaters by 300.#\nTell me... what good is a metal that marks your deadliest foes gold when every friend comes wearing a knife-edged smile and every servant stokes fire in their heart?

03802000.name: Sorcerer's Veil
03802000.desc: #c50% stamina reduction 1 time when rechallenging after failing to progress.#\nThis veil is comfortable, almost refreshing, on your face, but its origins with a dark sect of sorcerers undeniably pulls at your mind at times.

03802001.name: Silken Sorcerer's Veil
03802001.desc: #c100% stamina reduction 1 time when rechallenging after a failing to progress.#\nNothing quite feels as good as this silken covering on your face...and that thought threatens to lead your mind down darker paths.

03802002.name: Grim Epaulette
03802002.desc: #cIncreases the chances of finding a higher-ranked item when you get the next item.#\nDrak's personal guards were marked with these epaulettes, signaling their viciousness and cruelty to those they made demands of.

03802003.name: Threatening Epaulette
03802003.desc: #cIncreases the chances of finding a higher-ranked item when you get the next item.#\nDrak's most trusted guards wore these epaulettes, indicating that their every demand must be acknowledged, on pain of death.

03802004.name: Guardbreaker Pendant
03802004.desc:
#cLowers the difficulty for the next Azmothian Guardians.
- Aidan: Increases Final Damage up to 5% based on Glorious Memory.
- Kind Azrael: Increases Essence Destroyed duration by 2 sec.
- Infernus Harbinger: Defends against Hellfire Curse for 15 sec.#
This pendant bears a power that can repel Azmoth's guardians, but it does not appear to have done its long-departed owner much good.

03802005.name: Unproven Demonic Inoculant
03802005.desc: #cRestores 40 stamina.#\nMagatia's alchemists hastily concocted this serum to counteract demonic influences, but it lacked essential potency.

03802006.name: Demonic Inoculant
03802006.desc: #cRestores 60 stamina.#\nAfter some urgent reformulation, Magatia's alchemists were able to produce this effective serum.

03802007.name: Special Demonic Inoculant
03802007.desc: #cRestores 80 stamina.#\nThis potent serum was the result of tireless, sometimes desperate refinement from Magatia's alchemists.

03802008.name: Strawberry-Scented Syrup
03802008.desc: #cPrevent HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once.#\nA simple sweetener gifted from father to daughter can be all the motivation one needs to push past their limits.

03802009.name: Father's Keepsake
03802009.desc: #cPrevents HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once, and increases Final Damage by 10%. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nA beloved father concocted this powerful potion with the best of intentions, but tragically never saw it used.

03802010.name: Artifact Case
03802010.desc: #cGrants a chance to get an epic chasm item.#\nLayered with years of dust and marked with desperate gashes, this unassuming box could hold a most precious treasure.

03802011.name: Artifact Reliquary
03802011.desc: #cGrants a chance to get a unique chasm item.#\nBattered and grimy, one would never expect this box to be so hotly pursued for the rumored relic within.

03802012.name: Azmothian Crystal
03802012.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 15% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThis ephemeral crystal constantly emits steam and light, lending its strength to those around it.

03802013.name: Azmothian Blood Crystal
03802013.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 20% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nWreathed in steam and crimson light, this crystal fills your soul with newfound power.

03802014.name: Hunter's Talisman
03802014.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 500 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nDemon hunters take any advantage they can get, and this grim keepsake is said to bring them good fortune.

03802015.name: Horrifying Talisman
03802015.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nNo one would think these vicious claws could bring good luck, but demon hunters are cut from a very different cloth.

03802016.name: Fanzy's Energy Tonic
03802016.desc: #cRestores 60 stamina.#\nThe mind is your most precious resource in Azmoth, a fact that led Fanzy to create this mentally-reinforcing draught

03802017.name: Fanzy's Special Tonic
03802017.desc: #cRestores 80 stamina.#\nFanzy's experiences in the chasm may have given him nightmares, but they also allowed him to perfect the formula for his tincture, providing a powerful reinforcement against the withering horrors of Azmoth.

03802018.name: 10 Boogies's Evidence Sack
03802018.desc: #cGrants a chance to get an epic chasm item.#\n10 Boogies has been gathering up all kinds of suspicious items to report on. Surely there must be something worthwhile here...

03802019.name: 10 Boogies's Special Evidence Sack
03802019.desc: #cGrants a chance to get a unique chasm item.#\n10 Boogies set this particular sack of questionable items aside, which suggests there may be especially good stuff inside.

03802020.name: Azmothian Alchemy Crystal
03802020.desc: #cRestores 60 stamina.#\nSomething must have shocked this red crystal into forming, given its strange shape. The vital energies radiating from it are definitely stranger still.

03802021.name: Forbidden Alchemy Crystal
03802021.desc: #cRestores 80 stamina.#\nThe life energy seeping from this crystal is powerful enough to seriously question how such a thing could be made...and what the cost of that process could have been.

03802022.name: Coliseum Booster
03802022.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 15% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThe blue crystal inside this bottle vaporizes when exposed to air, and whatever power it contains transfers to those around it.

03802023.name: Red Coliseum Booster
03802023.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 20% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nWhatever this red crystal is, it fills you with seemingly unholy strength once unbottled.

03802024.name: Azrael's Note
03802024.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 500 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nAzrael collected his thoughts about Azmoth's structure here, which could be quite valuable to the expedition.

03802025.name: Azrael's Journal
03802025.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nWith more experiences to draw on, Azrael outlined nearly the full scope of Azmoth in this extensive journal. The information within is absolutely invaluable.

03802026.name: Azmothian Silver Coin
03802026.desc: A #ccoin# featuring a portrait of a horned individual. Who knows how valuable this could be?

03802027.name: Azmothian Gold Coin
03802027.desc: A #ccoin# featuring a portrait of a horned individual. Who knows how valuable this could be?

03802028.name: Magatia's Support
03802028.desc:
The alchemists of Magatia have spared no expense to support the exploration of Azmoth Chasm. You may not know exactly what this experimental potion will do... but you're pretty sure it'll be beneficial.
#cGrants a chance to get one of the following effects:
- Prevents HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once.
- Prevents HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once, and increases Final Damage by 10%.
- Grants a chance to get an epic chasm item.
- Grants a chance to get a unique chasm item.
- Increases Final Damage by 15% or 20% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.
- Increases points earned by 500 or 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.
- Recovers 50 or 60 Resistance.#

03802041.name: <Ride or Die> Legion Block
03802041.desc: It's a <Ride or Die> Legion Block.

03802042.name: Chilling Gaze
03802042.desc: There's a chill running down your spine, as if you're watched by hungry eyes...\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802043.name: Bloody-legged Spider
03802043.desc: Come on closer, won't you please, so we can dance and we can feast?\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802044.name: Old Cobweb
03802044.desc: The best thing about decorating with cobwebs is how, if you wait long enough, they'll hang themselves up.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802045.name: Dark Socks
03802045.desc: In the Dark Maplemas dimension, we only like to wear socks when they're wet.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802046.name: Broken Gingerbread Man
03802046.desc: A broken gingerbread men, doing his best to hold it all together.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802047.name: Melted Candle
03802047.desc: This half-melted candle has shed its eerie light on many a dark and dreadful Maplemas night.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802048.name: Sour Candy Cane
03802048.desc: This made with the finest spoiled peppermint Maple World had to offer.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802049.name: Black Cat
03802049.desc: There's nothing cuter than a cat's mischief and nothing scarier than its malice.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802050.name: Slay Bell
03802050.desc: If you listen carefully, the ringing noise it makes sounds like a scream.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802051.name: Growling Maw
03802051.desc: Be careful with your fingers when hanging this one up, unless you think you have too many.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

03802159.name: Mysterious Glowing Pouch
03802159.desc: #cAfter returning from an expedition and claiming rewards, grants an item according to set probability.#\nA pouch bursting with a mysterious light, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars.

03802164.name: Mysterious Stopwatch
03802164.desc: #cAfter returning from an expedition, reduces expedition time by 5%.#\nA stopwatch that shines with a mysterious light, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. You get the feeling that it can speed up time.

03802165.name: Mysterious Blue Stopwatch
03802165.desc: #cAfter returning from an expedition, reduces expedition time by 10%.#\nA stopwatch that shines with a mysterious blue light, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. You get the feeling that it can speed up time.

03802166.name: Mysterious Purple Stopwatch

03802169.name: Blessed Dice
03802169.desc: #c+3 to Dice Total during the expedition#\nDice empowered by the glow of a mysterious blessing, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. Holding them in your hand lifts your spirits.

03802170.name: Blessed Blue Dice
03802170.desc: #c+6 to Dice Total during the expedition#\nDice empowered by the blue glow of a mysterious blessing, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. Holding them in your hand lifts your spirits.

03802173.name: Blessed Green Dice
03802173.desc: #c+15 to Dice Total during the expedition#\nDice empowered by the green glow of a mysterious blessing, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. Holding them in your hand lifts your spirits.

03802174.name: Swift-Rolling Dice
03802174.desc: #c+1.2 to Final Multiplier during the expedition#\nDice that glow with a roll-boosting light, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. You can feel them trying to roll themselves in your hand.

03802175.name: Swift-Rolling Blue Dice

03802179.desc: #c-1 to Dice Total and +1.6 to Final Multiplier during the expedition#\nDice glowing with a cutting light, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. They press into your hand painfully.

03802184.name: Holy Rollers
03802184.desc: #c+1 to Dice Total and +1.4 to Final Multiplier during the expedition#\nDice radiating a holy light, discovered by Roro and a team of Familiars. They hover a few inches above your hand as you hold them.

03802189.name: Frontier Coin
03802189.desc: #cCan be used in the Familiar Frontier Shop.#\nA coin brought back from an expedition by Roro and a team of Familiars. It can be exchanged for various items in the Familiar Shop.

03802210.name: Academic Lineage
03802210.desc: #cRound Difficulty decreased by 20% upon exploration. Disappears when 1 exploration is complete.#\nA special effect obtained by exploring Maple University.

03994573.name: Windy Gale Gourd

03994574.name: Thunder Ground

03994575.name: Crackly Thunder Gourd
03994575.desc: A gourd filled with Tempest [Thunder] energy. Take it to Cassandra.

03994581.name: Buff Freezer x 5

03994582.name: Nero's Purrfect Purchase Palace x 5

03994583.name: Hair Color Coupon (REG)

03994584.name: Royal Vacation Hair Coupon

03994585.name: Mermaid Mirror x 2

03994586.name: Fusion Anvil
03994586.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. Win it to receive a Fusion Anvil that allows you to change the appearance of equipment.

03994587.name: House Wedding Ticket
03994587.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. Win it to receive a House Wedding Ticket.

03994588.name: Item Megaphone x 3
03994588.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. Win it to receive three Item Megaphones.

03994589.name: Lv. 20 Weapon Bypass Key
03994589.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. Win it to receive a Weapon Bypass Key that allows you to equip weapons that are up to 20 levels higher than you.

03994590.name: Lv. 20 Armor Bypass Key x 4
03994590.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. Win it to receive four Armor Bypass Keys that allow you to equip armors that are up to 20 levels higher than you.

03994591.name: Owl of Minerva x 3
03994591.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. Win it to receive an Owl of Minerva that allows you to easily search for an item at the market.

03994592.name: 1,000,000 Maple Points
03994592.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. You can receive Maple Points, which can be used to purchase cash items at the Cash Shop.

03994593.name: 500,000 Maple Points
03994593.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. You can receive Maple Points, which can be used to purchase cash items at the Cash Shop.

03994594.name: 100,000 Maple Points
03994594.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. You can receive Maple Points, which can be used to purchase cash items at the Cash Shop.

03994595.name: 50,000 Maple Points
03994595.desc: Prize from the Tempest Festival event. You can receive Maple Points, which can be used to purchase cash items at the Cash Shop.

03994596.name: Dice

03994597.name: Brain Wave Recorder
03994597.desc: Brain-wave measuring device that Bruce placed on monsters to research their behavior before the rain.

03994598.name: Gentle Breeze Fan
03994598.desc: Mar the Fairy's treasured leaf fan. One swing of the fan and you will feel a gentle forest freeze!

03994599.name: Foreverfreeze Ice
03994599.desc: Rock-hard ice from the Ice Pillar. It won't melt no matter how hot the weather is.

03994600.name: Windy's Wind Gourd
03994600.desc: Wind Gourd that Lisa requested for Windy the Wind Fairy. Gourd has 'To my friend Windy..." on it. It's pretty Windy.

03994608.name: Ghost Sheet Music
03994608.desc: A score used by a ghost that appears in the Music Room. It has a total of 13 pages.

03994609.name: Assembly Microphone
03994609.desc: Microphone that the principal uses during assembly.

03994610.name: Repair Tool
03994610.desc: Repair tool that the repairman uses to repair school properties.

03994618.name: Disorderly Student Name Tag
03994618.desc: Name tag of delinquent students that violated school rules.

03994619.name: Grin's Sad Ring
03994619.desc: A ring that's lost it's particularly dark powers.

03994620.name: Grin's Awesome Ring
03994620.desc: A dark ring full of awesome dark powers.

03994621.name: Jug of Contaminated Water
03994621.desc: Stay logged in for 30 minutes to purify the water within.

03994622.name: Jug of Clean Water
03994622.desc: A nice jug of cool clean water for the people of Rwanda. Take it back to Cassandra so she can get it into the right hands!

03994623.name: Cosmos Flower
03994623.desc: A cosmos flower. Stay logged in for 30 minutes with this and Cassandra will give you a Star Stamp.

03994635.name: Yut Stick Set
03994635.desc: A set of sticks for the Game of Yut. Each game of Yut requires one set. You can stack up to #c99# in your Set-up tab, and collect up to #c80# each day.

03994636.name: Sports Drink
03994636.desc: A sports drink that gets absorbed faster than water. It's made of electrolytes and stuff.

03994637.name: Frozen Sports Drink
03994637.desc: A refreshingly slushy sports drink. It's got what plants and people crave!

03994638.name: Homecoming Spicy Roll
03994638.desc: A fiery red rice cake. It's so spicy!

03994639.name: Homecoming Ricey Roll
03994639.desc: A yummy rice roll made with many tasty ingredients.

03994640.name: Homecoming Butter Squid
03994640.desc: Fragrant and mouth watering Buttery Roasted Squid.

03994646.name: Flask of Death
03994646.desc: Cassandra needs [Other Ether] to perform her divinations. Stay online with this for 30 minutes to fill it up.

03994647.name: Full Flask of Death
03994647.desc: Flask full of [Other Ether]. Take this to the Cassandra.

03994648.name: Faded Moon Picture
03994648.desc: Baby Moon Bunny's most cherished possession, an old picture of the moon. Hold this in your Set-up tab for 30 minutes to clear it up.

03994649.name: Restored Moon Picture
03994649.desc: Baby Moon Bunny's most cherished possession, all cleared up and ready to return.

03994650.name: Boo Buddy Candy
03994650.desc: Give this to your friends, or strangers, or anybody with a sweet tooth! #cRight-click on another player to access the [Give Halloween Candy] menu#.

03994656.name: Failed Test Paper
03994656.desc: A crumpled old test paper that says, '0 points for magic knowledge. See me after class!' It looks really old.

03994657.name: Dropped Diary
03994657.desc: This old diary is covered in the writings of a scared young student.

03994658.name: Signature Tablet
03994658.desc: A slate that contains the signatures of all students who agree to the closing of the school.

03994659.name: Sealed Emblem
03994659.desc: A puzzling Sealed Emblem that has the words, 'Everyone I miss, don't forget about the October with a full moon.'

03994660.name: Party Outfit Box
03994660.desc: A box full of fancy party clothes. Too bad it's locked up so tight.

03994661.name: Cygnus's Love Letter
03994661.desc: A letter supposedly full of Cygnus's Love. You really want to open it.

03994662.name: Post-Seasoned Chicken
03994662.desc: Chicken tossed in a special spicy blend, then deep fried. Perfect for watching Maple Post Season.

03994663.name: Ghastly Purple Letter
03994663.desc: A strange purple letter dropped by one of Maple Castle's ghosts.

03994664.name: Party Outfit Box
03994664.desc: A box full of fancy party clothes. Too bad it's locked up so tight.

03994665.name: Empty Nova Bottle
03994665.desc: A glass bottle from Cassandra. Stay logged in for 30 min to fill it with soul.

03994666.name: Full Nova Bottle
03994666.desc: A bottle filled with soul after staying logged in for 30 minutes. Take this to Cassandra.

03994667.name: Jewel Ticket Scrap
03994667.desc: A piece of a Jewel Pop Ticket. Collect enough, and you can tape them together to make a complete ticket.

03994668.name: Leafy Clover
03994668.desc: Lucky clover leaf. Keep it with you for 30 minutes to receive the luck of the clover.

03994670.name: Rosey Marble
03994670.desc: Hold on to the Rosey Marble you got from Cassandra for 1 hour to turn it into a Heartshaker Marble. Be careful not to log out during that time or the marble will disappear.

03994671.name: Heartshaker Marble
03994671.desc: The Rosey Marble from Cassandra has turned into a Heartshaker Marble. Whose love is in this marble?

03994673.name: Yellow Maple Leaf
03994673.desc: Hold on to this Yellow Maple Leaf from Cassandra for 30 minutes to change it to Red Maple Leaf. Be careful not to log out during that time or the maple leaf will disappear.

03994674.name: Red Autumn Maple Leaf
03994674.desc: Red maple leaf full of fall colors. Autumn in Maple World is beautiful!

03994675.name: Snow Shovel
03994675.desc: Shovel snow, shovel gravel, shovel just about anything! Warning: you'll lose this when you log out!

03994676.name: Hand Warmer
03994676.desc: Your hands could always be warmer. Warning: you'll lose this when you log out!

03994677.name: Cup of Ramen
03994677.desc: Dirt cheap and filled with a week's worth of sodium. Warning: you'll lose this when you log out!

03994685.name: Clonesicle
03994685.desc: A popsicle just enough for one person. If you keep it for 30 minutes without logging out, it will double in size!

03994686.name: Double Popsicle
03994686.desc: A popsicle you can share with someone. Double the love, double the joy!

03994687.name: Number 2
03994687.desc: Number 2 for celebrating the new year.

03994688.name: Number 0
03994688.desc: Number 0 for celebrating the new year.

03994690.name: Number 5
03994690.desc: Number 5 for celebrating the new year.

03994691.name: Young Sun
03994691.desc: A young sun ready to become an adult sun. Feels very sunny.

03994713.name: Slime Figurine
03994713.desc: A slime statue for collectors. Drag into Cassandra's Collection.

03994716.name: Hare Figurine

03994718.name: Fancy Stone

03994719.name: Pigmy Cage
03994719.desc: A cage built just right for Pigmys. The little fellow in here might even be the same one the Maple Admin is looking for!

03994720.name: Clara's Valentine's Day Coin

03994721.name: Chocolate Piece
03994721.desc: Left over Valentine's Day chocolate pieces. These were left EVERYWHERE--the clean up is going to be a mess...

03994722.name: Cassandra's Tiny Shoes

03994723.name: Fine Sifter
03994723.desc: A sieve usually used to strain things. The sheer number of holes should keep the Glowing Ghost preoccupied for hours.

03994724.name: Cassandra's New Shoes

03994725.name: Nappy Shoes
03994725.desc: A gently-used pair of shoes. #cYou might lose these if you log out#.

03994726.name: Lightweight Tree Branch

03994728.name: Bright Feather
03994728.desc: A bright feather from a bird that has not been identified. Take it over to the Maple Admin.

03994742.name: Rainbow Fish
03994742.desc: [For Exhibition Only] Not really a rainbow, because it's missing blue AND purple. What a liar.

03994743.name: Blowfish
03994743.desc: [For Exhibition Only] So adorable, so puffy, so fat, so extremely poisonous.

03994744.name: Clown Fish
03994744.desc: [For Exhibition Only] Also called the 'least likely to succeed fish'.

03994745.name: Golden Fish
03994745.desc: [For Exhibition Only] It's not wrong to bite one of these to see if they're genuine. Just wait until the person who gave it to you is gone.

03994746.name: Tuna Can
03994746.desc: [For Exhibition Only] A can of tuna. It's not really the museum's best piece.

03994747.name: Poppin Fish
03994747.desc: [For Exhibition Only] It keeps doing that arm thing, only with fins.

03994748.name: Breakin Fish
03994748.desc: [For Exhibition Only] It just keeps spinning on its head.

03994749.name: Lockin Fish
03994749.desc: [For Exhibition Only] You are a fish, not a robot! Silly fish.

03994750.name: Bamboo Spear
03994750.desc: [For Exhibition Only] Extremely dangerous and environmentally friendly.

03994751.name: Frozen Tuna
03994751.desc: [For Exhibition Only] This totally isn't just some accidental leftover from that time the janitor kicked out the power at the Marine Museum.

03994753.name: Lovely Blade
03994753.desc: [For Exhibition Only] It's so absurdly adorable, you just want to cut something.

03994754.name: Swanky Sword
03994754.desc: [For Exhibition Only] A famous swordsman once bought this from a guy for way too much and then had to pawn it.

03994755.name: Golden Pot Lid
03994755.desc: [For Exhibition Only] A lid from the legendary golden ramen pot. A perfect weapon for grandmas.

03994756.name: Toughguy Suit
03994756.desc: [For Exhibition Only] Can clothes be a weapon? No. That's ridiculous.

03994757.name: Salamander Cestus
03994757.desc: [For Exhibition Only] The blacksmith who made this was terribly fond of amphibians.

03994758.name: Heart Wand
03994758.desc: [For Exhibition Only] Moon prism-- wait, no, wrong one.

03994759.name: Gingerbread Man
03994759.desc: [For Exhibition Only] A Gingerbread Man so realistic, you'll probably end up eating this before it makes it to the museum.

03994760.name: Chocolate Heart
03994760.desc: [For Exhibition Only] Don't tell anybody, but there's an actual human heart inside that heart. Gross... yet tasty.

03994761.name: Gingerbread Lady
03994761.desc: [For Exhibition Only] She just might come to life. Hopefully she's not super evil.

03994762.name: Chocolate Cake

03994763.name: Han Gwa Set
03994763.desc: [For Exhibition Only] There's some legend about a crow or something, but mostly these are just cookies.

03994764.name: Mochi Ice Cream

03994766.name: Chiffon Cake

03994767.name: Cookie Ultimo
03994767.desc: [For Exhibition Only] A chef at a 5-star hotel made this cookie. Other cookies taste like garbage in comparison.

03994802.name: Fully-baked Gingerbread Cookie
03994802.desc: Take this to the Gingerbread Man. Do your best not to eat it on the way there... they're friends.

03994820.name: Crumpled Paper

03994821.name: Maple Tree Seed

03994862.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave. /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Grave Wild Boars.
