03994863.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave.  /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Masks.

03994864.name: A Piece of Guardian's Shield: C2
03994864.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave. /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Grave Stone Masks.

03994865.name: A Piece of Guardian's Shield: C3
03994865.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave. /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Grave Wooden Masks.

03994866.name: A Piece of Guardian's Shield: D1
03994866.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave. /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Golems.

03994867.name: A Piece of Guardian's Shield: D2
03994867.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave. /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Grave Dark Golems.

03994868.name: A Piece of Guardian's Shield: D3
03994868.desc: Collecting all 12 Pieces, you can go to the Reality of Grave. /n#cA rare piece discovered from the Grave Golems.

03994869.name: Cold Winter Bean Sherbet
03994869.desc: A bowl full of shaved ice topped with sweet, delicious bean paste. Beat the cold of winter with chilly ice and sweet beans!

03994870.name: Blazing Sun
03994870.desc: A little bit of stored winter sunlight. The only thing that can fight the bone-chilling cold in Maple World.

03994871.name: Stolen Goose Egg
03994871.desc: The farm owner claims this goose egg was stolen from him. You can't tell if it's real or not. Why is he obsessing over this egg?

03994872.name: Blue Sky Fan
03994872.desc: A fan that blows a cool breeze. Stay logged in for 15 minutes with this item in your inventory and you'll get a Star Stamp from Cassandra.

03994873.name: Lovely Warmth
03994873.desc: A thermometer bearing the mommy chicken's love. Maybe this will wake up the sleepy egg.

03994875.name: Invisible Friend
03994875.desc: A lonely friend who is often forgotten, even when they've been standing around for a solid 10 minutes.

03994876.name: Shy Friend
03994876.desc: A lonely friend who even hides their face from new people.

03994877.name: Timid Friend
03994877.desc: A lonely friend who is always careful.

03994878.name: Crushed Can
03994878.desc: This can must be recycled in the metal recycling bin.

03994879.name: Empty Plastic Bottle
03994879.desc: This bottle must be recycled in the plastic recycling bin.

03994880.name: Crumpled Newspaper
03994880.desc: This newspaper must be recycled in the paper recycling bin.

03994881.name: Commerci Seal Stamp
03994881.desc: A seal stamp with the Commerci Republic's emblem engraved into it. Get them from Commerci monsters.

03994882.name: Dawnveil Ancient Document
03994882.desc: An ancient document containing records of Dawnveil. But there's no telling if it's real.

03994883.name: Commerci Soap
03994883.desc: A special soap made in Commerci.

03994884.name: Glasses
03994884.desc: A pair of handmade spectacles from the artisans in the Rosa region.

03994885.name: Black Pepper
03994885.desc: A specialty of the Rosa Region.

03994886.name: Canned Fish
03994886.desc: Canned fish made with fish imported from Rien Harbor. Made in Commerci.

03994887.name: Iridescent Scale
03994887.desc: A pretty sea monster scale with five colors.

03994890.name: Moneta Root
03994890.desc: A rare herb native only to Dawnveil.

03994891.name: Medicinal Kettle
03994891.desc: A kettle manufactured for a visitor from afar.

03994892.name: Unknown Map
03994892.desc: A map held by the legendary Grosso Polpo.

03994893.name: Sweet Honey
03994893.desc: A pot full of natural honey. Some Honey Water is in order!

03994907.name: Promise Token
03994907.desc: This is proof of your promises together. Keep this with you and stay logged in for 15 minutes to get a Star Stamp from Cassandra.

03994909.name: Closed Magic Pocket Pouch
03994909.desc: The Magic Pocket Pouch is closed tight. It will open after you spend 30 minutes with the pendant.

03994910.name: Open Magic Pocket Pouch
03994910.desc: The Magic Pocket Pouch opened after 30 minutes with the pendant. Talk to the spirit to get your reward.

03994917.name: Sengoku Jewel
03994917.desc: A mystical jewel that slowly accumulates energy. It fills after 30 minutes.

03994918.name: Empowered Sengoku Jewel
03994918.desc: This jewel is filled to bursting with energy.

03994932.name: Isis's Empty Bottle
03994932.desc: Have Isis's Empty Bottle to fill it with Resurrection Elixir of Isis.

03994933.name: Resurrection Elixir of Isis
03994933.desc: A fancy bottle that can resurrect Osiris.

03994934.name: Gale Gourd
03994934.desc: A gourd that can capture the Hot Summer [Wind] that blew into Maple World. Stay logged in for 20 minutes with this in your inventory to fill it up.

03994935.name: Windy Gale Gourd
03994935.desc: A gourd filled with Hot Summer [Wind] energy. Take it to Cassandra.

03994978.name: Attack on Titan Surprise Random Stamp
03994978.desc: A stamp you can get from recycling your items from the Attack on Titan Surprise Style Box. Collect 11 stamps to exchange them for a special Surprise Style Box!

03994979.name: Attack on Titan Real Goods Draw Ball
03994979.desc: A random draw ball to participate in the Attack on Titan Real Goods Gift campaign.

03994981.name: Rudolph Christmas Stocking
03994981.desc: After praying for 30 minutes with the Christmas Stocking, Rudolph will appear.

03994982.name: Dry Grass
03994982.desc: Hold onto this for 30 minutes and the Dry Grass will turn it into Grass Dew. It's so delicate it will disappear if you log out.

03994983.name: Grass Dew
03994983.desc: Give it to Typhon before it disappears!

03994988.name: Mysterious Rose Seedling
03994988.desc: Keep the Mysterious Rose Seeding for 30 minutes and it will become a Bloomed Rose.

03994989.name: Bloomed Rose
03994989.desc: You kept the Mysterious Rose Seedling for 30 minutes and it became a Bloomed Rose.

03994992.name: Dull Flame Orb
03994992.desc: It's a mysterious Dull Flame Orb that glows dimly. Hold on to it for 20 minutes and it will transform into a Shining Flame Orb. But be warned, it will vanish if you log out.

03994993.name: Shining Flame Orb
03994993.desc: It's the Shining Flame Orb requested by the Fireworks Merchant. Be warned, it will vanish if you log out.

03996002.name: Yakuza Soldier's Shoes
03996002.desc: The black shoes of a Yakuza Soldier. They're quite worn.

03996003.name: Yakuza Grunt's Girdle
03996003.desc: A green girdle used by Yakuza Grunts in the vain hope of blocking knives to the gut.

03996004.name: Yakuza Bruiser's Baseball Bat
03996004.desc: A Yakuza Bruiser's baseball bat covered in dents and red splotches. It doesn't seem like it's been used for baseball.

03996005.name: Yakuza Enforcer's Jacket
03996005.desc: A Yakuza Enforcer's sleek black jacket.

03996006.name: Fire Raccoon Finance's Secret Ledger
03996006.desc: A secret ledger filled with Fire Raccoon Finance's financial secrets. Deliver it to Pipopa.

03996007.name: Spring Flower Seed
03996007.desc: A precious seed that tells you spring is here! Hold this in your Inventory for 10 minutes and then return to Cassandra for a Star Stamp.

03996018.name: Power Condenser
03996018.desc: Karula's custom Power Condenser. Keep it with you for 30 minutes to fill it with potent powers. It might disappear if you log out during that time so be careful.

03996019.name: Charged Condenser
03996019.desc: A Power Condenser filled with potent power.

03996022.name: Frozen Key
03996022.desc: A Frozen Key with which you can open the EU & SEA Cross Treasure Box.

03996023.name: Treasure Box Key
03996023.desc: A key with which you can open the EU & SEA Cross Treasure Box. However, you first need to check whether the ice has melted.

03996024.name: Closed Magic Pocket Pouch
03996024.desc: The Magic Pocket Pouch is closed tight. It will open after you spend 3 hours as Pink Bean.

03996025.name: Open Magic Pocket Pouch
03996025.desc: The Magic Pocket Pouch has opened after spending 3 hours as Pink Bean! Open the Movie Synopsis to get your rewards.

03996033.name: Clear Fatigue Meter
03996033.desc: The Clear Fatigue Meter has become murkier after 30 minutes.

03996034.name: Murky Fatigue Meter
03996034.desc: 프리미엄PC방에서 접속 시간이 30분이 지나 피로 측정기가 탁해졌다. NPC 린과 대화를 통해 피로 측정기도 교환하고 맞는 보상도 받아가자.

03996035.name: High-powered Clear Fatigue Meter
03996035.desc: When you are connected with the Clear Fatigue Meter for more than 60 minutes, it becomes more and more murky.

03996036.name: High-power Murky Fatigue Meter
03996036.desc: 프리미엄PC방에서 접속 시간이 60분이 지나 피로 측정기가 탁해졌다. NPC 린과 대화를 통해 피로 측정기도 교환하고 맞는 보상도 받아가자.

03996037.name: M
03996037.desc: It's a squishy letter M for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996038.name: A
03996038.desc: It's a squishy letter A for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996039.name: S
03996039.desc: It's a squishy letter S for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996040.name: T
03996040.desc: It's a squishy letter T for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996041.name: E
03996041.desc: It's a squishy letter E for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996042.name: R
03996042.desc: It's a squishy letter R for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996043.name: I
03996043.desc: It's a squishy letter I for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996044.name: A
03996044.desc: It's a squishy letter A for completing the weekday mission!\r\n#cMake sure it's in your inventory when you go to get your Meister's Cubes on the weekend.\r\n(You MUST trade these letters in to get the Meister's Cubes!)#

03996048.name: Wish Upon a Star Letter
03996048.desc: This is a letter with a wish-upon-a-star written on it. Stay logged in for 15 minutes with this item in your inventory and you'll get a Star Stamp from Cassandra.

03996055.name: Empty Glass Bottle
03996055.desc: An empty glass bottle from the fortune teller. Keep it close for 30 minutes to transfer energy into it.

03996056.name: Positive Energy Bottle
03996056.desc: A glass bottle filled with warm, positive energy. You can now turn in the fortune teller's quest.

03996057.name: Passage Notes
03996057.desc: Keep this book with you while staying in the game for 60 minutes or more to automatically fill in what you did.\r\nIt will disappear if you log out.

03996058.name: Handwritten Passage Notes
03996058.desc: Take this completed book to the passage!

03996059.name: Passageway  Notes
03996059.desc: Keep this pocket book with you while staying in the game for 180 minutes or more to automatically fill in what you did. It will disappear if you log out.

03996060.name: Handwritten Passageway  Notes
03996060.desc: Take this pocket book, with what you did written inside, to the passageway!

03996069.name: Closed Energy Pocket Pouch
03996069.desc: A tightly closed Energy Pocket Pouch. It will open after you spend some time logged in.

03996070.name: Open Energy Pocket Pouch
03996070.desc: You've opened the Energy Pocket Pouch! Talk to Lyn via the notifier on the left.

03996071.name: Too Rare Meat
03996071.desc: This meat is not fully cooked yet. Keep hold of it #cfor 15 minutes# to cook it to perfection.\n#cThis item will disappear when you log out.#

03996072.name: Yummy Meat
03996072.desc: Fully cooked, delicious-smelling meat. Pink Bean Santa would probably love it.\n#cThis item will disappear when you log out.#

03996088.name: Holiday Dice
03996088.desc: Dice used for the Holiday Event. You can throw as many dice as you have in your Set-up tab for the board game.

03996089.name: Delicious Sandwich
03996089.desc: A sandwich stolen from Mrs. Ming Ming. Children supposedly love it.

03996090.name: Hot Rice Ball
03996090.desc: A Rice Rall stolen from Mrs. Ming Ming. It's still hot.

03996091.name: Yellow Balloon
03996091.desc: A floaty balloon that Checky was SUPPOSED to give to the kids.

03996092.name: Red Balloon
03996092.desc: A floaty balloon that Checky was SUPPOSED to give to the kids.

03996093.name: Green Balloon
03996093.desc: A floaty balloon that Checky was SUPPOSED to give to the kids.

03996094.name: Seedling
03996094.desc: A seedling needed to participate in the tree planting event.

03996095.name: Plane Ticket
03996095.desc: A plane ticket to a super luxurious resort.

03996096.name: Festival Sack
03996096.desc: A heavy sack. Hold onto it for 15 minutes and see what happens.\n#cThis item will disappear when you log out.#

03996104.name: Crumpled Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket
03996104.desc: A crumpled Rock-Paper-Scissors ticket. Lil Zakum will exchange it for a whole Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket if you hold on to it for 10 min.\n\n#cThis item will disappear when you log out.#

03996105.name: Crumpled MMF Flyer
03996105.desc: It's a crumpled MMF flyer. Something good might happen if you take it to DJ JM in 30 mins when it's straightened out.

03996106.name: Complimentary Ticket - Hall H
03996106.desc: A complimentary one-time use ticket that permits access to the Henesys show.

03996107.name: Complimentary Ticket - Hall A
03996107.desc: A complimentary one-time use ticket that permits access to the Ariant show.

03996108.name: Complimentary Ticket - Hall T
03996108.desc: A complimentary one-time use ticket that permits access to the Temple of Time show.

03996109.name: Complimentary Ticket - Hall K
03996109.desc: A complimentary one-time use ticket that permits access to the Kerning City show.

03996110.name: Complimentary Ticket - Hall S
03996110.desc: A complimentary one-time use ticket that permits access to the Sleepywood show.

03996111.name: Complimentary Ticket - Hall H
03996111.desc: A complimentary one-time use ticket that permits access to the Henesys show.

03996112.name: Rainbow Timer
03996112.desc: A timer Cassandra gave you. The display appears to be broken. Better keep it for 1 hour anyways.

03996113.name: Un-crumpled MMF Flyer
03996113.desc: This previously crumpled MMF flyer has mostly been straightened out.

03996114.name: Fireworks Show Invitation Letter
03996114.desc: It's an envelope containing an invitation to the MMF fireworks show. Something good will happen if you check the invitation after 1 hour.

03996115.name: Fireworks Show Invitation Envelope
03996115.desc: An invitation to the MMF Fireworks Show. Take it to DJ JM.

03996116.name: Fireworks Show Invitation Letter
03996116.desc: It's an envelope containing an invitation to the MMF fireworks show. Something good will happen if you check the invitation after 1 hour.

03996117.name: Fireworks Show Invitation Envelope
03996117.desc: An invitation to the MMF Fireworks Show. Take it to DJ JM.

03996118.name: Fireworks Show Invitation Letter
03996118.desc: It's an envelope containing an invitation to the MMF fireworks show. Something good will happen if you check the invitation after 1 hour.

03996119.name: Fireworks Show Invitation Envelope
03996119.desc: An invitation to the MMF Fireworks Show. Take it to DJ JM.

03996120.name: Rainbow Timer
03996120.desc: A timer Cassandra gave you. It shows 60 min. 00 sec.

03996121.name: Wednesday Crayon Piece
03996121.desc: A broken piece of a crayon obtained from the Monster Park. You might be able to combine it more pieces to make a working crayon.

03996122.name: Saturday Crayon Piece
03996122.desc: A broken piece of a crayon obtained from monsters. You might be able to combine it with more pieces.

03996123.name: Ice Nependeath Seed
03996123.desc: It's an Ice Nependeath Seed. It will turn into an Ice Nependeath Sprout if you hold onto it for 30 minutes.

03996124.name: Ice Nependeath Sprout
03996124.desc: Holding the Ice Nependeath Seed for 30 minutes turned it into an Ice Nependeath Sprout.

03996125.name: Frozen Rocket Cookie Basket
03996125.desc: It's a Frozen Rocket Cookie Basket. Hold on to it for 15 minutes to warm up a batch of cookies that alleviate the fatigue of boosting your rocket's size.\n#cThis item will disappear when you log out.#

03996126.name: Rocket Cookie Basket
03996126.desc: Your cookies are ready to eat! Talk to Captain Ovo via the notifier on the left.

03996127.name: Aspire Solar Battery
03996127.desc: A solar battery developed by Aspire Industries. Hold onto it for #c30 minutes# to charge it. \n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996128.name: Charged Solar Battery
03996128.desc: A battery with a built-in solar collector. It's fully charged. \n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996133.name: Closed Rainbow Box
03996133.desc: It's a Closed Rainbow Box. It will open after 15 minutes.\n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996134.name: Open Rainbow Box
03996134.desc: It's an Open Rainbow Box. A shiny rainbow came out of the box.\n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996135.name: Geyser Zone Warning Sign
03996135.desc: A sign warning of erupting geysers. Drop it near a wooden post on Eluna to set it up, or replace a sign that is already set up.

03996136.name: Quicksand Warning Sign
03996136.desc: A sign warning the area contains dangerous quicksand. Drop it near a wooden post on Eluna to set it up, or replace a sign that is already set up.

03996137.name: Deadly Biteysnek Warning Sign
03996137.desc: A sign warning of an infestation of Deadly Biteysneks. #c'In case of emergency, boop the snoot.# Drop it near a wooden post on Eluna to set it up, or replace a sign that is already set up.

03996138.name: Beware of Elemental Sign
03996138.desc: A sign warning of the presence of the deadly Elunite Elemental. Drop it near a wooden post on Eluna to set it up, or replace a sign that is already set up.

03996140.name: Elunarium (ATT & M. ATT)
03996140.desc: Elunarium that enhances#c Attack Power and Magic ATT#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level.

03996141.name: Elunarium (Skill EXP)
03996141.desc: Elunarium that provides#c Bonus EXP for using skills#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level, and from the#c Eluna Prospector's Box#.

03996142.name: Elunarium (Boss Damage)
03996142.desc: Elunarium that enhances#c Boss Damage#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level or #c Elite Bosses#.

03996143.name: Elunarium (Ignore Enemy DEF)
03996143.desc: Elunarium that enhances your#c Ignore Enemy Defense#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level, and from #cMonster Park#.

03996144.name: Elunarium (Crit Rate)
03996144.desc: Elunarium that enhances your#c Critical Rate#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level or#c Elite Monsters#.

03996145.name: Elunarium (Crit Damage)
03996145.desc: Elunarium that enhances#c Critical Damage#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level and from the#c Eluna Prospector's Box#.

03996146.name: Elunarium (Status Resistance)
03996146.desc: Elunarium that enhances#c Status Resistance#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level.

03996147.name: Elunarium (All Stats)
03996147.desc: Elunarium that enhances#c All Stats#. It can be obtained by hunting monsters near your level.

03996148.name: Groovy Smoothie
03996148.desc: Enjoy a Groovy Smoothie for 30 minutes, and fatigue will be a thing of the past! \n#cThis item disappears when you log out.#

03996149.name: Empty Groovy Smoothie
03996149.desc: You're all done with your drink! Talk to Cameow the Cat of All Trades via the notifier on the left.

03996150.name: Empty Battery
03996150.desc: A battery specially developed by Dr. Kim. Keep it for 30 minutes to charge it.\n#cThis item disappears when you log out.#

03996151.name: Charged Battery
03996151.desc: The battery is fully charged. See Dr. Kim for your next assignment.

03996152.name: Eva Repair Alloy
03996152.desc: This is a special alloy necessary for Eva repair.

03996153.name: Faded Eye of Fire
03996153.desc: A dull light barely emanates from the Faded Eye of Fire. This is what Rei is searching for.

03996159.name: 2x Caravan Reward per Round Bonus Ticket (7 Days)
03996159.desc: A limited-time bonus ticket that doubles final rewards from playing Caravan while it is in your inventory.

03996160.name: 2x Boss Julieta Reward per Round Bonus Ticket (7 Days)
03996160.desc: A limited-time bonus ticket that doubles final rewards from playing Boss Julieta while it is in your inventory.

03996161.name: Heart of the Eyeful
03996161.desc: The Eyeful and the people of Abrup are anxiously awaiting your return to MONAD: The First Omen Act 3. They need a hero. Hold the Heart of the Eyeful and the Hope of Abrup's People for 30 minutes, and your connection will become stronger than ever, earning you an Earnest Heart!

03996162.name: Earnest Heart
03996162.desc: An Earnest Heart can only earned by holding both the Heart of the Eyeful and the Hope of Abrup's People for 30 minutes while you are waiting for MONAD: The First Omen Act 3.

03996163.name: Groovy Smoothie
03996163.desc: If you can gulp down this Groovy Smoothie in 30 minutes, fatigue will be a thing of the past! \n#cThis item disappears when you log out.#

03996164.name: Empty Groovy Smoothie
03996164.desc: You're all done with your drink! Talk to Beowoof via the notifier on the left.

03996165.name: Glacial Determination
03996165.desc: A glacial chunk of determination. Give it some time to melt, and you'll get Nature's Determination.

03996166.name: Nature's Determination
03996166.desc: The frigid determination to resist the powers of darkness

03996167.name: Small Cloud Pufflet
03996167.desc: A Small Cloud given to you by Cloudie. Nurture it and help it grow for 30 minutes, and when it has grown big enough, you can return it.

03996168.name: Big Cloud Puff
03996168.desc: The cloud you've been nurturing looks like it has grown from a small pufflet into a very respectable puff! You should return it to Cloudie.

03996169.name: Unfinished Music Sheet
03996169.desc: Hold onto this for 15 min to gather the surrounding sound and complete a music sheet. However, it will disappear if you log-out, so be careful.

03996170.name: Completed Music Sheet
03996170.desc: A music sheet meant to be finished by gathering the surrounding sound. Take it to the Bard to complete the Fantastic Melody.

03996195.name: Pot of Meat
03996195.desc: A meat dish prepared by Ram, the lunch committee member. It needs to cook for 15 minutes before it's ready. Return it to Ram once it's fully cooked.

03996196.name: Pot of Cooked Meat
03996196.desc: A meat dish prepared by Ram, the lunch committee member. It looks like it's finished cooking. Take it to Ram.

03996201.name: Frozen Awakening Coin
03996201.desc: So Gong has entrusted you with this coin. Keep it in your inventory for 30 minutes, and once the ice completely melts, return it to him.

03996202.name: Awakening Coin
03996202.desc: An Awakening Coin you've earned, now with all the ice around it melted. Find So Gong and return it to him.

03996203.name: Sealed Star Energy
03996203.desc: An object which supposedly has great stores of star energy sealed within. Hold onto it for 1 hour to free the energy inside.

03996204.name: Liberated Star Energy
03996204.desc: The star energy has been completely liberated. Take it to So Gong.

03996205.name: Moonlight Bottle (Empty)
03996205.desc: An empty bottle for collecting moonlight energy. \r\n\r\n#cIf you hold onto this item for 15 minutes, it'll fill up with moonlight.#

03996206.name: Moonlight Bottle (Full)
03996206.desc: This bottle is now filled with moonlight. Take it to Wonky.

03996209.name: Crescent Moon Box
03996209.desc: It's a Crescent Moon Box. It will open after 15 minutes.\n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996210.name: Full Moon Box
03996210.desc: It's an Open Box. A full moon came out of the box.\n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996211.name: Extinguished Flame
03996211.desc: An Extinguished Flame. It looks like it will smolder for about 15 minutes.\n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996212.name: Burning Flame
03996212.desc: A Burning Flame. You can feel the heat.\n#cThis item disappears upon logging out.#

03996226.name: Blank Parchment
03996226.desc: A blank piece of parchment. Fill it with the know-how of Maple World for 15 minutes.\n#cThis item disappears when you log out.#

03996227.name: Parchment of Know-How
03996227.desc: A piece of parchment filled with the know-how of Maple World. Deliver it to Kazuma.\n#cThis item disappears when you log out.#

04000000.name: Blue Snail Shell
04000000.desc: The blue shell from a poor, almost-defenseless snail.

04000001.name: Orange Mushroom Cap
04000001.desc: A cap removed from a mushroom

04000002.name: Pig's Ribbon
04000002.desc: Taken off from the pig with a ribbon

04000003.name: Tree Branch
04000003.desc: The branch bent away from a tree

04000005.name: Leaf
04000005.desc: The leaf that's taken out of a tree

04009229.desc: This sloppy Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket says #c'teeket'#. Lil Zakum needs some spelling lessons.

04009230.name: Ancient Evil Eye Tail
04009230.desc: A tail of an Evil Eye that used to live in the Ancient Cave. It's glossy and lustrous, unlike the tails of those other loser Evil Eyes.

04009266.name: Skeledog's Bone
04009266.desc: A mysterious bone. You might be able to make a spicy soup with this bone.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid, go ahead!

04009267.name: The Key
04009267.desc: It's a Heart Key which allows you to open the hearts of people who are eating lunch. You could use it to have people change their mind.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

04009268.name: Dinoram Tenderloin
04009268.desc: A thick meat loaf. It looks delicious.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

04009269.name: Tough Dragon Skin
04009269.desc: Very tough monster meat. It's really hard to chew and it tastes like squid.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

04009270.name: Balrog's Seal Stone

04009271.name: Poisonous Mushroom

04009272.name: Leaf

04009273.name: Evil Eye Tail

It looks disgusting, but some say it's pretty delicious.\r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

04009274.name: Free Spirit

This food will literally have 'soul' if you cook with this.r\n\r\nIt's one of the ingredients for the delicious lunch, and #cif you have 3 of them regardless of type, you will be able to make a delicious lunch by double clicking them.#Do not be afraid and go ahead!

04009275.name: Chicken Leg

04009553.desc: A red fruit. It's juicy and highly nutritious. An essential food for the birds living in the forest. Just looking at it whets your appetite.

04009556.desc: A leaf that fell from an Illusionary Raccoon's head as it woke up from its sleep. When there was only one season in the Eternal Forest, the raccoons put it over their head to avoid the sunlight. It glows with the light of summer.

04009557.name: Tangled Spike
04009557.desc: A spike that's hard to see, as it's mixed among the leaves. It seems to have fallen from an Illusionary Hedgehog as it rolled in the bushes. Be careful not to step on it. It could sting.

04009558.name: Bramble Thorn
04009558.desc: A thorn that budded on the Brambles. It seems to have fallen when you defeated them. It's solid and sharp, as if warning others not to approach. But don't ignore it. The more delicate a plant is, the more thorns it will have to hide its weakness.

04034998.desc: A withered-looking olive tree. It appears to have lost all color.

04034999.name: Black Raven Feather
04034999.desc: A raven's feather. It's as black as the night.

04035000.name: Worm
04035000.desc: A worm that inhabits the frozen trees of #cSlumbering Dragon Island#. It's good for #cfishing# bait. They'll squirm away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

04035001.name: Shrimp
04035001.desc: A shrimp that can survive the bitter cold of #cSlumbering Dragon Island#. It's good for #cfishing# bait. They'll flop away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

04035002.name: Golden Worm
04035002.desc: This worm gives off a soft golden light. It's a rare curiosity found only on #cSlumbering Dragon Island#. It's good for #cfishing# bait. It'll squirm away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

04035003.name: Golden Shrimp
04035003.desc: This shrimp has a strange golden shell that makes it nearly unbreakable. Despite that, it's good for #cfishing# bait. It'll flop away when you #clog out# or leave #cSlumbering Dragon Island#.

04035004.name: Diamond
04035004.desc: A diamond synthesized with materials from Slumbering Dragon Island. You can catch rare fish using this as #cfishing bait#.

04035005.name: Hatsar's Golden Shrimp
04035005.desc: A gold shrimp from Hatsar that can be caught in a special oasis. You can exchange them for gold coins.

04036000.name: Adler's White Key
04036000.desc: A white key you received from Adler. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036001.name: Lightning-Touched Wooden Key
04036001.desc: A key discovered inside a tree in the Land of Innocence after a thunderstorm.\r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036002.name: God of Battle's Key
04036002.desc: A key given to you in the Land of Warriors when you were mistaken for the 'God of Battle' in your enlarged state. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036003.name: Golden Key
04036003.desc: A key found among Mansa's treasure-puke pile. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036004.name: Raven Black Key
04036004.desc: A pitch-black key swallowed by a raven. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036005.name: Crystalline Key
04036005.desc: A flashy crystalline key found inside a diary. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036006.name: Cast Iron Key
04036006.desc: A key made of cast iron given to you by Horemheb, the wealthiest person in the Land of Riches. It was the least valuable of his possessions. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036007.name: Yellow Mage's Key
04036007.desc: The Yellow Mage's plastic key. It feels cheap, but it's bursting with malevolent energy. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036008.name: Carved Stone Key
04036008.desc: An old man who carves tombstones carved this key out of stone. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036009.name: Molded Clay Key
04036009.desc: An old man who carves tombstones molded this key from clay. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036010.name: Heart-shaped Key
04036010.desc: A heart-shaped toy key you received from a child in the Land of Innocence. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036011.name: Striped Candy Key
04036011.desc: A key made of striped candy you got from a child in the Land of Innocence. \r\nIt's one of the keys needed to open the Huge Door in the Land of Beginnings.

04036012.name: Color Collector
04036012.desc: A handy-dandy color collector capable of sucking the color right out of a monster.

04036013.name: Filled Color Collector
04036013.desc: The color collector is full of various colors harvested from monsters.

04036014.name: Battle Balrog's Armor
04036014.desc: A sturdy-looking set of Balrog-sized armor.

04036015.name: Brand New Teddy Bear
04036015.desc: A brand new teddy bear from Sunni's store. It's soft and huggable.

04036016.name: Tina's Lost Storybook
04036016.desc: This must be Tina's storybook. It's hard to tell though, as the color is in rough shape.

04036017.name: Emilia's Insignia
04036017.desc: An insignia signifying a candidate for the Kingdom of Lugunica's royal election.

04036018.name: Moral Support
04036018.desc: These heart-shaped gems are commonly given out to encourage individuals to follow their dreams.

04036019.name: Audio Cable

04036020.name: Fruit Jelly Container
04036020.desc: An essential ingredient for making Jelly Juice, the highly-caloric alternative to Bubble Tea.

04036021.name: Note Paper

04036022.name: Smoked Mystery Meat Bone
04036022.desc: This once meaty bone has been picked clean!

04036027.desc: A CD album that could contain a pass to the signing event.

04036028.name: Moral Support
04036028.desc: There heart-shaped gems are commonly given out to encourage individuals to follow their dreams. Giving this to a friend may bring you closer.

04036034.desc: It's a gorgeous, sparkling Diamond. It could be useful against monsters that like shiny things.

04036036.name: Sardine
04036036.desc: This little sardine is precious to the Ice Pepe Siblings, who are gathering tons of them for an unknown purpose.

04036037.name: The Mistress' Icicle
04036037.desc: Once upon a time, a 50-million-year-old icicle was granted life, and became the Mistress of Ice. It's said the icicle formed slowly, growing 0.0001 mm every year. Someone has been writing bits of her legend down on paper and spreading it around. Something amazing will occur when you gather all of the papers and speak the three-digit password.\r\n\r\n#cThere's a number written on the icicle but you can't make it out.#

04036040.name: Snow Rabbit Leaf
04036040.desc: This leaf was once a Snow Rabbit's ear. Didn't anyone tell you? Leaves are murder!

04036041.name: Bottled Blue Flame
04036041.desc: Fogo Azul or one of his lookalikes was sucked into this bottle and trapped.

04036042.name: Black Annis' Staff
04036042.desc: It's a staff once wielded by Black Annis.

04036043.name: Rimos Shorts
04036043.desc: A pair of inexplicably stylish shorts worn by Rimos. They smell a little funky.

04036047.name: Unfinished Stone
04036047.desc: A slab of stone. This ought to work well for carving tombstones.

04036048.name: Strange Snow Crystal
04036048.desc: It's a crystal formed from compacted snow. There seems to be a secret power hidden within it.

04036049.name: Magic Eyepatch
04036049.desc: This magical eyepatch will dispel any fear! As long as it's a fear of heights.

04036050.name: El Nath Unmeltable Ice Shard

04036051.name: Fiendly Flu Medicine
04036051.desc: It's a carrot-flavored cold medicine.\r\nIt's seems to be a miracle cure against the disease the Frost Fiends carry.

04036052.name: Refined Snow Crystal Sample
04036052.desc: A sample refined from 50 Snow Crystals. Who's ready for some science!?

04036053.name: Completing quests for The Afterlands awards 30% Bonus EXP
04036053.desc: The Afterlands are now available! 30% Bonus EXP will be granted for completing all Afterlands quests!

04036054.name: Horn Fragment

04036059.name: Monster-Milk

04036067.desc: It's a sweet-smelling paste made from bean curd. This will make a good filling for steamed buns.

04036068.name: Dream Coin
04036068.desc: A coin you received for taking on Dream Defender. You can trade it for rewards with Mr. Flopsy, the Dreamweaver.

04036069.name: Sweetheart Choco

A sweet chocolate to share with a loved one.
Allegedly, eating this fills you with power and extends your lifespan.
You can eat it using the Choco Syringe.
#c'Valentine's Day is not about sharing chocolate!'"#

04036070.name: Luggage Ticket
04036070.desc: A pass required to board the Mothership with luggage. Good for one personal item and one checked bag weighing up to 15 Quintaflerps.

04036071.name: Signal Jammer
04036071.desc: Blocks radio transmissions by drowning the frequency in signal noise. Particularly useful during invasions.

04036072.name: SpaceCoin
04036072.desc: A currency used by Grays. It's value is unknown.

04036073.name: Gray Popstar Collectible Figurine
04036073.desc: It looks like a model of a Gray Popstar. Alienese scribbled on the toy's stand reads 'Property of Nolyfe.'

04036084.desc: A little star that makes the Christmas tree really shine.

04036085.name: Flashy Ornament
04036085.desc: A bell used to beautify the Christmas tree.

04036086.name: Soft Snow
04036086.desc: Snow that can be heaped decoratively upon the Christmas tree.

04036087.name: Tree Ornament Exchange Box
04036087.desc: A box filled with ornaments to decorate the Christmas tree magnificently.\r\nTake the box to the Christmas tree in town.\r\nYou can get 5 Nova Coins each time you decorate the tree.

04036088.name: Lucky Silk Sack
04036088.desc: It's the silk luck sack the Magpie Trio lost. Return it to Maggie the Magpie.

04036091.name: Ribbon Brooch
04036091.desc: It's a ribbon brooch with a heartrate monitor secretly tucked inside.

04036092.name: Creeper Scarlion's Ribbon
04036092.desc: Ribbon fabric carried by Creeper Scarlions.

04036093.name: Tool Bag
04036093.desc: It's the tool bag that the Jellybus ran off with.

04036094.name: Ribbon Brooch
04036094.desc: It's a ribbon brooch with a heartrate monitor secretly tucked inside.

04036095.name: Love-Filled Chocolate
04036095.desc: Chocolate that Cassandra made with love.

04036096.name: Essence of Water
04036096.desc: The coalesced lifeforce of a Water Spirit.

04036097.name: Essence of Sunlight
04036097.desc: The coalesced lifeforce of a Sun Spirit.

04036098.name: Essence of Earth
04036098.desc: The coalesced lifeforce of an Earth Spirit.

04036099.name: Deathcry
04036099.desc: The final screams of a Toxic Spirit, preserved forever in crystalline form.

04036100.name: Volatile Shriek
04036100.desc: The crystallized shrieks produced in a Volatile Spirit's final moments.

04036101.name: Essence of Water
04036101.desc: The coalesced lifeforce of a Water Spirit.

04036102.name: Essence of Sunlight
04036102.desc: The coalesced lifeforce of a Sun Spirit.

04036103.name: Essence of Earth
04036103.desc: The coalesced lifeforce of an Earth Spirit.

04036104.name: Aspire Visitor's ID
04036104.desc: A visitor ID Badge that allows you to enter the headquarters of Aspire Industries, creators of the #cWondroid#.

04036105.name: Accursed Horn Energy
04036105.desc: Residue from the horns of Magnus. Collect several to remove Kaiserium's Curse.

04036106.name: Rainbow Dew
04036106.desc: A brilliant Rainbow Dew eaten by Orange Mushroom.\r\nYou can drag it to feed Orange Mushroom.

04036107.name: Model 13's Key
04036107.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 13 at #cAspire#.

04036108.name: Model 6's Key
04036108.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 6 at #cAspire#.

04036109.name: Model 82's Key
04036109.desc: A key held by Guardroid Model 82 at #cAspire#.

04036110.name: Work Order
04036110.desc: A work order used for work on the #cWondroid# project at #cAspire Industries#.

04036111.name: Wondroid Research Diary
04036111.desc: A research diary detailing the entire creation and development of the #cWondroid# at #cAspire Industries#.\r\n#c[Classified TOP SECRET]\r\nClearance Level 3#

04036112.name: Rune-Engraved Elunite Crystal
04036112.desc: An Elunite Crystal engraved with alien runes. It feels unlike any other Elunite Crystal you've discovered.

04036113.name: Churmble Specimen
04036113.desc: A research sample harvested from the crystal-coated Eluna lifeform known as a 'Churmble.'

04036114.name: Thalia Floatyfish Specimen
04036114.desc: A research sample from the 'Thalia Floatyfish.' It looks more like a monster than a plant.

04036115.name: Deadly Biteysnek Specimen
04036115.desc: A research sample from the 'Deadly Biteysnek'. It appears to be capable of asexual reproduction at a cellular level, explaining the lifeform's abundance on this planet. Smells like chicken.

04036116.name: Captured Churmble
04036116.desc: Churmble that has been successfully captured and placed in a cage. You feel kind of bad, but science requires sacrifice.

04036117.name: Captured Atlassian Crab
04036117.desc: Atlas that has been successfully captured and put in a cage. That's no drab little crab. It's as shiny as they come.

04036118.name: Spaceflight Research Laboratory Photo
04036118.desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to research spaceflight.

04036119.name: Photo of Water Filtration Facility Ruins
04036119.desc: A photo of a ruined facility that appears to have once been used to extract and purify water.

04036120.name: Sub-Zero Hunt EXP Boost
04036120.desc: You gain a powerful EXP buff when you hunt monsters in the Sub-Zero Hunt.

04036121.name: Dark Residue
04036121.desc: It's a dark residue commonly obtained from the monsters found at Gold Beach.

04036122.name: Old Bone Fragment
04036122.desc: It's an old bone fragment that can be obtained from monsters at the Excavation Site. Despite its shabby appearance, it has great archaeological value.

04036123.name: Drake Tissue Sample
04036123.desc: It's a tissue harvested from a Drake. Apparently it's quite valuable for biological research.

04036124.name: Artificial Organism Tissue Sample
04036124.desc: It's a tissue sample from an artificial organism created by way of alchemy. It could be quite valuable for study.

04036125.name: Mechanical Lifeform Component
04036125.desc: A component from a mechanical lifeform. It appears to have been crafted through the synergy of alchemy and engineering.

04036126.name: Horntail's Evil Energy
04036126.desc: It's an energy commonly found from monsters in Minar Forest influenced by Horntail. How you managed to collect it, only the developers can answer.

04036127.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
04036127.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology. It's calibrated to interface with the data collector in the Swamp Region.

04036128.name: Photo of Stellar Observatory Ruins
04036128.desc: A photo of a ruined structure that appears to have once been used to study the stars.

04036129.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
04036129.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data from the Swamp Region.

04036130.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
04036130.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on Drake monsters.

04036131.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
04036131.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on Drake monsters.

04036132.name: Lidium Sample
04036132.desc: It's the Lidium ore that Eremos asked you to obtain.

04036133.name: Ryuul Mobile Data Collector
04036133.desc: It's a Ryuul data storage device that's been jury-rigged into a mobile data collector. You can use it to record data on the enemies you fight in Ellin Forest.\r\n\r\nApparently it's powered by a micro-singularity, so unless you're looking to destroy two versions of Maple World at once, maybe don't break it.

04036134.name: Zakum Fragment Sample
04036134.desc: It's a fragment of Zakum's statue you collected for Eremos. He seemed eager to analyze it.

04036135.name: Empty Ryuul Data Disk
04036135.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  Use it to collect data on the Minar Forest region.

04036136.name: Full Ryuul Data Disk
04036136.desc: It's a data storage device crafted using advance Ryuul technology.  It's filled with data on the Minar Forest region.

04036137.name: Dry Firewood
04036137.desc: Dry firewood that Volcano Bugs love. It has Volcano Bug droppings on it but still burns okay.

04036138.name: Resin
04036138.desc: Resin that Beetles love. Beetles tend to have mouths sticky with resin.

04036139.name: Mountain Turtle Egg
04036139.desc: The egg of a Mountain Turtle. Don't eat it raw or you'll get a tummy ache!

04036140.name: Cast Iron Plate
04036140.desc: A cast iron plate that used to be part of a Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

04036141.name: Big Nail
04036141.desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Mutant Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

04036142.name: Mutant Hedgehog Fur
04036142.desc: Mutant Hedgehog fur, hidden beneath cast iron plates and big nails.

04036143.name: Nutria Hind Leg
04036143.desc: The hind leg of a Nutria. Melts in your mouth!

04036144.name: Still Fluid
04036144.desc: Fluid from inside a waste drum. Strangely, it doesn't flow.

04036145.name: Unburning Flame
04036145.desc: A flame found inside a waste drum. Strangely, it doesn't burn.

04036146.name: Soft Scrap Iron
04036146.desc: A heap of scrap metal from inside a waste drum. Strangely, it's soft and malleable.

04036147.name: Wiggling Tail
04036147.desc: The wiggling tail of a Specter Stray Dog. It almost seems alive.

04036150.name: Mutant Hedgehog Fur Tuft
04036150.desc: A tuft of fur. You should take it to Coney.

04036151.name: Mutant Nutria Blood
04036151.desc: The blood of a Mutant Nutria. You get the feeling you shouldn't touch it with your bare hands..

04036152.name: Poison Remover
04036152.desc: Used by Mr. Hazard's men to clean their hideout.

04036153.name: Onyx Stonegar Magic Stone
04036153.desc: A stone that absorbs magical energy from Onyx Stonegar.

04036154.name: Decent Wooden Shield
04036154.desc: A wooden shield used by a Specter Shieldbearer. It's fairly big and sturdy.

04036156.name: Yellow Speeyor Fur Coat
04036156.desc: Yellow Speeyor's noble fur coat. Terribly soft.

04036157.name: Dinodon Ribs
04036157.desc: The ribs of a Dinodon. Its chewy texture can't be beat.

04036158.name: Angelic Buster Figurine
04036158.desc: An Angelic Buster Figurine that's rare because it's hand-stamped.

04036159.name: Eurenth's Letter
04036159.desc: A letter from Eurenth that contains information about the Central Region.

04036160.name: Dinogoth Shoulder Meat
04036160.desc: Meat from a Dinogoth's shoulder. Popular item for army supplies.

04036161.name: Hunter's Arena EXP Increase
04036161.desc: You gain a powerful EXP increase buff when you hunt monsters in the Hunter's Arena.

04036162.name: Mechanical Parts
04036162.desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Mutant Hedgehog's body. It could be useful for modding machines.

04036163.name: Grossular Shard
04036163.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Green Grossular.

04036164.name: Amethyst Shard
04036164.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Purple Amethyst.

04036165.name: Dean's Bag
04036165.desc: Dean's bag. It is full of useless junk.

04036166.name: Dean's Notebook
04036166.desc: A notebook's never been used. Dean's name is written crookedly on the back cover.

04036167.name: Pyrope Shard
04036167.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Fire Pyrope.

04036168.name: Obsidian Shard

04036170.desc: A hefty piece of shiny metal. The surface is covered in vines because it was buried in the forest for a long time.

04036171.desc: A small and shiny crystal shard you can get from a Blue Larimar.

04036306.name: Legendary Tier Ingredient: Pinto Bean
04036306.desc: An ingredient destined to be part of a culinary masterpiece for the Absolute Taste event. Can only be used in Legendary Tier food. Open the UI via the NPC or notifier and place it on the ingredient slot.

04036307.name: Legendary Tier Ingredient: Cilantro
04036307.desc: An ingredient destined to be part of a culinary masterpiece for the Absolute Taste event. Can only be used in Legendary Tier food. Open the UI via the NPC or notifier and place it on the ingredient slot.

04036308.name: Master Chef Feedback
04036308.desc: Use these to have your Absolute Taste dish reviewed by the only food critic who counts, Chef Gourdon Ritzy himself. You'll need a new one for every time you get his feedback.

04036311.name: Red Reagent
04036311.desc: A strange red light flickers when you shake it.

04036312.name: Jean's Gift
04036312.desc: Beautiful, but somehow it looks dangerous.

04036315.name: Flutterbuzz Powder
04036315.desc: A fine, glittering powder found on Flutterbuzz monsters in Fox Forest.

04036316.name: Pom Puff Leaf
04036316.desc: A soft, pulpy leaf found on Pom Puff Bush monsters in Fox Forest.

04036317.name: Nettled Squirrel Tree Nut
04036317.desc: A nutrient-filled tree nut found on Nettled Squirrel monsters in Fox Forest.

04036318.name: Grow-a-Bunch Fertilizer
04036318.desc: Maru's extra special, extra smelly, nutty fertilizer.

04036319.name: Vicious Squirrel Tree Nut
04036319.desc: A nutrient-filled tree nut found on Vicious Squirrel monsters in Fox Forest.

04036320.name: Grow-a-Buncha-Bunch Fertilizer
04036320.desc: Maru's extra special, extra smelly, nutty fertilizer.

04036321.name: Pilfered Jewelry Box
04036321.desc: A box of expensive jewelry belonging to a guest at the Snowdrift Lodge that was pilfered by a Thief Crow. Leave it with the hotel employee to return to its rightful owner.

04036322.name: Intact Battery
04036322.desc: A battery that can be obtained from Aspire Guard Robots. It's intact and can be used right away.

04036323.name: Broken Battery
04036323.desc: A battery that can be obtained from Aspire Guard Robots. However, it's useless, since it's severely damaged.

04036324.name: Aspire Engineer Shield
04036324.desc: An Engineer Shield designed to protect the user from hazardous conditions in Aspire. It  prevents industrial accidents caused by waste compressors, bio-blocking lasers, and bio-blocking gaseous matter. The number of times it activates depends on how many you have. Each activation deducts one.

04036325.name: Wondroid Emergency Repair Kit
04036325.desc: An emergency kit used to repair broken and damaged Wondroids. It's not advisable to use it on humans.

04036326.name: Data Connector
04036326.desc: You can access Adam and Eve's memories through the Data Connector.

04036327.name: Memory Sliver
04036327.desc: A memory fragment scattered all over Morass. The hint of a story is just barely visible inside. Gathering more fragments may make it easier to see.

04036328.name: Memory Glass
04036328.desc: A complete memory scattered all over Morass. Someone's story is clearly reflected within the depths of the glass.

04036329.name: Glittering Powder
04036329.desc: The glittery, powdered form of a beautiful gem that is the envy of all who look at it.

04036330.name: Anti-magic Stone Fragment
04036330.desc: A fragment of the Anti-Magic Stone that caused a horrific accident in Trueffet years ago. Even a small piece may cause tremendous damage.

04036331.name: Stolen Fruit
04036331.desc: A juicy-looking piece of fruit the bullies stole from the Big Apple Fruit shop. It really does look tasty.

04036332.name: Shadow's Core
04036332.desc: The resulting core from the strange shadow after it's been dematerialized. It still exudes an ominous black energy.

04036333.name: Tasty Seafood
04036333.desc: A piece of seafood found on Xenoroid Echo. Take it to Chef Michelin to turn it into a scrumptious dish! Don't tell him where the ingredient is from, though.

04036334.name: Experiment Remnants
04036334.desc: This is the by-product of an experiment that has gone horribly wrong. Maybe you can find a way to use it to defend the lab better.

04036335.name: Broken Shaft
04036335.desc: The shaft of a hammer that belonged to a Thralled Warhammer Knight. The knight's soul trapped within gives off an imposing energy.

04036336.name: Broken Bow
04036336.desc: A broken bow that belonged to a Thralled Archer. The knight's soul trapped within gives off a threatening energy.

04036337.name: Memory Sliver
04036337.desc: A small fragment from a shattered memory. The hint of a story is just barely visible inside. Gathering more fragments may make it easier to see.

04036338.name: Memory Glass
04036338.desc: A complete memory collected from Morass. Someone's story is clearly reflected within the depths of the glass.

04036339.name: Memory Sliver
04036339.desc: A small fragment from a shattered memory. The hint of a story is just barely visible inside. Gathering more fragments may make it easier to see.

04036340.name: No-Blessing Charm
04036340.desc: After enhancement, the 8-Blessing Charm loses its power and must be restored somehow.

04036341.name: Moonlight Mushroom Powder
04036341.desc: This powdered mushroom glows in the dark. Boiling it down will create a sedetive with a bitter flavor.

04036342.name: Peanut
04036342.desc: Munch, munch! Peanuts are so great.

04036343.name: Thorn Tree Sap
04036343.desc: It may be full of nutrients, but it takes a lot of work to make it palatable.

04036344.name: Dried Tree Husk
04036344.desc: Why are you carrying around bits of tree? You must be positively barking!

04036345.name: Tough Meat
04036345.desc: For the sake of your teeth, this should only be chewed in dire emergencies.

04036346.name: Crumbled Rock
04036346.desc: It's the very latest and greatest in rock-based technology!

04036347.name: Crushed Crystal
04036347.desc: It's the prettiest, sparkliest powder you've ever seen!

04036348.name: Decent Crystal
04036348.desc: Its quality is just good enough that it could be useful for something.

04036349.name: Exploding Eyeball
04036349.desc: Keep an eye out for this disgusting pyrotechnic wonder!

04036350.name: Soft Scrap Iron
04036350.desc: It's a decent chunk of leftover iron from a blacksmithing project.

04036351.name: Wiggling Tail
04036351.desc: This squiggly, wiggly tail actually looks kinda gross...

04036352.name: Meat for Storage
04036352.desc: It's decent quality meat that's been prepped and readied for long-term storage.

04036358.name: Captured Monster Card
04036358.desc: A card with the monster Sakura asked for captured in it. Look a little closer, and you'll see the Muddy Sprout Monster.

04036361.name: Shimmering Star
04036361.desc: Take this shiny little piece of the sky to Cassandra to receive an awesome title decorated with stars.

04036362.name: Captured Monster Card
04036362.desc: A card with the monster Sakura asked for captured in it. Look a little closer, and you'll see the Royal Cactus.

04036363.name: Captured Monster Card
04036363.desc: A card with the monster Sakura asked for captured in it. Look a little closer, and you'll see Flicker.

04036364.name: Captured Monster Card
04036364.desc: A card with the monster Sakura asked for captured in it. Look a little closer, and you'll see the Black Mushroom Gang.

04036365.name: Captured Monster Card
04036365.desc: A card with the monster Sakura asked for captured in it. Look a little closer, and you'll see the Befuddled Spirit.

04036366.name: Captured Image
04036366.desc: Contains the captured image of a location Tomoyo asked for.

04036367.name: Decide how to deal with this matter.
04036367.desc: For Caravan conversation window menu categories

04036368.name: Missing Daughter's Hat
04036368.desc: A hat belonging to Shulla's missing daughter. It's singed everywhere.

04036369.name: Photo of Missing Daughter
04036369.desc: A picture frame blackened with soot holding a photo of Shulla's missing daughter.

04036370.name: Sturdy Piece of Wood
04036370.desc: A sturdy piece of wood hand-picked by a clever Eyeful.

04036371.name: Burnt Bread
04036371.desc: A loaf of bread found beneath the ruins of a building. It's completely burnt and covered in ash. There's no way it's edible.

04036372.name: Shrelephant Meat
04036372.desc: This wild Shrelephant Meat looks rich and tender.

04036373.name: Firewood
04036373.desc: Bone-dry branches perfect for starting fires.

04036374.name: Raging Hellfang Meat
04036374.desc: Tough, stringy meat from a Raging Hellfang.

04036375.name: Cayne's Lost Brooch
04036375.desc: The brooch Cayne lost in Eyeful territory. The crest of Afinas has been intricately carved into it.

04036376.name: Gold Filigree Necklace
04036376.desc: A golden necklace that seems to have been lost by someone.

04036377.name: Rich Gold Watch
04036377.desc: A rich gold watch that appears to have been lost by someone.

04036378.name: Shrelephant Meat
04036378.desc: This wild Shrelephant Meat looks rich and tender.

04036379.name: Jellyrash Rope
04036379.desc: The rope is a bit sticky and gross, but it looks strong.

04036380.name: Photo of Old Woman and Granddaughter
04036380.desc: The old woman and her granddaughter look happy. The granddaughter has blue-gray skin and demon's markings, just as people said she did.

04036381.name: Horned Helm
04036381.desc: A helm made specially by Sanaan for Einar. It looks quite grand with those horns on either side.

04036382.name: Leatty Crystal
04036382.desc: A type of medicine used for folk remedies in Abrup.

04036383.name: Raging Hellfang Meat
04036383.desc: Tough, stringy meat from a Raging Hellfang.

04036384.name: Shrelephant Meat
04036384.desc: This wild Shrelephant Meat looks rich and tender.

04036385.name: Raging Werebeast Fur
04036385.desc: This Werebeast fur is thick and warm, perfect for winter.

04036386.name: Actinops Transparent Blood
04036386.desc: Transparent blood just like that of the Actinops fish, a local specialty of Abrup. Is the Toxic Belcher really a mutated fish?

04036387.name: Fembris Fang
04036387.desc: Fembris' mighty fang which does not melt, even in fire. It's much bigger and sharper than other wolf monster teeth. Is Fembris really a monster of legend, or is it another mutated wolf?

04036388.name: Frostflail Yeti's Horn
04036388.desc: Giant Frostflail Yeti horn. It's much bigger and tougher than other Yeti horns. Is it really a mutated Yeti, as Slaka says?

04036389.name: Solid Piece of Wood
04036389.desc: A sturdy piece of wood hand-picked by a clever Eyeful.

04036390.name: Frozen Optusa Leaf
04036390.desc: A Frozen Optusa Leaf which can be found near an air hole. Used as an ingredient in Elva's special elixir.

04036391.name: Actinops Transparent Blood
04036391.desc: Transparent blood just like that of the Actinops fish. Used as an ingredient in Elva's special elixir.

04036392.name: Eyeful's Antenna
04036392.desc: An Eyeful's shiny antenna. Used as an ingredient in Elva's special elixir.

04036393.name: Broken Helmet
04036393.desc: This helmet is clearly not from Abrup and matches Aruhi's eyewitness account. Is there truly some mastermind behind the kidnappings?

04036394.name: Skuas Mountain Stone
04036394.desc: A building stone dug up from the hilly mountains of Skuas. It is very sturdy.

04036395.name: Sturdy Piece of Wood
04036395.desc: A sturdy piece of wood hand-picked by a clever Eyeful.

04036396.name: 14th Street Celeb Pass
04036396.desc: Give this to Cassandra to select and fill a desired #cCelebrity Prestige Condition# for an #cevent that has ended.#

04036397.name: Leatty Crystal
04036397.desc: A type of medicine used for folk remedies in Abrup.

04036398.name: Ahtuin Shell
04036398.desc: Ahtuin Shell. It looks quite tough.

04036399.name: Atus Shell
04036399.desc: Atus Shell. Would it make a good shield?

04036400.name: Bellalion Scale
04036400.desc: Bellalion Scale. It's got lovely colors.

04036401.name: Bellalis Scale
04036401.desc: Bellalis Scale. It has no special features.

04036402.name: Aranya Claws
04036402.desc: Aranya Claws. They're sharp and scary.

04036403.name: Aranea Claws
04036403.desc: Aranea Claws. They're cracked at the end.

04036404.name: Keeper of Light Ring
04036404.desc: Keeper of Light Ring. It's made of a magical material.

04036405.name: Keeper of Darkness Ring
04036405.desc: Keeper of Darkness Ring. It looks pretty sturdy.

04036406.name: Light Executor Ring
04036406.desc: Light Executor Ring. It vibrates ever so slightly.

04036407.name: Dark Executor Ring
04036407.desc: Dark Executor Ring. It makes a weird noise from time to time.

04036444.name: Scattered Soul Shard
04036444.desc: A soul shard that has been scattered across the Labyrinth.

04036445.name: Condensed Soul Power
04036445.desc: A soul that was condensed at the altar. You can feel a mysterious power coming from it.

04036446.name: Wicked Soul Remnants
04036446.desc: The remnants of wicked souls from Soot Beasts and Soot Talons. Just being near it creeps you out.

04036447.name: Card Vestige
04036447.desc: Syaoran is searching for this card vestige.

04036449.name: Flare
04036449.desc: Fire it off, and it'll sail high up into the sky.

04036450.name: Fresh Firewood
04036450.desc: This firewood's too fresh to give off anything but smoke if you burn it.

04036451.name: Animal Fat
04036451.desc: This slick substance is great for cooking and greasing wheels.

04036452.name: Decent Flint
04036452.desc: Flint that will come in handy when making a fire.

04036453.name: Decent Tree Branch
04036453.desc: A well-dried tree branch. It will catch fire quickly.

04036454.name: Burning Black Soul
04036454.desc: Traces of a soul left behind by unknown individuals. It looks as though it's burning.

04036455.name: Maple World's Energy
04036455.desc: Energy of Maple World. It's said that the Fluttering Leaves fall if the #cPeaceful Maple Tree# in town is blessed with this.

04036456.name: Void Fragment
04036456.desc: Fragments broken off of Crushing Glares and Burst Glares. You feel judged in their presence.

04036457.name: Cruel Remnant
04036457.desc: A dark whisper earned by defeating the images of commanders. Evil memories swirl within.

04036458.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036458.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of Arkarium, the Guardian of Time# quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.

04036460.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036460.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of the Tyrant Magnus# quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.

04036461.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036461.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of Lotus, the Wing Master quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.#

04036462.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036462.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of Damien, the Sword of Destruction quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.#

04036463.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036463.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of Will, the King of Spiders quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.#

04036464.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036464.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of Lucid, Keeper of Nightmares quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.#

04036465.name: Black Mage Remnant
04036465.desc: A piece of the Black Mage. There is a way to draw dark powers from this fragment, the same powers that the Black Mage wields...\r\nRequired for completing the #c[Genesis Weapon] Traces of Verus Hilla the Red Witch quest without defeating the Genesis Crux.#

04036468.name: Monster Determination
04036468.desc: The fierce determination of free creatures who resist the powers of darkness

04036474.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 1
04036474.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036475.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 2
04036475.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036476.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 3

04036477.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 3
04036477.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036478.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 4
04036478.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036479.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 5
04036479.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036480.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 6
04036480.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036481.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 7
04036481.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036482.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 8
04036482.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036483.name: Detective Office Pass: Episode 9
04036483.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office story.

04036484.name: Detective Office Pass: Epilogue 1
04036484.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office epilogue.

04036485.name: Detective Office Pass: Epilogue 2
04036485.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office epilogue.

04036486.name: Detective Office Pass: Epilogue 3
04036486.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office epilogue.

04036487.name: Detective Office Pass: Epilogue 4
04036487.desc: A ticket you need to continue with the Peplock Holmes Detective Office epilogue.

04036488.name: Blank Tape
04036488.desc: A blank tape you can use to film the Lunar New Year video message. Find the Officer of the Day and deliver it.

04036489.name: Video Message
04036489.desc: A video message containing precious messages from the officers to their loves ones. It's been wrapped in silk with great care.

04036490.name: Big Nail
04036490.desc: A big nail that used to be stuck on a Prickly Hedgehog's body. It's slightly rusted.

04036491.name: Mysterious Part
04036491.desc: Who knows what this thing's for?

04036492.name: Scratched Cast Iron Plate
04036492.desc: A Cast Iron Plate perfect for teppanyaki. Looks like a Nutria was gnawing on it.

04036493.name: Wiggling Tail
04036493.desc: The wiggly, squiggly tail of a stray specter dog. It almost seems alive.

04036494.name: Device Button
04036494.desc: A button that was attached to the Purification Device. It must have seemed valuable to the Gloogers.

04036495.name: Device Part
04036495.desc: A part that was attached to the Purification Device. It must have seemed valuable to the Gloogers.

04036496.name: No-Blessing Charm
04036496.desc: The charm may have lost its power, but a little elbow grease and refining might improve it. Yoria says you should collect 88 of them!

04036497.name: Neinheart's Pocket Watch
04036497.desc: A pocket watch that Neinheart lent to you. He says you should find him when the alarm goes off.

04036498.name: Neinheart's Ringing Pocket Watch
04036498.desc: The alarm went off! Go find Neinheart.

04036499.name: Nyen's Burning Flare
04036499.desc: The still-burning flare that fell from Nyen. You can probably still use this to light the fireworks.

04036500.name: Lit Lantern
04036500.desc: This lantern is full of Deep Forest Wisps and emits a soft glow.

04036501.name: Hay
04036501.desc: This is a piece of Hay from a Hay Bundle that's perfect for working into useful items.

04036502.name: Makeshift Broomstick
04036502.desc: This is a Makeshift Broomstick crafted from pieces of Hay. Clean up the Dust Bundles with this Broomstick.

04036503.name: Pure Water
04036503.desc: This refreshing liquid can be obtained from the Spring Sprites. #cDrag# it to the Small Bottle to collect it.

04036504.name: Lotus
04036504.desc: This flower has been gently plucked from its stem.

04036505.name: Pure Water
04036505.desc: This refreshing liquid can be obtained from the Spring Sprites. #cDrag# it to the Small Bottle to collect it.

04036506.name: Pure Water
04036506.desc: Spring Sprites drop this precious water, which can be collected in the Small Bottle.

04036507.name: Lotus
04036507.desc: This flower has been gently plucked from its stem.

04036508.name: Orange Mushroom Doll
04036508.desc:
This cute little orange mush plush is a favorite among tourists, since it's one of the most recognizable monsters in Maple World.
#cHunt Orange Mushroom-type monsters for this.#

04036509.name: Immaculate Branch
04036509.desc:
This is no ordinary tree branch. It's giving off all kinds of weird energy!
#cHunt Stump-type monsters for this.#

04036510.name: Wiggly Jelly
04036510.desc:
This little jelly jiggler looks pretty tasty, but something weird might happen if you eat it.
#cHunt Slime-type monsters for this.#

04036511.name: Clockwork Sprocket
04036511.desc:
There's no telling what this thing is used for, but it's still an interesting curio.
#cHunt Machine-type monsters for this.#

04036512.name: Everfrost Snowflake
04036512.desc:
This beautiful, sparkling snowflake never melts, even when the weather's warm!
#cHunt monsters in cold, snowy regions like El Nath for this.#

04036513.name: Essence of Time
04036513.desc:
This unique souvenir captures a moment of warped time within its crystalline walls.
#cHunt monsters in Temple of Time or Clocktower for this.#

04036514.name: Enchanted Teardrop
04036514.desc:
Some strange magic within maintains this item's beautiful teardrop shape.
#cHunt monsters in water like Aqua Road for this.#

04036515.name: Shiny Erda Fragments
04036515.desc:
There's not much energy left in this, but it still makes for a unique conversation piece.
#cHunt Arcane River monsters for this.#

04036516.name: Glittering Ore
04036516.desc:
The raw form of this mineral gives off an almost ethereal light.
#cHunt monsters in Mines, Dead Mines, and Mountains, or by harvesting Veins for this.#

04036517.name: Dewy Sprout
04036517.desc:
This little, green sprout is the perfect representation of a fresh spring morning in Maple World.
#cHunt Plant-type monsters or harvest Herbs for this.#

04036518.name: Starburst Mana Crystal
04036518.desc:
You can feel a powerful energy from deep within. No one knows what these are really used for, but the one thing that's certain is that these aren't something just anyone can get their hands on.
#cDefeat boss monsters to obtain these.#

04036519.name: Monster Park E Ticket
04036519.desc:
These tickets used to get you entry to the excitement and adventure of Monster Park, but now they're more of a collectible from another time.
#cCan be obtained once Monster Park is cleared#

04036520.name: Famous People Snapshots
04036520.desc: Several photos of the most famous people in Maple World. The best of these will make for a great scrapbook!

04036521.name: Famous Places Snapshots
04036521.desc: Several photos of the most famous places in Maple World. The best of these will make for a great scrapbook!

04036522.name: Famous Monsters Snapshots
04036522.desc: Several photos of the most infamous monsters in Maple World. The best of these will make for a great scrapbook!

04036523.name: Pillar Offering
04036523.desc: This is an offering that the Ruins Guardians carry. You need them to get the answer to the riddle right.

04036524.name: Pudgy Flower Seed Oil
04036524.desc: Seed oil extracted from the Pudgy Flower. It's moist, so it softens up the ground.

04036525.name: Pudgy Flower Stems
04036525.desc: Tough Pudgy Flower stems. Somehow, they're the perfect ingredient for the Wunderlixir. The Karuppa must know a secret trick to using them.

04036526.name: Toxiblossom Leaf
04036526.desc: Toxiblossom Leaves that carry deadly poison. Somehow, they're the perfect ingredient for the Wunderlixir. The Karuppa must know a secret trick to using them.

04036527.name: Pottery Shards
04036527.desc: Shards of the pottery Hoppin' Sprouts hid in. They're one of the antique items that Gorgonz is collecting.

04036528.name: Censer Ashes
04036528.desc: Ashes from the censer Chargin' Sprouts hid in. Each carries a unique scent. It's one of the antique items that Gorgonz is collecting.

04036529.name: Extra Dry Firewood
04036529.desc: Firewood carried by the Log-a-Rhythmic Bugs. They're very dry, so they'll burn easily.

04036530.name: Smoky Flint
04036530.desc: Flint carried by the Sparkinstone Bugs. They're ideal ingredients for an explosive, since the catch on fire so easily.

04036531.name: Glowpod
04036531.desc: These glowpods were dropped by the Ruins Sentinel. They will be useful in lighting the dark path underwater.

04036532.name: Maple World Leaf
04036532.desc:
This humble leaf is the ultimate symbol of everything Maple World. Collect a bunch for Cassandra, and she'll swap them for a LINE FRIENDS souvenir. 
#cCan be obtained by hunting monsters near your level.

04036533.name: Sentsuma
04036533.desc: The sentinel's fruit looks kind of dangerous. Better be careful with it...

04036534.name: Guardian's Soul Flame
04036534.desc: Soul Flame spilled by the Guardians. It's quite beautiful, really.

04036536.name: Super Expensive Makeup Kit
04036536.desc: A high-end makeup kit that probably cost more than you make in a week.

04036537.name: Severed Antenna
04036537.desc: An antenna severed from a Hunterizer. It looks to still be in working order.

04036538.name: Unique Sound
04036538.desc: Collect the unique sounds monsters make from time to time to create a Creative Rhythm.

04036550.name: Fantastic Melody
04036550.desc: You've collected the surrounding sound and completed a Fantastic Melody.

04036551.name: Creative Rhythm
04036551.desc: You've collected the unique sounds that monsters make and completed a Creative Rhythm.

04036552.name: Perfect Harmony
04036552.desc: You've eliminated the Poseur Musicians and their dissonant, sub-par efforts to complete a Perfect Harmony.

04036571.name: Lyck's Recipe
04036571.desc: It's one of Master Lyck's secret recipes!

04036572.name: Sleep Powder
04036572.desc: The very same sleeping powder sprinkled all over Lachelein by Lucid.

04036573.name: Forest Spirit Energy
04036573.desc: Residual energy of the spirits that live in the forests of Arcana.

04036574.name: Cave Spirit Energy
04036574.desc: Residual energy of the spirits that live in the caves of Arcana.

04036576.name: Stiff Wooden Block

04037372.desc: A freshly caught octopus with a delightful mouthfeel.\nUsed in #cArno's Cooking#.

04037380.desc: A mortal wish, stolen by a Fling before it could reach the Star Garden.

04037381.name: Heavenly Hours

04037382.name: Alchiba Extinguished
04037382.desc: A constellation stripped of the light which ought sustain it. Alchiba is already dissipating.

04037383.name: Soul Residue
04037383.desc: The final, lingering remnant of a soul native to Tallahart. Though faint, it still contains traces of an Ancient God's power. You can feel it fading away even as you hold it.

04037384.desc: The final, lingering remnant of a soul native to Tallahart. Though faint, it still contains traces of an Ancient God's power. You can feel it fading away even as you hold it.

04037402.desc: The glimmering scale of a mythical imugi. It may have been scraped off on a lakebed days ago, but it still shines as if it fell from the legendary serpent mere moments ago.

04037407.name: Broken Flashlight
04037407.desc: Someone must have used this flashlight, and busted the light bulb.

04037462.name: Ellanos I
04037462.desc:
Ellanos attacks nearby enemies by jumping up in the air, causing a shockwave.
Ellanos can't be summoned in mid-air and is unaffected by attack reflection.

When a #cShadow Partner, Mirror Image, Buckshot, Falling Moon, Equinox Cycle, Dark Servant, Arc Charger, Blue Blood, or Manifest Projector# is applied, instead of the attack count increase effect, a Final Damage increase effect with the same effect will be applied.

Not affected by cooldown reset or buff duration increase effects.
