04251402.desc: A jewel used primarily for item-production.\nThere's no way to tell how the item will turn out with this.

04260000.name: Basic Monster Crystal 1
04260000.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 31 ~ 50.

04260001.name: Basic Monster Crystal 2
04260001.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 51 ~ 60.

04260002.name: Basic Monster Crystal 3
04260002.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 61 ~ 70.

04260003.name: Intermediate Monster Crystal 1
04260003.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 71 ~ 80.

04260004.name: Intermediate Monster Crystal 2
04260004.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 81 ~ 90.

04260005.name: Intermediate Monster Crystal 3
04260005.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 91 ~ 100.

04260006.name: Advanced Monster Crystal 1
04260006.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 101 ~ 110.

04260007.name: Advanced Monster Crystal 2
04260007.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 111 ~ 120.

04260008.name: Advanced Monster Crystal 3
04260008.desc: A Monster Crystal that was formed by combining the droppings of monsters on level 121 ~ 130.

04280000.name: Gold Box
04280000.desc: A gold treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Gold Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

04280001.name: Silver Box
04280001.desc: A silver treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Silver Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

04280002.name: Premium Gold Box
04280002.desc: A gold treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Premium Gold Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Premium Gold Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

04280003.name: Premium Silver Box
04280003.desc: A silver treasure chest dropped by a monster. This can be opened with the Premium Silver Master Key available at the Cash Shop. If you already have the Premium Silver Master Key, just double-click the box to open it.

04280011.name: Maplenogi Gold Lock
04280011.desc: A Gold Lock dropped from a monster. You can open it by double-clicking if you have a Maplenogi Gold Key.

04280012.name: Maplenogi Silver Lock
04280012.desc: A Silver Lock dropped from a monster. You can open it by double-clicking if you have a Maplenogi Silver Key.

04290000.name: Golden Chicken Effect
04290000.desc: Golden Chicken Effect was given as a reward for helping Lazy Daisy. You can turn it ON/OFF by double-clicking the icon or using the key configuration menu to assign a shortcut key.

04290001.name: Bummer Effect
04290001.desc: This effect is for people who helped Lazy Daisy but failed to hatch the egg. You can turn it ON/OFF by double-clicking the icon or using the key configuration menu to assign a shortcut key.

04300000.name: New Year's Card (Send)
04300000.desc: A beautiful card with season's greetings.

04301000.name: New Year's Card (Receive)
04301000.desc: A beautiful card with season's greetings. Double click on it to read!

04310000.name: Perfect Pitch
04310000.desc: This Music Note gives Inkwell the perfect pitch he's been dying to find. You can trade it for a rare item if you go to the Free Market Entrance or talk to Inkwell in Henesys before March 30th.

04310001.name: Icy Guitar Pick
04310001.desc: An icy blue guitar pick that will be exchanged when Inkwell returns.

04310002.name: 6th Anniversary Silver Coin
04310002.desc: A silver coin created to commemorate MapleStory's 6th Anniversary. It's only circulated during the 6th Anniversary period and has variety of uses.

04310003.name: 6th Anniversary Insignia
04310003.desc: A one of a kind, untradable item received by a player for taking over a town during a Cake or Pie invasion or from #cNPC Pie Lord Tiara or Cake Boss Daniel# after participating in a Cake or Pie invasion.

04310004.name: OSSS Medal
04310004.desc: A medal issued by the OSSS. It can be used to purchase various core cells from Senior Researcher Jett.

04310007.name: Icy Guitar Pick
04310007.desc: An icy blue pick used for playing the guitar. You can take it to Mrs. Bo to purchase a special item.

04310008.name: Moonlight Coin
04310008.desc: A coin engraved with a full moon.

04310009.name: Noble Lion King Medal
04310009.desc: A medal containing Lion King's special power. It shines with a weak silver glow, as it hasn't been purified completely.

04310010.name: Royal Lion King Medal
04310010.desc: This purified golden medal contains Lion King's special power. Murt, in the Second Tower of Lion King's Castle, will accept it in exchange for Royal Von Leon equipment.

04310011.name: Christmas Snow Crystal
04310011.desc: Can be used to purchase items from Fur Puff near White Christmas Hill.

04310012.name: Golden Snow Crystal
04310012.desc: Can be used to purchase rare items from Fur White near White Christmas Hill.

04310013.name: Sol Gong Doll for Christmas
04310013.desc: A very cute rag doll with Santa hat which resembles Sol Gong. Take it to Sol Gong in Dojo for an amazing Christmas present.

04310014.name: Snowdrop Coin
04310014.desc: A coin-shaped snowdrop. You can purchase items from Inkwell with these coins.

04310015.name: Gallant Emblem
04310015.desc: An emblem gifted by the god of war. An unknown power radiates from it.

04310016.name: Red Button
04310016.desc: A red button. These can be used to purchase items from Inkwell.

04310018.name: Crusader Coin
04310018.desc: The currency used within the Silent Crusade. Available supplies are determined by your rank.

04310019.name: Tourist Memorial Coin
04310019.desc: A memorial coin distributed to the tourists of Maple World. Collecting these coins will come in handy later on.

04310020.name: Monster Park Commemorative Coin
04310020.desc: A special coin to commemorate the Monster Park. Take it to the Merchant at Monster Park to trade it for a special item.

04310021.name: Dolphin Island Commemorative Coin
04310021.desc: A commemorative coin given to visitors to Dolphin Island. The back of the coin features Pason's signature.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Pason to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

04310022.name: Cherry Blossom Commemorative Coin
04310022.desc: A commemorative coin given to those who visit the cherry blossoms. The back of the coin features the signature of Chief Stan.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Chief Stan to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

04310023.name: Luck Coin
04310023.desc: Gather enough Luck Coin and exchange it for rewards from #cNPC Inkwell#.

04310024.name: Treasure Hunt 'You Lose' Note
04310024.desc: A treasure hunt note featuring a picture of a bomb. That probably means it's no good.\n#cGather up the 'You Lose' notes and bring them to Hooper, the merchant, to trade them for food items.#

04310025.name: 7th Anniversary Coin
04310025.desc: A coin to commemorate MapleStory's 7th Anniversary. You can only find these during the 7th Anniversary celebration. You can use them to buy Joy Bird Feathers, which Inkwell can then use to upgrade Maple Beryl equipment into Crimson Maple equipment.

04310027.name: Legends Awards Coin
04310027.desc: A coin used during the Legends Awards. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Legends Shop.

04310028.name: Legends Maple Coin
04310028.desc: A special currency used during the Legends event. You can use it from the Maple Tab in the Legends Shop.

04310029.name: Crusader Coins
04310029.desc: You can exchange this for Silent Crusade items from Wence at the Silent Crusade Safe House. Silent Crusade items can also be exchanged through the Maple Administrator.\n\n#cCan be exchanged until 1/31/2024#.

04310030.name: Homecoming Coin
04310030.desc: A special sporty coin that can be exchanged for equipment and scrolls from Inkwell.

04310031.name: Legends Awards Coin
04310031.desc: A coin that can be obtained by participating in various Maple Award events. You can trade it for items at the Award Shop by opening the UI on the left side of the screen.

04310034.name: Renegades Coin
04310034.desc: A coin used during the Renegades Festival. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Renegades Shop.

04310036.name: Conqueror's Coin
04310036.desc: Coin obtained by clearing Fight for Azwan. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

04310037.name: Clover Coin
04310037.desc: You can trade it with NPC Rechanuni who is infront of PMD entrance for valuable items which are obtainable only in Premium Dungeon.

04310038.name: Emperor's Coin
04310038.desc: Coin obtained by clearing the Fight for Azwan on Hard Mode. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.

04310043.name: Alien Coin
04310043.desc: Even aliens love to have a little coin in their pockets! Bring it to Pico in NLC to exchange for a Nebulite.

04310048.name: 8th Anniversary Coin
04310048.desc: Coin released in celebration of 8th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 8th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

04310050.name: Old Maple Coin
04310050.desc: Use them to buy special items from Old Maple Event Shop.

04310051.name: Purified Spirit Stone
04310051.desc: This is one squeaky-clean Spirit Stone. Take it to the supply soldier in Momijigaoka.

04310054.name: Sengoku Coin
04310054.desc: A coin from the Sengoku Festival. Use it to purchase items from the Sengoku Store during the event.

04310055.name: Purified Spirit Stone
04310055.desc: A Spirit Stone purified by Tsuchimikado Haruaki. Take it to the supply soldier in Momijigaoka to receive the Spirit of the Soul.

04310057.name: Tempest Coin
04310057.desc: Newly minted to celebrate the Tempest Festival. Allows you to purchase various limited-time items during the festival.

04310058.name: Magnus Coin
04310058.desc: A coin that you obtained for defeating Magnus. Talk to Mayala at Downtown Black Market to trade it in.

04310059.name: Shadowdealer Coin
04310059.desc: A secret coin obtained for helping the Shadowdealers. Talk to Mayala at Downtown Black Market to trade it in.

04310060.name: Evolving Coin
04310060.desc: Turn this in to Vendor-C2 in the Evolution Lab for Cores, Equipment, and Scrolls.\n\n#cCan be exchanged until 1/31/2024#

04310061.name: 2014 Homecoming Coin
04310061.desc: Turn this in to Wonky in the Event Hall for sports equipment and scrolls.

04310062.name: Masked Gentleman Coin
04310062.desc: This silver coin is one of the Masked Gentleman's family heirlooms. Take it back to him to trade for various items.

04310063.name: Step Pop Coin
04310063.desc: Turn this in to NPC Lux in town for valuable items. Lux's items change every 2 hours.\nVisit the Free Market Entrance in Channel 1 to find Lux.

04310064.name: Yggdrasil Rune
04310064.desc: An ancient stone engraved with Yggdrasil's rune. Trade it to the merchant at Colossal Root in the Root Abyss for a Sealed Box.

04310065.name: Chaos Yggdrasil Rune
04310065.desc: An ancient stone engraved with Chaos Yggdrasil's rune. Trade it to the merchant at Colossal Root in the Root Abyss for a Sealed Box.

04310066.name: Unleashed Coins
04310066.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, equipment, and Mastery Books from the Solar Power Coin Shop.

04310067.name: PC Cafe Coin
04310067.desc: 프리미엄 PC방에서만 획득 가능한 코인 아이템이다. 린에게서 주문서, 장신구 등으로 교환할 수 있다.

04310069.name: Monster Life Coin
04310069.desc: Coin purchased with Monster Life Warus. Used to purchase goods from Jimmy-Jack.

04310070.name: New Year's Yut Coin
04310070.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, equipment, and Mastery Books from the New Year's Coin Shop.

04310071.name: New Year's Kite Coin
04310071.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls and equipment from the New Year's Coin Shop.

04310075.name: Oda Coin
04310075.desc: Take this to Goemon to exchange for totems.

04310079.name: 9th Anniversary Coins
04310079.desc: Coin released in celebration of 9th Maple Anniversary. Only used during 9th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase Maple armors and other special items from Inkwell.

04310080.name: 9th Anniversary Maple Leaf
04310080.desc: A beautiful maple leaf. #cYou can trade it for 9th Anniversary Coins from Inkwell, but only during the event period.#

04310081.name: OSSS Coin
04310081.desc: A medal coin issued by the OSSS. It can be used to purchase various core cells from Senior Researcher Jett.

04310084.name: Frontier Coin
04310084.desc: You can take it to Inkwell to purchase a Frontier special item.

04310085.name: Time Coin
04310085.desc: A coin imbued with the power of time. Zero, from Cello in Zero's Temple, will accept it in exchange for supplies.

04310086.name: Job Advancement Coin
04310086.desc: This coin is required for Open Advancement, which is only available for Explorers.

04310088.name: RED Coin
04310088.desc: A red coin with the letters RED imprinted on it. #cYou can use it to buy items at the RED Shop.#

04310091.name: Anheim Coin
04310091.desc: A coin minted by the Ranheim Magic School. Keilbarren, in Kritias Marketplace, accepts these coins in exchange for anti-magic and other useful items.

04310092.name: Kritias Commemorative Coin
04310092.desc: A very valuable coin minted by the Kritias Government. Keilbarren, in Kritias Marketplace, accepts these coins in exchange for special items.

04310095.name: Silver Farm Coin
04310095.desc: A silver coin only usable in the goose farm. You can use them when purchasing special items at the goose farm. Talk to the farm owner.

04310096.name: SAO Coin
04310096.desc: Coins required to enter the Sword Art Online Dungeon. NerveGear is used to travel to different worlds.

04310099.name: Spring Bunny Coin
04310099.desc: Take these coins to the Spring Bunny Salesman in the Event Hall to get rare items. Can only be used during the Spring Event period.

04310100.name: Commerci Denaro
04310100.desc: A coin used exclusively by the traders of Commerci.

04310101.name: Black Friday Coin
04310101.desc: A coin to celebrate the funnest shopping day of all... Black Friday!

04310102.name: Mustache Comb
04310102.desc: Carlton the mustache researcher is looking for this comb. You can trade this for a special item at Carlton's Mustache Lab.

04310103.name: Mustache Scissors
04310103.desc: Carlton the mustache researcher is looking for these scissors. You can trade them for a special item at Carlton's Mustache Lab.

04310104.name: RP Coin
04310104.desc: It can be exchanged for items from Paul.

04310105.name: Model Student Candy
04310105.desc: A reward that Mr. Schrodinger only gives to exemplary students. You can use the Lockers at Maple Leaf High with these candies.

04310108.name: Nut Coin
04310108.desc: These coins are the future! Their value can only go up! Use them buy special items from Roasty the Nut Merchant.

04310110.name: 9th Anniversary Coin
04310110.desc: Collect these coins during the 9th anniversary event and use them to purchase all sorts of neat items from the 9th Anniversary Coin Shop.\r\n

04310113.name: Carrot Coin
04310113.desc: A coin featuring a fresh-looking carrot mark. Use them buy special items from Roasty the Nut Merchant.

04310119.name: 10th Anniversary Coin
04310119.desc: A coin released to mark the 10th Maple Anniversary. Only used during the 10th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase special items.

04310124.name: Hugh Head's Gold Needle
04310124.desc: A gold needle from Hugh Head. You can trade it to him for new uniforms.

04310125.name: Hugh Head's Silver Needle
04310125.desc: A silver needle from Hugh Head. You can trade it to him for new uniforms.

04310126.name: Hot Summer Coin
04310126.desc: These coins are the future! Their value can only go up! Use them to buy special items from Roasty's Hot Summer Shop.

04310129.name: Winter Limited Coin
04310129.desc: A coin that lets you buy various scrolls, damage skins, and chairs from the Winter Limited Coin Shop.

04310136.name: Old Maple Coin(2)
04310136.desc: Use them to buy special items from Old Maple Event Shop.

04310144.name: Attack on Titan Reward Stamp
04310144.desc: You can exchange these stamps for rewards at the Attack on Titan Rewards Shop.

04310148.name: Star World Coin
04310148.desc: This is Star World's primary currency. Use it to buy items from the Star World Coin Shop.

04310149.name: Game Machine Coin
04310149.desc: Put these coins into the game machine to play a game.

04310150.name: Reward Coin
04310150.desc: You can exchange these coins for rewards.

04310153.name: FIREPOWER Coin
04310153.desc: This coin is available during the FIREPOWER event. It can be used to purchase various items from the Coin Commissary, Korean Folk Town, and more.

04310154.name: FIREPOWER SP Coin
04310154.desc: This coin is #ca very special one# from the FIREPOWER event. It can be used to purchase exclusive items from Agent Burns.

04310155.name: Valentine Heart
04310155.desc: A sweet heart for Valentine's Day.

04310156.name: AbsoLab Coin
04310156.desc: Three-Hands, in Haven, accepts these coins in exchange for official AbsoLab equipment.

04310163.name: 11th Anniversary Coin
04310163.desc: A coin released to mark the 11th Maple Anniversary. Only used during the 11th Anniversary, this can be used to purchase special items.

04310166.name: 10-Year Token
04310166.desc: Collect these and bring them to the Artifact Keeper at the Event Hall to get popular rewards from past events!

04310167.name: Beefy Coin
04310167.desc: Used to purchase materials for Beefy's Kitchen. You can only use them during the event period, and they will vanish afterward.

04310172.name: Pepe Coin
04310172.desc: Purchase special items from Pepe at the 2015 Summer Main Town and Monster Treasure Town.

04310175.name: Star M Coin
04310175.desc:
#cEvent Period: 
Until TKTKTK#

#cStar M Coin Shop Available:
Until TKTKTK#

A special coin that can be acquired from Star Planet M. Purchase various items during the event period.

04310177.name: Yu Garden Coin
04310177.desc: A coin that can only be used in Yu Garden. You can exchange it for items from the Yu Garden or Black Market merchants.

04310180.name: Madhouse Coin
04310180.desc: Accepted at all major vending machines in the hospital.

04310181.name: 2016 Homecoming Coin
04310181.desc: Turn this in to Wonky in the Event Hall for sports equipment and scrolls.

04310184.name: World Traveler Coin
04310184.desc: A coin from the year 2015! Travel the world to scrounge these up, and use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

04310185.name: 2016 Rice Cake Festival Coin
04310185.desc: A coin printed in the year 2016! They mark the celebration of the rice festival. Use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

04310186.name: Alishan Coin
04310186.desc: A coin that can be found on Alishan, and is only accepted there. Take it to #cLunch Vendor# and use it to purchase all kinds of items.

04310188.name: Junk Food Coin
04310188.desc: Bring these to the Junk Food Merchant to purchase event items.

04310189.name: Reboot Coin
04310189.desc: A coin that marks the opening of the Reboot Server. Use it to purchase special items at the Reboot Coin Shop.

04310194.name: Style Box Stamp
04310194.desc: A stamp earned by recycling items received from the Style Random Box!\nYou can exchange them at the Style Random Box Stamp Shop, by the Free Market Entrance!

04310195.name: Heroes Coin
04310195.desc: This coin is available during the summer event. It can be used to purchase various items from the Heroes Coin Shop.

04310198.name: Rice Drop Soup Coin
04310198.desc: A big coin engraved with the image of a delicious-looking rice drop soup. It can be traded to Pink Mong for various items.

04310199.name: Stigma Coin
04310199.desc: Stigma coin that can be traded for AbsoLab equipment. Talk to the Demon Supplier in Deserted Camp.

04310201.name: Broken Gold Fragment
04310201.desc: A fragment broken off of a golden statue. You can exchange it for items from Lil Murgoth.

04310202.name: Zero-Point Energy Module
04310202.desc: A device capable of harvesting ambient energy. \r\nMerona got lost inside the Cube searching for this.

04310203.name: Clone DNA
04310203.desc: A DNA sample  that can be collected from PULSAR's clones.\r\nIt's been modified by PULSAR's biotechnology.\r\nYou can trade this with the Space Detective wandering around inside the Cube.

04310204.name: PULSAR Medallion
04310204.desc: A token that proves you belong to PULSAR.\r\nIt smells like icky pirate, but it could be valuable to somebody.

04310205.name: PULSAR Jewel
04310205.desc: A device to awaken mystical creatures and control their minds.\r\nBigby in the Hyperspace Cube is collecting this for unknown reasons.

04310206.name: 12th Anniversary Coin
04310206.desc: A limited-edition coin released to mark MapleStory's 12th Anniversary. It can be used during the 12th Anniversary to purchase special items.

04310209.name: Aqua Bucks
04310209.desc: A currency used during the Water Wars event. Used coin to purchase various Hydroblaster Skills and items from each team's Supply NPC.

04310210.name: V Coin
04310210.desc: A summer event coin that has a clear V mark. Take it to Wave to trade it for a special item.

04310211.name: Unity Heart
04310211.desc: 클라이언트 변경으로 소실되거나 변경되는 컨텐츠/시스템애 대한 보상으로 지급되는 코인이다.\r\n자유시장에 있는 Unity Shop에서 사용할 수 있다.

04310212.name: MMF Coin
04310212.desc: A coin commemorating the Maple Music Festival! Use them to purchase special items from the Coin Shop.

04310213.name: M-Force Go!
04310213.desc: Grants a chance for M-Forcers to deal a finishing blow. Drops 5,000 bonus mesos.

04310214.name: Ultra Beam
04310214.desc: Places a Revolving Cannon designed by Dr. Kim. Drops 10,000 bonus mesos when the enemy is defeated.

04310215.name: Mesotron-X
04310215.desc: Summons the giant robot Mesotron-X, which fires lasers in all directions every time you press the skill button. Drops 20,000 bonus mesos when the enemy is defeated.

04310216.name: AbsoLab Essence
04310216.desc: Contains the essence of AbsoLab equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

04310217.name: Arcane Umbra Essence
04310217.desc: Contains the essence of Arcane Umbra equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

04310218.name: Phantasma Coin
04310218.desc: Dimo, on Lachelein Main Street, accepts these coins in exchange for official Arcane Umbra equipment.

04310221.name: Persimmon Coin
04310221.desc: A fall event coin that depicts a delicious persimmon. Bring it to Mommy Moon Bunny to exchange it for something special.

04310224.name: BFF Coin
04310224.desc: The premium currency used by the BFF Finder app. You can exchange it for various special items at the BFF Coin Shop!

04310225.name: Override Coin
04310225.desc: It's a shiny Override Event Coin! You can trade it for various special items at the #cOverride Coin Shop# run by Yeti.

04310226.name: New Year's Coin
04310226.desc: Exchangable for various items in Ms. Song's Shop.

04310227.name: Dream Coin
04310227.desc: A coin you received for taking on Dream Defender. You can trade it for rewards with Mr. Flopsy, the Dreamweaver.

04310228.name: Magpie Coin
04310228.desc: It's a Magpie Coin depicting an adorable magpie. You can exchange it for various and special items at the #New Year's Coin Shop# run by Magnus the Magpie.

04310229.name: Legion Coin
04310229.desc: A coin acquired with your Legion's hard work and cooperation.\r\nYou can exchange it for various items or use it to increase your Legion rank at #cDame Appropriation and Squire Pancho in major towns#.

04310230.name: Aspire Commemorative Coin
04310230.desc: A commemorative coin issued by Aspire. You can trade it to #cAlec# and #cKhun# in exchange for various items.

04310232.name: Dragon Boat Festival Coin
04310232.desc: Obtained by participating in the Mini-game Station event. Collect them and exchange them for exclusive event-only items!

04310235.name: Spirit Coin
04310235.desc: A coin earned by rescuing a Rock Spirit in Spirit Savior. You can exchange these for Arcane Symbols from the <Escaped Rock Spirit> NPC.

04310237.name: Nova Coin
04310237.desc: It's a Nova Event Coin! You can redeem it for special items at the #cNova Coin Shop#, run by Manoff.

04310238.name: Absolute Taste Coin
04310238.desc: A coin earned in the Absolute Taste event. You can trade it for various items from the Spoon 'n' Pantry shop NPC.

04310241.name: Pop Coin
04310241.desc: A Pop Coin obtained for participating in the Maple Film Festival. It can be exchanged for special items in Ring Master Orchid's #cKing of the Rings Coin Shop.#

04310242.name: Snowdrift Lodge Coin
04310242.desc: A currency required for the use of the Snowdrift Lodge's services and facilities. Visit an employee in the lodge's lobby to make use of these services.

04310243.name: Lab Server Coin
04310243.desc: A coin used only on the Lab Server. Can be used to purchase many useful items from the Lab Server Shop.

04310244.name: Ghost Coin
04310244.desc: Trade this in for special items like the Halloween-themed items at the #cGhoulbuster Coin Shop# run by Hallowkitty.

04310247.name: EVA Coin
04310247.desc: It's a #cvery special coin# engraved with a special Eva mark. It can be used to purchase #cEvangelion related items# from Porter.

04310248.name: Ark Coin
04310248.desc: It's an Ark Event Coin! You can redeem it for special items at the #cArk Coin Shop#.

04310249.name: Arachno Coin
04310249.desc: Dimo, at the Base Camp in Esfera, accepts these coins in exchange for official Arcane Umbra equipment.

04310252.name: Research Coin
04310252.desc: A coin earned from plant harvests on the Spring Valley Farm.\r\n

04310253.name: 14th Street Coin
04310253.desc: You'll get 14th Street Coin x1 for every 14th Street Point x100 earned.

04310255.name: Credit
04310255.desc: Credits, the most common currency used across the galaxy.

04310257.name: Alliance Medal
04310257.desc: A medal given by the Alliance to heroes that have gathered the power of determination. You can use Alliance Medals to increase your Alliance Rank or to purchase items from the Alliance Supply Depot.

04310258.name: Retro Coin
04310258.desc: It's a Retro World event coin! You can trade it for special items at the #cRetro World Coin Shop#.

04310260.name: Genesis Essence
04310260.desc: Contains the essence of Genesis equipment. Used to upgrade Lapis/Lazuli for Zero.

04310261.name: Utah Coin
04310261.desc: You'll get 1 Utah Coin for every 100 Utah Points earned.

04310263.name: Hong Bao
04310263.desc: These fancy, red money envelopes can be used in the Lunar New Year Special Supply Shop. The Lunar New Year Special Supply Shop is available at the Lunar New Year Party, Henesys, Leafre, and Nameless Town from 01/30/2019 to 02/12/2019.

04310266.name: Adventure Coin

05170000.name: Pet Name Tag
05170000.desc: Use this item to name your pet. If you call its name before making an order, your pet will respond much better to your command. \n ex. Lucky, sit! \r\nOnly #cletters and numbers# can be used in names, and #conly 1 blank space is allowed in the text of the name.#

05180000.name: Water of Life
05180000.desc: Mysterious water collected from a deep well beneath Ellinia. Take it to Fairy Mar in Ellinia to grant #c90 days# of magic duration to your pet. (Can be extended only up to 365 days while the magic duration remains.)\nDoes not work on #cMiracle Pets#.

05190000.name: Item Pouch Skill
05190000.desc: Adds the Item Pouch skill to the selected pet.\n#cCan only be used on pets with Meso Magnet.

05190001.name: Auto HP Potion Skill
05190001.desc: Allows your pet to use HP potions on you when you're hurting. \n#cAvailable to all pets that do not have this skill.#

05190002.name: Expanded Auto Move Skill
05190002.desc: This scroll expands the pet's auto move by 3x.\n#cCan only be used on pets with the Auto Move Skill. Cannot be stacked for use.\nCannot add this skill to Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

05190003.name: Auto Move Skill
05190003.desc: Adds a skill that automatically picks up nearby items and mesos without having to move.\n#cCan be used on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch.

05190004.name: Expired Pickup Skill
05190004.desc: Allows your pet to pick up items left by other players. It takes 110 seconds for an item to be released from ownership so your pet can take it.\n#cAvailable to pets with meso and item pick-up skills.#

05190005.name: Ignore Item Skill
05190005.desc: A skill to prevent pets from collecting selected items. Equipping a pet with this skill will apply the skill to#c all equipped pets.# You can use this on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch. Some items, including quest and untradable, cannot be selected.

05190006.name: Auto MP Potion Skill
05190006.desc: Allows your pet to use MP potions on you when you're running dry. \n#cAvailable to all pets that do not have this skill.#

05190009.name: Auto All Cure Skill
05190009.desc: Allows your pet to cure you of abnormal statuses.\n#cThis skill can be used on all pets, but can't be duplicated.#

05190010.name: Auto Buff Skill
05190010.desc: Choose one buff skill you want from the Skill window and drag it to the bottom of the Pet Equip tab. Once it's saved, the pet will use the chosen skill automatically. You can save up to 2 skills per pet. Cannot be used on certain skills, #cincluding hyper skills#.

05190011.name: Auto Feed and Movement Skill
05190011.desc: Allows your pet to feed itself using Pet Food from your inventory. Also allows your pet to navigate multi-level maps to pick up mesos and items if it has the #cAuto Move Skill#. \n#cCan be used on all pets.#

05190012.name: Fatten Up Skill
05190012.desc: Hunting enemies near your level will cause your pet to grow. Once it grows large enough, it will cast a mysterious buff. Once the buff goes into effect, you'll have to hit an enemy at least 5 minutes later to trigger the buff again.\n#cCannot be used on Action Pets.#

05190013.name: Open Pet Shop Skill
05190013.desc: Add an Open General Store skill to the designated pet. You can purchase potions to recover HP & MP, or get throwing stars and bullets. Some maps restrict the use of this item, though.

05190014.name: Slimming Medicine
05190014.desc: Giving this medicine to a pet with the #cFatten Up# skill will remove the Fatten Up skill.

05190017.name: Advanced Auto Move Skill
05190017.desc: Adds a skill that automatically picks up items and Mesos within a greater range without having to move.

05191000.name: (-) Delete Item Pick-Up
05191000.desc: If you use this scroll, your pet will no longer pick up items.\n#cCannot be used on Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

05191001.name: (-) Delete HP Charge
05191001.desc: Use this scroll to disable the pet from automatically feeding the character when the HP reaches critical stage.

05191002.name: (-)Delete Expand Range
05191002.desc: If you use this scroll, your pet's range of travel will return to the default.\n#cCannot be used on Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

05191003.name: (-) Delete Automatic Pick-Up
05191003.desc: If you use this scroll, your pet will no longer automatically move to pick up items and mesos.\n#cCannot be used on Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

05191004.name: (-) Delete Pick up Leftover Item & Meso
05191004.desc: Use this scroll to disable pets from picking up leftover items and mesos, the ones that have been dropped for more than 30 seconds.

05820000.desc:

- #cRight-click# the Potion Pot to open the genie window.
- Drag HP or MP recovery items into the item window.
- Check #cAUTOFILL# to charge the pot automatically when you loot compatible items.
- Equip to a quickslot, or to a pet's Auto HP/Auto MP Potion Pouch.
- Once expired, the pot remains in inventory.
- Use a #cRust Remover# to extend the pot's duration by 30 days.
- Use a #cPot Embiggener# to increase the pot's capacity.

05820001.name: [7 Days] Potion Pot
05820001.desc: Special potion that recovers just enough HP and MP. Right-click to open the pot. Drag & drop potions into the window to charge up the Potion Pot. Activate "AUTOFILL" option to charge the Potion Pot automatically as you get potions while training. If you also want to autofil your pot with Elixirs, check the "Elixir" option. You can use a Rust Remover to renew your pot once it expires. You can also purchase a Pot Embiggener if you want to add more space.

05821000.name: Pot Embiggener
05821000.desc: Use to permanently increase the Potion Pot's Storage capacity by one level(1000000). Hover your cursor over the Potion Pot's icon to view current capacity. Maximum capacity level: 9(10000000).
